Position Summary   The Director of Product Line Management for Optical Engines is responsible for defining, executing, and owning the product strategy and lifecycle for Adtran’s optical engine portfolio. This role sets the vision for client pluggables and embedded optical engines supporting access, aggregation, metro, and transport use cases, aligned to Adtran’s open networking and disaggregated systems strategy.  This leader serves as the primary business owner for the optical engine product line, driving market success through close collaboration with R&D, supply chain, sales, marketing, system product management, and key customers and partners.     Key Responsibilities    Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership    Own the end‑to‑end product strategy and roadmap for Optical Engines (e.g., pluggable optics, coherent engines, embedded optical solutions).  Define product positioning, value propositions, and differentiation aligned with Adtran’s systems, software, and open network solutions.  Drive make/buy/partner decisions for optical technologies in alignment with corporate strategy.  Deliver Market Requirement Specifications and ROI analysis for new product concepts, working with R&D and lead customers to help define the roadmap    Market & Customer Leadership    Serve as the voice of the customer, translating service provider, MSO, enterprise, and partner requirements into product definitions.  Engage directly with Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers on roadmap alignment, feature prioritization, and custom requirements.  Monitor market trends (coherent optics evolution, DWDM standards, ZR/ZR+, Open Line Systems, power and density advances) and competitive dynamics.    Execution & Lifecycle Management    Own business cases, pricing strategies, margin targets, and ROI for the optical engine portfolio.  Lead product lifecycle management from concept, development, launch, and growth through end‑of‑life.  Partner with engineering to ensure on‑time, on‑budget delivery of products meeting performance, cost, and quality targets.    Cross‑Functional Leadership    Work closely with system product management teams to align optical engines with Adtran platforms.  Collaborate with operations and supply chain on long‑term component strategy, vendor relationships, and cost optimization.  Support sales, solutions engineering, and marketing with technical messaging, enablement, and customer presentations.    Team Leadership    Build, mentor, and lead a high‑performing product line management team.  Establish best practices across market analysis, roadmap development, and product governance.      Required Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field; MBA preferred.  10+ years of experience in optical networking technology, with at least 5 years in product management or product line leadership.  Deep understanding of optical engines and technologies including coherent optics (ZR/ZR+), pluggable form factors, client optics and DWDM systems.  Proven experience owning a product P&L or equivalent business responsibility.  Strong customer‑facing and executive‑level communication skills.  Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix organization.      Preferred Qualifications    Experience with open networking, disaggregated optical systems, or software‑defined networking.  Prior leadership in semiconductor‑adjacent or optics component businesses.  Familiarity with service‑provider purchasing models and long product lifecycles.  Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers.      Key Success Metrics    Revenue growth and margin performance of the optical engines portfolio  On‑time delivery of roadmap commitments  Customer adoption across Adtran platforms  Cost reduction and supply chain resiliency  Alignment of optical engine capabilities with system‑level differentiation

## Job Summary

The Senior Hardware Engineer will be a member of the Optical Engines R&D team responsible for designing pluggable optical transceiver modules for metro, core, and data center applications. The successful candidate will have proven competency in high-speed electronic design, signal integrity management, and product development throughout the complete product lifecycle.

This role will work closely with hardware, FPGA, firmware, test, and mechanical engineering teams to deliver innovative optical networking products from concept through production. Experience with simulation tools such as Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS, and other signal integrity analysis tools is highly desirable.

## Duties and Responsibilities

• Develop block diagrams and schematics from the initial concept phase.

• Specify, design, test, integrate, and release new optical transceiver products to production.

• Create Hardware Unit Design Specifications and test plans.

• Design solutions utilizing bare-die components and advanced microelectronic assembly techniques, including wire bonding and flip-chip technologies.

• Work closely with PCB layout engineers on complex, high-layer-count board designs.

• Provide guidance to CAD designers throughout PCB development activities.

• Collaborate with FPGA, firmware, and test engineering teams during product integration and validation.

• Perform signal integrity analysis and high-speed simulations using industry-standard tools.

• Support products through manufacturing transfer and production release activities.

• Provide engineering support for products in production and work directly with contract manufacturing partners.

• Work cross-functionally across R&D disciplines to meet product performance, quality, cost, and schedule objectives.

• Complete the full product design lifecycle on portions of the system involving multiple components.

• Work independently on assigned design activities with minimal supervision.

• Understand product architecture, design processes, tools, and development methodologies required to perform assigned responsibilities.

## Basic Qualifications

• BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in high-speed board design.

• Strong fundamentals in electromagnetic and RF design, including impedance matching and S-parameter analysis.

• Experience with high-speed RF measurements and characterization techniques.

• Experience with fiber optic testing and measurements.

• Experience using laboratory equipment including:
• Spectrum Analyzers

• Network Analyzers

• Logic Analyzers

• Function Generators

• BER Test Sets

• Proficiency with schematic capture tools such as Mentor Graphics DxDesigner, Xpedition, or equivalent.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering.

• Experience using Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS, HyperLynx, or similar EM/SI simulation tools.

• Experience designing optical transceivers or coherent pluggable optical modules.

• Knowledge of optical component reliability requirements and telecommunications standards, including Telcordia, IEC, and ITU.

• Experience with coherent optical systems.

• Programming experience using Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW for automation and test development.

• Knowledge of signal integrity and power integrity analysis techniques.

## Travel Requirements

• Approximately 10% travel.
• 5% domestic travel

• 5% international travel

Generate high-quality technical documentation, including design specifications and test plans.   Testing & Validation   Evaluate optoelectronic components and subsystems using laboratory test setups.  Verify compliance with supplier specifications and ADTRAN product requirements. Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners to ensure successful product deployment.  Identify technical risks and develop mitigation plans.  Support volume manufacturing and ongoing product lifecycle activities.  Perform other duties as assigned.   Qualifications  Required Education   Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.   Required Experience & Skills   Strong knowledge of Optical Communications Theory and Digital Communications Theory.  Experience designing and developing optical modules and optical sub-assemblies.  Hands-on testing experience with optical components, modules, and subsystems.  Experience with optical system simulation and analysis tools.  Test automation experience.  Strong technical writing and documentation skills.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.  Proven ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.   Preferred Qualifications   Knowledge of Ethernet standards.  Familiarity with optical component reliability requirements.  Experience working with telecommunications standards including Telcordia, IEC, and ITU.   Success Profile  The ideal candidate:   Is a collaborative team player.  Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills.  Can effectively coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners.  Produces high-quality engineering documentation.  Thrives in a fast-paced product development environment.   Travel   Occasional travel may be required to support activities at other ADTRAN locations, customer sites, or supplier/manufacturing partner facilities.

Build a strong foundation in finance while helping turn accurate data into practical business insight.

As a Financial Analyst, you’ll support the day-to-day financial processes that help our team make informed decisions. You’ll work closely with experienced finance colleagues and cross-functional partners, gaining hands-on exposure to order processing, month-end activities, and reconciliations. This is an opportunity for a finance professional who is curious, detail-oriented, and eager to grow in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

• Prepare and post journal entries and support month-end close activities in accordance with established timelines and controls.

• Perform account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and escalate issues when appropriate.

• Review and process sales orders in line with financial policies, approval requirements, and internal controls.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and other teams to help resolve order-processing issues and maintain accurate financial information.

• Assist with audit requests, and documentation supporting compliance activities.

• Learn and apply relevant company policies, systems, and finance best practices.

## What You Bring

• Experience through a finance, accounting, co-op, internship, or similar role is preferred.

• A foundational understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and reconciliation processes.

• Working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables; an interest in developing stronger analytical skills.

• Exposure to financial or ERP systems such as NetSuite or Oracle is an asset.

• Exposure to Tableau, Power BI, or other data-visualization tools is an asset.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and commitment to accurate work.

• The ability to communicate clearly, ask thoughtful questions, and work effectively with colleagues across functions.

• A proactive learning mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with guidance.

## Why Join Us

You’ll join a supportive finance team where you can build practical experience, strengthen your technical skills, and take on increasing responsibility as you grow.

Purpose of the Role: The "QNX Everywhere" Initiative   QNX is on a mission to compete directly with Linux as the premier, go-to operating system for embedded development worldwide. Through our  QNX Everywhere  initiative, we are building a rich, seamless open-source ecosystem that brings the vast array of open-source software currently enjoyed on Linux natively onto the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS).    As an Open-Source Software Developer, you will play a pivotal role in this initiative. You will analyze, port, optimize, and upstream a wide range of open-source software — spanning core system utilities, networking middleware, IPC frameworks, middleware stacks, applications, AI frameworks, and bleeding-edge  Physical AI & Robotics  stacks. By bringing these technologies to QNX, you will enable developers globally to build safe, secure, and feature-rich embedded solutions without sacrificing the rich open-source ecosystem. Projects span a wide variety of domains, including:   System Runtimes:  Node.js, GTK, SQLite, Boost.   Networking & Middleware:  SOME/IP, MQTT, DDS, Zenoh.   Physical AI & Robotics:  ROS2, OpenPI, Google MediaPipe, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow.     Upstreaming & Community Leadership:  Work directly with upstream open-source communities and maintainers to integrate QNX build targets, patches, and CI configurations into mainstream repositories.   Hardware & Accelerator Enablement:  Work with silicon partners to enable open-source software on diverse embedded platforms, including GPU/NPU acceleration blocks ( NVIDIA IGX   Thor, AMD ROCm , Qualcomm, NXP).   QNX Subsystem Integration:  Integrate open-source projects with core QNX subsystems (graphics, networking, USB, audio, sensors, and multimedia).   Porting Layers & Toolchain Support:  Develop OS-specific abstraction layers, shims, and porting libraries; adapt cross-compilation build systems (CMake, Meson, Bazel, Cargo, GN/Ninja) for QNX toolchains.   Performance Optimization:  Perform low-level profiling, memory footprint reduction, latency tuning, and performance optimization on embedded target hardware. Strong software development skills in C and C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python.  Proven experience with Linux/Unix development environments and cross-compilation toolchains (CMake, Meson, Ninja, Make).  Solid understanding of operating system internals and POSIX APIs (pthreads, IPC, memory management, networking sockets).  Excellent communication skills with an interest in collaborating within open-source developer communities.  Self-motivated with a passion for building software ecosystems.      Any of the below are considered a bonus:    Experience porting, building, or maintaining large open-source projects or Linux distributions.  Experience or interest in  Physical AI, Robotics, or Vision frameworks  (e.g., ROS2, OpenPI, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).  Experience with  GPU / Heterogeneous Compute  stacks (NVIDIA CUDA/TensorRT, AMD ROCm, Vulkan Compute, OpenCL) on platforms like NVIDIA Thor/IGX or AMD silicon.  Knowledge of embedded GUI engines (Qt, GTK), or automotive/industrial middleware (DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT). ## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts.

With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we're looking for?

Are you passionate about building the tools that power the world's most advanced embedded systems? Join a team of highly skilled engineers developing the compilers, libraries, utilities, and command-line tools that help developers create mission-critical software used in automotive, robotics, industrial automation, and beyond.

This is an opportunity to work close to the operating system, solve complex technical challenges, and influence the evolution of a world-class development platform.

##

## What You'll Do:

• Design, develop, and enhance system-level software including compilers, command-line utilities, runtime libraries, and developer tooling. This involves a combination of in-house tools and the GNU or LLVM toolchains.

• Build innovative solutions that enable customers to deliver high-performance, reliable, and secure embedded applications.

• Investigate and solve complex technical problems across the software stack, from low-level system components to developer-facing tools.

• Collaborate with experienced engineers to define product requirements, architecture, and long-term technical strategy.

• Participate in design and code reviews, contributing to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

• Continuously expand your expertise in compiler technologies, operating systems, embedded development, and software engineering best practices.

##

## What You Bring:

• Strong software development experience in C and/or C++.

• Understanding of embedded software development concepts and real-time operating systems (RTOS).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle challenging technical issues.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a passion for technical discussions and architecture design.

• Curiosity, creativity, and a desire to build technology that other developers rely on every day.

##

## Nice to Have:

• Experience developing, maintaining, or optimizing compilers, toolchains, or language runtimes.

• Interest in programming language implementation, code generation, optimization, or compiler internals.

• Experience with Linux and/or Windows-based development environments.

• Background in systems programming, including operating systems, debuggers, profilers, interpreters, linkers, or performance analysis tools.

• Familiarity with low-level software, performance optimization, or developer productivity tools.

##

## Why You'll Love This Role:

• Work on technology that sits at the heart of embedded and real-time systems.

• Solve technically challenging problems that require deep systems knowledge.

• Collaborate with experts in operating systems, compilers, and systems software.

• Influence products used by developers worldwide.

• Grow your expertise in a highly specialized and impactful engineering domain.

If you are ready to use your expertise to drive real innovation, we would love to hear from you!

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

Join us in shaping the future of secure automotive technology. As part of our team, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring the safety and resilience of next-generation embedded systems. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge cybersecurity challenges in a dynamic environment where your expertise directly influences products used worldwide.

## What You’ll Do

• Be the cybersecurity authority for development teams, guiding them to meet ISO/SAE 21434 standards and beyond.

• Own and evolve the QNX Cybersecurity Management System—your ideas will drive improvements.

• Dive deep into research and vulnerability analysis, uncovering risks before they become threats.

• Review and refine project documentation to align with best-in-class security practices.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, providing expert product security support.

• Lead Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) activities, ensuring compliance with ISO 21434.

• Analyze software defects for security impact, working closely with developers to mitigate risks.

• Verify and validate ISO 21434 work products for quality and compliance.

• Advise on security testing strategies, helping teams strengthen their defenses.

• Identify compliance gaps and implement process improvements, keeping us ahead of evolving standards.

• Automate everything you can—from fuzz testing to vulnerability scanning and reporting.

## What We’re Looking For

• Solid understanding of ISO/SAE 21434 and familiarity with ASPICE, ISO 26262, and other automotive standards.

• Exposure to EU CRA, IEC 62443, ETSI 303, and global cybersecurity regulations.

• Experience in product security, engineering teams, certifications, and audits.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

• Hands-on experience with C/C++, Python, and embedded systems.

• Bonus: You love automating processes and making security scalable.

## Why You’ll Love This Role

• Work on mission-critical systems that power the automotive industry.

• Influence security architecture and processes at a global scale.

• Collaborate with world-class engineers and cybersecurity experts.

• Enjoy autonomy, ownership, and innovation—your ideas matter here.

• Be part of a team that values continuous learning and cutting-edge research

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. ## Are you the person we're looking for?

We're looking for a Senior Quality Manager to play a pivotal role in auditing, maintaining, and advancing the quality, safety, and cybersecurity processes behind QNX software products. In this highly visible role, you'll partner with engineering, product management, and safety and cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with global standards, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and help shape the future of our integrated Quality Management System (QMS) and Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS). If you're passionate about software processes and quality, enjoy navigating complex regulatory landscapes, and thrive in environments where precision and innovation intersect, we'd love to hear from you.

## What you'll do

## Quality Systems & Compliance Leadership

• Partner on the continual improvement of the QNX QMS and CSMS toward meeting quality objectives and maintaining certification to ISO 9001 and ISO/SAE 21434.

• Drive continuous improvement quality initiatives and champion a quality and safety culture across engineering and product development teams.

• Contribute to the evolution and enhancement of QNX quality processes, templates, methodologies, and compliance frameworks.

• Apply expertise across multiple industry standards including ISO 9001, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, IEC 61508, IEC 62304, and ASPICE to support certification readiness and regulatory compliance.

• Identify compliance gaps, assess risks, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

• Ensure process consistency, traceability, and evidence generation throughout the product lifecycle.

• Stay current with emerging standards, regulations, and industry best practices affecting safety-critical and cybersecurity-focused software development.

## Audit & Certification Activities

• Plan, execute, and document quality audits, gap analyses, compliance reviews, and process reviews assessments.

• Support certification readiness initiatives across safety, cybersecurity, and quality domains.

• Maintain compliance evidence packages and audit documentation required for internal and external assessments.

• Support interactions with certification bodies, regulatory organizations, customers, and external auditors.

• Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements through design, implementation, verification, validation, and release activities.

## Technical Leadership & Collaboration

• Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering teams on standards interpretation, audit readiness, process compliance, and certification requirements.

• Build strong cross-functional relationships that align quality objectives with technical and business goals.

• Participate in customer-facing audits including questionnaire responses, supplier engagements, and quality reviews.

• Contribute to quality strategy discussions, process governance, and product lifecycle initiatives across the organization.

## What you'll have

• Proven experience in software process and quality management within embedded software environments, ideally in safety-critical industries such as automotive, industrial automation, medical devices, aerospace, defense, or rail.

• Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining compliance with ISO 9001 and one or more of the following: ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, IEC 61508, IEC 62304, ASPICE, SEI-CMMI, DO-178C.

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, configuration management, requirements management, traceability, and process quality assurance methodologies.

• Experience conducting internal and external audits and supporting certification activities.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail, and influencing skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Quality Management, Quality Systems Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline

## If you have any of these then that would be great

• Previous software engineering experience spanning requirements, design, development, testing, or systems engineering.

• Experience with process modeling, quality measurement, and traceability management in a functional safety environment.

• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification and/or root cause analysis (RCA), 5D, 8D.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as JAMA, Jira, GitHub, and Confluence.

• ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification.

• ASPICE Process Expert or Provisional/Competent Assessor certification.

• TÜV Functional Safety Engineer certification.

• Experience supporting cybersecurity management systems and compliance programs

## Why QNX?

• Industry Leader: Be part of a company powering the next generation of critical embedded systems.

• Impactful Work: Lead high-impact continuous improvement quality initiatives that influence growth and market positioning.

• Innovation & Growth: Join a team that thrives on innovation and drives cutting-edge solutions.

• Happy and Collaborative Culture: Work with talented and passionate professionals across diverse functions.

• Solutions Impact: Your work will shape offerings that define the future of industry and intelligent systems.

## Join us and help ensure the software the world depends on never lets it down!

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

We're expanding our Product Cybersecurity team and looking for passionate security researchers who love understanding how software fails, uncovering hidden vulnerabilities, and pushing offensive security techniques to the next level. If you're the type of person who can't resist digging deeper into a crash dump, writing custom fuzzing harnesses, reversing software to understand its inner workings, or using AI to uncover attack paths others miss, we'd love to talk to you.

## What You'll Do:

• Hunt for vulnerabilities across QNX products and embedded software components before attackers find them

• Perform penetration testing and offensive security assessments against real-world embedded platforms

• Design, develop, and execute large-scale fuzzing campaigns to uncover memory corruption defects, logic flaws, and emerging vulnerability classes

• Investigate crashes and software defects to determine exploitability and security impact

• Conduct root-cause analysis and exploit development to understand and demonstrate real-world attack scenarios

• Leverage AI/ML-assisted techniques to accelerate vulnerability discovery and improve security analysis workflows

• Build and evolve automated security testing frameworks, fuzzers, scanners, and exploit validation pipelines

• Collaborate closely with engineering teams to reproduce, triage, and remediate vulnerabilities

• Contribute tools, methodologies, and research that strengthen our overall security posture

• Stay at the forefront of emerging threats and vulnerability research affecting modern embedded operating systems

## What We're Looking For:

• Hands-on experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing, exploit development, or offensive security

• Practical experience with fuzzing frameworks such as AFL, libFuzzer, or similar technologies

• Strong understanding of low-level software internals including memory management, process isolation, POSIX APIs, concurrency, and embedded systems concepts

• Familiarity with common vulnerability classes such as:

• Use-after-free

• Heap corruption

• Buffer overflows

• Race conditions

• Privilege escalation

• Logic vulnerabilities

• Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python

• Experience developing automation and tooling for security testing or vulnerability discovery

• A passion for investigating complex systems and finding weaknesses others overlook

• The ability to independently drive research initiatives from concept through discovery and validation

## Bonus Points If You Have:

• Experience applying AI or machine learning techniques to security research or vulnerability detection

• Knowledge of automotive cybersecurity, embedded systems, or QNX-based platforms

• Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434 or secure software development practices

• Reverse engineering experience using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, or similar frameworks

• Experience working with operating systems, kernels, drivers, or low-level system software

## Why You’ll Love This Role:

• This is an opportunity to spend your time exploring, researching, breaking, and improving the security of software that runs some of the most important systems in the world. You'll have the freedom to:

• Pursue challenging security research questions

• Build new tools and automation frameworks

• Experiment with emerging AI-assisted security techniques

• Influence the security of products deployed at massive scale

• Collaborate with world-class embedded engineers and security researchers

• Turn curiosity into real-world impact

The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

Our customers count on us to convert awesome ideas into great products and services. The QNX Board Support Package (BSP) Team is looking for Driver Developers (Software Dev II & Senior’s) to design and implement the next generation computing platforms for a Tier 1 automotive customer. This person will be part of a development team responsible for creating software drivers to support next-gen hardware peripherals on some of the most advanced hardware platforms available. You must be someone with ideas and real passion for software delivered to maximize reuse, efficiency, and simplicity.

In return for your skills, expertise and enthusiasm, we will provide you with an attractive compensation & comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the brightest minds working on cutting edge platforms at QNX. Join us and you’ll become part of a team that is already leading the way and there is no telling what you could accomplish.

## You will have:

• A successful track record of developing drivers for various hardware peripherals including the adaptation of existing drivers for embedded platforms.

• Proven aptitude for BSP development such as board bring up, enhancement of existing software and performance tuning.

• Enthusiastic about developing new driver architectures to support future hardware peripheral advancements.

• Focused on ensuring software is held to our quality standards

• Interested in opportunities to develop software under specialised safety standards such as ISO26262, IEC61508 etc.

## You will have the following technical skills:

• Bootloader and board bring up skills such as u-boot/DRAM controller initialization / system clock configuration / GPIO & pinmux)

• Experience with serial driver development for UARTs, i2c, SPI, CAN, input devices, touch controllers etc

• Storage device driver development targeting block storage devices, UFS, SD/eMMC, AHCI/SATA, or flash technology (NAND/NOR)

• High speed complex communication busses like PCIe, USB

• Experience writing drivers for wired and wireless networking interfaces

• Development know-how on power management, DVFS, thermal management, etc

• Domain expertise with security hardware and firmware (TPM, TrustZone, etc.)

## You will have the following skills & experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience

• Established software development experience

• In-depth knowledge of C and Assembly programming languages.

• Hands on development experience using embedded operating systems (QNX, Linux, GreenHills, VXworks preferred)

• Prior experience in driver development is essential

• Experience writing software for major processor architectures (ARM, x86, PPC, etc.)

• Hands on experience in the development of software following either safety standards (ISO26262, IEC61508 etc) or MIL standards would be a standout skill

## For the Senior level roles, you will also be able to demonstrate:

• Writing of QNX or Linux device drivers

• Ownership of complete subsystems with ability to work independently to completion

• Mastery across multiple bus architectures and communication protocols

• Project leadership or team leadership experience

## Your work will affect millions of users and be essential to the success of QNX.

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

The QNX Power Management Test Team is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Test Specialist to help validate and deliver next-generation file systems technologies. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software, hardware, automation, and embedded systems while solving challenging technical problems that directly impact product reliability and customer success. You'll design sophisticated test suites, build scalable automation frameworks, execute system-level validation on real hardware, and collaborate with world-class developers to identify and resolve issues before they reach customers. Every day offers new technical challenges, from debugging complex failures to improving automated test coverage and accelerating release quality. If you're energized by automation, passionate about quality, and enjoy working hands-on with hardware in a fast-paced engineering environment, we'd love to talk to you.

## What You'll Do

• Design, develop, optimize automated tests, test frameworks and test cases to continuously improve test coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.

• Execute software validation activities on both reference and customer hardware platforms.

• Debug complex software and hardware interactions, analyze failures, and perform root-cause investigations.

• Create and maintain detailed defect reports and verify fixes through rigorous regression testing.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test documentation based on product requirements.

• Generate high-quality test reports and communicate results clearly to development and leadership teams.

• Build, maintain, and improve automation lab infrastructure and testing environments.

• Collaborate closely with development, integration, and test teams to ensure product quality across the software stack.

• Reproduce and isolate field-reported issues using creative troubleshooting and validation techniques.

## What You Bring

• Experience developing automated test solutions for software or embedded systems.

• Must have strong programming skills in Python, C, and Shell scripting

• Hands-on experience with Linux

• Experience testing file systems features across multiple hardware platforms.

• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, validation strategies, and test automation best practices.

• Proven experience creating test plans, developing test cases, executing tests, and reporting results.

• Ability to work independently while effectively contributing within a collaborative team environment.

• Strong organizational skills with a track record of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality results.

• Experience with modern development workflows and tools, including Git or SVN, Jira, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines

• Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and system validation skills in embedded software and hardware environments.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear, concise, and actionable defect reports.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

If you’re passionate about open ecosystems, upstream collaboration, and bringing modern open‑source technologies into places they’ve never been before, this role gives you a rare opportunity: shaping how open-source runs on one of the world’s most trusted real‑time operating systems. This is a 50/50 hybrid role: half deep technical contribution and half leadership.

At QNX, open source isn’t an afterthought, it’s becoming a core pillar of our platform strategy. You’ll help define how open source evolves inside a safety‑critical, high‑reliability environment used in automotive, robotics, medical devices, and beyond.

## Responsibilities include:

• Porting & optimizing open‑source projects for the QNX RTOS, ensuring performance, reliability, and real‑time behavior.

• Designing integration layers, build systems, and CI/CD workflows for open‑source components.

• Integrating OSS with QNX subsystems such as graphics, networking, USB, audio, and sensors.

• Upstreaming QNX‑relevant changes and collaborate directly with open‑source communities.

• Leading & mentoring a team of talented open‑source engineers, providing technical direction and fostering growth.

• Driving project roadmaps, define best practices, and champion open‑source adoption within QNX.

• Documenting processes & advocating for open‑source excellence across the company.

## You will need:

• Significant progressive embedded software experience, including in technical leadership/mentorship.

• Strong skills in C/C++ for embedded systems development & hands‑on RTOS development (QNX, Linux, or similar).

• Deep understanding of embedded systems, hardware architectures, and cross‑compilation tool chains.

• Experience in device driver development.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills. You will have the proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a team of software engineers, fostering growth and accountability.

• Curiosity, enthusiasm, and interest in new technologies.

## It would be great if you have:

• Linux or Android internals experience.

• Proficiency with Git, GDB, GCC, Make/CMake.

• Proven contributions to large open‑source projects.

• Familiarity with open‑source licensing models & best practices relating to community engagement.

• Strong GCC/GDB knowledge.

• Experience with Agentic AI.

## Why join QNX as a Technical Development Manager:

  We are hiring a Product Owner to own the delivery backlog for our core products. You will partner with Product Managers who own product strategy and roadmap outcomes, and with Engineering teams who own solution design and execution. Your focus is to translate product intent into clear, testable work, keep the backlog healthy and enable predictable delivery of customer value.   
   
  What You'll Do:   
 
  Own and continuously refine the team backlog to maximize delivered value within roadmap guardrails.  
  Translate product goals and customer problems into well-formed epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria and supporting context (happy and alternate requirements).  
  Lead backlog refinement with Engineering and ensure stories meet a shared Definition of Ready before sprint commitment.  
  Be the day-to-day requirements decision-maker for the team: answer questions quickly, clarify scope, and make pragmatic tradeoffs to keep delivery moving.  
  Partner with Engineering and QA to define testable acceptance criteria and validate completed work, accepting/rejecting stories based on agreed criteria.  
  Support sprint planning and sprint reviews by presenting priorities, context, and acceptance criteria, ensuring completed work is demonstrable and aligns with intended outcomes.  
  Coordinate Stakeholder Input and triage intake (Support/CS escalations, customer feedback, technical debt requests) into the backlog with appropriate context and priority rationale, shielding the engineering team from unplanned work.  
  Collaborate with Product Management on discovery and evidence gathering (customer calls, workflow observation, support data) and provide inputs that inform roadmap decisions.  
  Contribute to release readiness by partnering with QA to assess quality risks, outstanding defects and release confidence, as well as supplying scope summaries, release notes inputs, and enablement details for international teams as needed.  
 
   
  Where You’ll Own:  
  You are empowered to:  
 
  Order and re-order the workstream backlog within roadmap guardrails and agreed priorities.  
  Define acceptance criteria and determine whether a story meets “done” for product intent.  
  Make day-to-day scope tradeoffs within a sprint when new information emerges (while keeping the PM informed).  
 
  You will escalate to the Product Manager when:  
 
  A decision materially changes roadmap priority, customer commitments, or commercial implications.  
  Tradeoffs involve cross-team dependencies, significant schedule impact, or major scope changes.  
  Requests touch pricing/packaging, contractual commitments, or high-risk compliance considerations.  
 
   
   What Success Looks Like:    
 
  Engineering has a consistently “ready” backlog (typically 1–2 sprints ahead) with clear acceptance criteria and minimal churn due to unclear requirements.  
  Sprint outcomes are more predictable because stories are well-scoped, understood, and testable.  
  Stakeholders trust the backlog: priorities are transparent, rationale is documented, and intake is triaged consistently.  
  Shipped work solves the intended customer problem with fewer avoidable defects and less rework caused by ambiguity.  
 
   
  Who We're Looking For:  
 
  3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Technical Product Owner, or similar delivery-focused product role in a SaaS environment.  
  Demonstrated ability to write high-quality user stories and acceptance criteria and to decompose epics into incremental deliverables.  
  Experience partnering closely with engineering teams (Agile/Scrum/Kanban) and operating in a fast feedback loop.  
  Comfort interfacing directly with enterprise customers to understand workflows and validate requirements.  
  Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate tradeoffs and document decisions.  
  Working knowledge of analytics/telemetry concepts (instrumentation needs, adoption metrics) sufficient to specify requirements and interpret signals.  
  Maintain a high standard of security awareness, ensuring data protection, compliance with company policies, and adherence to industry standards in all aspects of work.  
 Exercise the highest level of discretion in the handling and protection of all data and sensitive information.  
 
   
   Assets (Nice to Have):    
 
  Experience with investigations, case management, compliance, ethics, HR, or security incident workflows.

  Experience working on multi-tenant SaaS platforms, migrations, integrations, or reporting engines.

We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.            Backed by over 25 years of domain   expertise   and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.      
   
    Role Summary       
   We’re   looking for a Solutions Engineer to join our Sales team. In this remote-first role,   you’ll     be responsible for   driving the technical success of our sales efforts — delivering impactful product demonstrations across Case IQ’s suite of solutions and supporting the sales team in winning new business. Through a consultative, customer-focused approach,   you’ll   help refine how we present our products, elevate the technical   proficiency   of our sales   team.   The position will involve occasional travel throughout the year for client meetings, training sessions, and industry events.   
     
    What You'll Do       
    Sales Support and Enablement       
 
   Conduct compelling, tailored product demonstrations across Case IQ's suite of solutions to help prospects understand value and capabilities.      
 
 
   Partner with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle to craft winning demo strategies aligned to customer pain points,     objectives  , and workflows.      
 
 
   Support discovery calls by uncovering technical requirements and positioning the right Case IQ solutions.      
 
 
   Serve as a trusted technical advisor, ensuring customers understand how Case IQ solutions fit into their workflows and ecosystems.      
 
 
   Collaborate with Marketing and Product teams to refine demo narratives, assets, and product messaging that support stronger conversion.      
 
    Performance and Metrics       
 
   Support demo delivery goals and contribute to Sales team ARR targets and increased win rates.      
 
 
   Track and assess demo quality, conversion impact, and customer engagement metrics.      
 
 
   Develop reporting dashboards or feedback loops to highlight patterns in demo performance and sales efficiency.      
 
    Team Enablement and Collaboration       
 
   Act as a primary point of contact for sales representatives needing demo support, objection handling, or product clarification.      
 
 
   Share best practices across the sales organization, from demo setup and storytelling to handling complex product questions.      
 
 
   Work with Sales and Product     leadership     to build repeatable demo frameworks and playbooks.      
 
 
   Collaborate closely with Product Management and Customer Success to channel market feedback into roadmap insights.      
 
   
    What Success Looks Like       
 
    30 Days     :       Complete onboarding, role-specific training,     required     security/compliance expectations, and product/demo environment orientation. Build context on Case IQ solutions, sales process, ICP, customer workflows, and current demo assets.      
 
 
    60 Days :       Begin supporting discovery and demo preparation, delivering portions of demos with Sales partners, documenting common objections or product questions, and contributing to demo asset improvements.      
 
 
    90 Days :       Own defined demos or technical sales support workstreams with increasing independence, including tailored demo strategy, discovery support, objection handling, and follow-up documentation.      
 
 
    6 Months :       Contribute to stronger demo consistency, clearer sales enablement, improved customer-facing technical narratives, and better visibility into demo performance or conversion patterns.      
 
 
    1 Year :     Operate     as a trusted       Solutions Engineering partner who helps Sales win new business through credible discovery, tailored demonstrations, strong technical storytelling, and cross-functional market feedback    .      
 
   
    Who You Are       
 
   B    achelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 years in B2B software sales or solutions engineering, ideally within Compliance, Investigations, or Risk Management sectors.      
 
 
   Proven ability to translate complex software capabilities into customer value through consultative demos and discovery sessions.      
 
 
   Strong technical acumen across SaaS environments, integrations, and     implementation     workflows.      
 
 
   Excellent presentation and communication skills, with an ability to adapt messaging for both executive and technical audiences.      
 
 
   A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset — excited to build and lead a high-performing Solutions Engineering team from the ground up.      
 
   
    Perks       a  nd Benefits       
 
   Work remotely within a flexible work environment; our team spans     7 countries      
 
 
   Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!      
 
 
   Generous professional development budget.      
 
 
   RRSP / 401k matching program    
 
 
   Half-day Fridays in the summer.

Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Distinguished Engineer - AI Computing System

## About the team:

The Advanced Computing and Storage Lab, currently a part of the Vancouver Research Centre, aims to explore adaptive computing system architectures to address the challenges posed by flexible and variable application loads in the future. It assists in ensuring the stability and quality of training clusters, constructs dynamic cluster configuration strategy solvers, and establishes precision control systems to create stable and efficient computing power clusters. One of the lab's goals is to focus on key industry AI application scenarios such as large model training/inference, based on key technologies like low-precision training, multi-modal training, and reinforcement learning, responsible for bottleneck analysis and the design and development of optimization solutions, thereby improving training and inference performance as well as usability.

## About the job:

• As a leading expert in the industry in the field of training cluster software frameworks and technologies, gain insights into the evolution direction of industry AI large model training frameworks and key features. Plan and layout AI frameworks and software features for scenarios such as large model pre-training, post-training, and integrated training and inference, building key capabilities for the company's training cluster software framework.

• Focusing on the company's large model training optimization field, lead the team to build key technologies such as low-precision training, parallel strategy tuning, and training resource optimization, promoting the commercial implementation of large model perception optimization-related technologies.

• Focusing on the company's training servers and super nodes and other products, lead the team to build large model AI training frameworks, operator libraries, acceleration libraries, and other software frameworks and acceleration features, fully leveraging system engineering and software-hardware collaboration capabilities to enhance AI cluster computing efficiency.

• Identify high-quality academic resources in the direction of large model training, collaborate with domain experts and scholars on projects, layout related standards and patents, support the company's continuous innovation in the training cluster field, and build long-term competitiveness in the AI training cluster direction.

• Cultivate a team of technical experts and key technical backbone in the direction of AI training cluster frameworks and software optimization.

The base salary for this position ranges from $172,000 to $230,000 depending on education, experience and demonstrated expertise.

About Fullscript
 
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
 
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
 
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
 
This is your invitation.
 
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI & Analytics Engineering team. This team builds AI-powered lab interpretation, clinician decision support, and conversational experiences directly into the Fullscript product.
You’ll help build the systems behind some of Fullscript’s most important AI experiences: AI-generated lab summaries, practitioner-facing conversational agents, and tools that help clinicians move from data to insight more quickly. The work is technical, product-minded, and deeply tied to real practitioner workflows.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has shipped production AI systems, understands how to turn ambiguous clinical and product problems into working software, and can own work from early experimentation through deployment, evaluation, and iteration.
You’ll work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and medical stakeholders to build AI features that are reliable, useful, and grounded in the way practitioners actually deliver care.
What you'll do
Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered product features, including lab result summaries, clinical workflow tools, and practitioner-facing conversational agents.
Build backend services that integrate LLMs and ML models into Fullscript’s platform, primarily using Python, with increasing exposure to Elixir as the platform evolves.
Develop AI systems that can support open-ended clinical questions, follow-up interactions, and reasoning over structured and unstructured healthcare context.
Implement prompting, grounding, retrieval, and safety strategies that improve output quality, consistency, and clinical relevance.
Build evaluation, testing, monitoring, and CI/CD workflows for AI features, including approaches for accuracy, hallucination detection, edge cases, and reliability.
Partner with medical, product, analytics, and engineering teams to translate clinical needs into practical AI capabilities that can scale.
Own AI systems end to end, from experimentation and prototyping through production deployment, iteration, and ongoing improvement.
Contribute to architecture and implementation decisions for AI-powered analytics, lab interpretation, and clinical decision-support workflows.
Stay current with fast-moving LLM, agentic AI, and applied ML ecosystems, while staying pragmatic about what is ready for production use.
What you bring to the table
5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, applied AI engineering, backend engineering, or a similar role, with a track record of shipping production systems.
2+ years of recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including conversational agents, RAG workflows, tool use, or agentic systems.
Strong backend development experience in Python, with solid SQL fundamentals and comfort working across data-heavy product environments.
Experience integrating LLMs such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, or similar models into user-facing products.
Experience with LLM application frameworks or orchestration tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face tools, or similar frameworks.
Strong engineering practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD, observability, evaluation, and production monitoring.
Experience evaluating and validating LLM-based applications for quality, hallucinations, correctness, edge cases, and reliability over time.
Ability to work independently in ambiguous problem spaces, ask strong questions, make sound tradeoffs, and partner effectively with technical, product, medical, and non-technical stakeholders.
Bonus if you have
Experience with Elixir, Phoenix, functional programming, or an interest in building with Elixir as Fullscript’s AI platform evolves.
Experience building AI assistants, conversational agents, or decision-support tools in healthcare, clinical workflows, regulated products, or other high-trust environments.
Familiarity with MCP, Langfuse, agent orchestration patterns, tool-calling systems, or multi-step AI workflows.
What we can offer you
Salary range: $130,00 to $150,000 CAD
Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters
RRSP/401k match and stock options to invest in your future
Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.
Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products
Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career
Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa, Toronto, or Calgary preferred for this role.

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

The Opportunity Fullscript is looking for an AI Enablement Specialist to help Fullscripters use AI confidently, responsibly, and effectively in their day-to-day work. You will join Team GSD, Fullscript's AI and automation enablement team. GSD helps departments improve how work gets done by combining practical AI education, workflow discovery, and scalable automation. This role will own the human side of that work: turning fast-moving AI capabilities and internal tools into clear, useful learning experiences that meet people where they are. This is primarily a content, enablement, and adoption role. You will build the self-serve resources, interactive learning experiences, communications, and support models that help teams learn independently. You will also work with stakeholders to uncover workflow pain points, assess AI and automation opportunities, and translate what you learn into clear inputs for the GSD roadmap. You will not be expected to build machine learning models or act as a full-time trainer. You should, however, be hands-on and credible with modern AI tools, curious about how people learn, and comfortable facilitating a live session or webinar when it is the best way to help a group move forward. What you'll do Own the creation of Fullscript’s AI training and development content, including practical guides, slide decks, blogs, videos, playbooks, templates, and role-based learning paths. Build and continuously improve interactive, self-serve learning experiences that make Fullscript’s AI knowledge easy to find, understand, and apply independently. Identify user groups, learning needs, and skill gaps across Fullscript, then tailor content to their workflows, business context, and level of AI fluency. Stay current on AI tools, capabilities, use cases, and emerging trends, using that knowledge to keep Fullscript’s learning materials accurate, relevant, and practical. Partner with AI Champions to shape departmental adoption roadmaps, equip them with reusable resources, and support the rollout and internal go-to-market of new AI tools. Build strong relationships across the business, observe how teams work, and uncover operational pain points, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for AI or automation. Gather requirements and frame opportunities by documenting the problem, users, current workflow, expected impact, data needs, feasibility, and risk, then translate those insights into clear recommendations for GSD roadmap planning. Serve as a frontline enablement partner for GSD applications, turning recurring questions, adoption barriers, and user feedback into better content, product guidance, and roadmap inputs. The Opportunity
Fullscript is looking for a Cloud Security Engineer to help secure the cloud platforms that power care delivery for millions of patients.
In this role, you’ll partner with engineering teams to design, build, and operate secure-by-default cloud infrastructure across AWS and Google Cloud. You’ll help protect sensitive health data, harden our cloud footprint, automate guardrails, and move cloud security from project-by-project work into a scalable, programmatic practice.
You’ll work closely with Security Engineering, GRC, SOC, Platform Engineering, and product teams to prevent, detect, and respond to cloud-native threats. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who likes solving complex infrastructure problems with code, cares about helping teams ship securely, and wants their work to support better patient outcomes.
What you'll do
Design and implement cloud security controls across AWS and Google Cloud, including multi-account architecture, network segmentation, data protection, and secure-by-default infrastructure patterns.
Build reusable Terraform modules, reference architectures, policy-as-code guardrails, and self-service tooling that make secure implementation easier for engineering teams.
Operate and tune CSPM/CNAPP tooling to identify misconfigurations, exposures, toxic combinations, and coverage gaps across Fullscript’s cloud environments.
Drive remediation of cloud vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, balancing risk, engineering effort, customer impact, and business priorities.
Strengthen IAM, secrets management, key rotation, cloud credentials, machine identities, and just-in-time access patterns across cloud and SaaS environments.
Embed security into CI/CD pipelines through IaC scanning, container image scanning, SBOM generation, artifact protection, and software supply chain controls.
Partner with the SOC and engineering teams on cloud-native detections, logging, runbooks, incident response, post-incident learning, and secure AI/ML workload patterns.

Strong understanding of cloud-native attack paths, IAM risks, network controls, data protection, key management, secrets management, and workload identity.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code, ideally Terraform, and a strong understanding of how to secure it at scale.
Ability to write code in Python, Go, or a similar language to automate detection, remediation, and security workflows.
Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows without creating unnecessary friction.
Working knowledge of at least one compliance framework such as SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI-DSS, or ISO 27001, with the ability to translate requirements into technical controls.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a bias toward enabling teams, influencing without authority, and helping engineers build securely.

Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.
Hands-on experience with CSPM or CNAPP tools such as Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Lacework, or similar platforms.
Experience securing Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, TypeScript, GraphQL, containerized workloads, or modern cloud-native applications.
Cloud incident response, forensics, or threat hunting experience.
Experience securing AI/ML workloads, LLM integrations, data science platforms, autonomous AI systems, or non-human identities.
Familiarity with AI/ML model supply chain risks, AI-specific SBOMs, or controls for limiting blast radius and privilege escalation.
Open-source contributions or experience building internal security tooling.

About Fullscript
Fullscript is on a mission to help people get better, and our Distribution team plays a critical role in making that happen.
More than 125,000 practitioners and 10 million patients rely on Fullscript. Our Distribution teams help make sure the products they need arrive accurately and on time.
The Opportunity
As a Warehouse Supervisor, you’ll lead the day-to-day work of our warehouse team, supporting a safe, effective, and positive work environment.
What to know upfront:
On-site: This is a 100% on-site role. Remote/hybrid work and relocation assistance are not available.
Hands-on: You’ll work on the warehouse floor alongside your team.
Physical: You’ll walk, stoop, stand for extended periods, and lift up to 50 lbs.
Schedule: Monday through Friday with flexible hours. You must be able to stay until the day’s work is complete. Overtime, weekends, and holidays may be required.
What You’ll Do
Promote Fullscript’s values and mission while motivating and supporting the growth of your team.
Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and secure work environment.
Oversee all daily warehouse functions, including receiving, picking/packing, shipping, inventory control, quality control, facilities, and workplace safety.
Ensure employees follow work procedures and protocols, recognizing strong performance and administering corrective action when needed.
Create and maintain daily work schedules based on business needs, including overtime or ending shifts early when volume dictates.
Maintain time and attendance data, including employee punches and attendance occurrences.
Lead new-hire onboarding and training.
Find new and innovative ways to increase the effectiveness of labor and system resources.
Work cohesively with other department team members to ensure objectives are met.
Perform other duties as assigned.
What You Bring
3+ years of Warehousing & Logistics experience.
1+ years of leadership experience with teams of 20+, including hiring, training, and off-boarding.
High school diploma required; secondary education degree desired.
Advanced experience with WMS and/or ERP systems in a warehouse environment.
Proven track record of generating and successfully implementing effective ideas.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including public speaking.
Ability to make difficult decisions, solve problems, prioritize, generate and utilize reports, and manage projects.
Ability to work effectively with team members, suppliers, and cross-functional departments, with a track record of solving cross-departmental problems with lasting solutions.
Ability to lift 50 lbs and work a full-time shift, including overtime when necessary.
What We Offer
$75,000 to $85,000 USD
PTO • 401k match • Premium benefits with customizable coverage and HSA • Fullscript product discounts • Continuous learning opportunities
The range reflects base salary only. Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

At Fullscript, we put people first, work as a team, stay curious, and focus on impact. You’ll lead a team whose work directly helps practitioners and patients get the products they rely on.
Interested? We’d love to hear from you.

Founded in 2011, Fullscript began by helping practitioners access and prescribe the products they trust to support better outcomes. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners and 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to power care delivery across North America.
Our mission is simple: helping people get better.

THE ROLE
We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Manager to support one of Fullscript’s fastest-growing segments. In this role, you’ll work closely with the GM and cross-functional leaders across Commercial, Product, and Operations to understand business performance and support key decisions.
This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you’ll operate at the intersection of finance, strategy, and execution. You’ll own the financial model, develop business cases, and help translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Own the economic model. Become the owner of the segment financial and unit economic model, driving forecasting and tracking of the business
Lead performance reporting. Produce clear performance narratives with insights, options, and recommendations
Own the scorecard and diagnostics. Define and measure key business performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve outcomes
Lead driver-based analyses to uncover performance drivers and areas for value creation
Build investment-grade business cases, including scenario analysis, payback, and risk assessment
Partner closely with the GM and leaders across Commercial, Product, and Operations to support decision-making
Provide financial insight to guide tradeoffs across initiatives, investments, and operational decisions
Develop a deep understanding of the business’s economic drivers and how they impact growth and profitability
Maintain a dynamic economic model and contribute to the ongoing performance narrative
Partner with data and analytics teams to operationalize insights into dashboards and tools

WHAT YOU BRING
5+ years of experience in strategic finance, consulting, investment banking, or a related field
Strong financial modeling skills, including driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, and business case development
Structured problem-solving skills and comfort working through ambiguous business challenges
Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights
Experience working cross-functionally and supporting decision-making across teams
Strong communication skills, including presenting insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders
Bias for action and ability to move from analysis to execution

WHAT YOU GET
Flexible PTO and competitive pay
RRSP match and equity
Comprehensive benefits package
Fullscript product discounts
Learning and development opportunities
Remote-first flexibility

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?
If you enjoy working at the intersection of strategy, data, and business performance and want to help shape how a fast-growing healthcare company makes decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re grateful for the high level of interest in joining Fullscript. Because of the volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to individual inquiries via LinkedIn or email. Please apply directly through our careers page to ensure your application is reviewed.

About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Lead Data Scientist to anchor one of the most important bets in our next chapter.
Fullscript is building intelligence trained on real-world functional outcomes. Not textbook data. Not controlled trials. Real longitudinal practitioner data layered with our own prescribing and lab history.
The hard part isn’t building models. It’s designing research that can credibly claim causality in messy, non-randomized healthcare data. Can we say that Protocol X led to Outcome Y, and stand behind it with confidence?
You’ll define how we approach causal research, set the methodological standard, and turn complex clinical data into insight the business can actually use. The output of this role will shape product direction, influence executive decisions, and determine whether this initiative becomes foundational to the company’s future. This is a high bar. We’re looking for someone who’s comfortable owning it.
What you'll do
Designing rigorous observational research frameworks that move beyond correlation toward defensible causal inference
Addressing confounding, selection bias, missingness, and other structural challenges in real-world healthcare data
Extracting outcome intelligence from newly acquired longitudinal practitioner datasets
Connecting prescribing patterns, lab data, and behavioral signals into coherent analytical narratives
Establishing methodological standards that protect the integrity of our claims
Translating complex statistical findings into clear implications for Product, Marketing, and executive stakeholders
Leading and mentoring a small data team while remaining deeply hands-on in research and modeling
Building repeatable research processes that can scale as new data flows in
What you bring to the table
Advanced training in statistics, biostatistics, econometrics, or a related field with deep expertise in causal inference
Demonstrated experience designing studies in observational healthcare data where randomization is not available
Practical understanding of the pitfalls in real-world clinical datasets, including confounding variables, selection effects, and incomplete outcome signals
Comfort working with messy inputs such as PDF labs, narrative notes, inconsistent schemas, and evolving data structures
Strong Python proficiency and hands-on experience with statistical modeling libraries
A track record of translating analytical insight into tangible business or product decisions
Professional maturity and autonomy to run a high-visibility research function independently
Experience leading or mentoring other data professionals while maintaining technical depth
What we can offer you
Competitive Salary ranges
Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa, Toronto, or Calgary preferred for this role.
Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters
RRSP/401k match and stock options to invest in your future
Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.
Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products
Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.
Why Fullscript
Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.
