Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care. The Mission: Care Mode at Fullscript Fullscript is evolving from a platform patients use to access care into one that helps them actively follow through on it. What we call Care Mode is at the center of that evolution. It is designed to create a continuous connection between patients and their care teams—helping patients turn recommendations into sustainable actions while giving practitioners greater visibility into what happens between visits. Our goal is to close the loop from recommendation → engagement → adherence → outcomes, using technology to deepen the connection between patients and their care teams at scale. This is not engagement for engagement’s sake. It’s about building thoughtful, trusted experiences that help people take the next right step in their care. The Role We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Patient Experience pod and help shape the technical and product foundations of Care Mode. This role blends engineering leadership, product thinking, and people leadership. You’ll stay close to the work—contributing to technical design and implementation, navigating difficult engineering decisions, and stepping in when deeper context or hands-on support is needed—while creating the conditions for a strong team to do its best work. We believe great engineering leaders are builders at heart. You can zoom out to understand strategy and product intent, then zoom back into the implementation when it matters. You bring clarity to ambiguity, raise the bar through example, and create momentum through trust, context, and shared ownership. The product reflects the team that builds it. This role shapes both. What You’ll Do Build and lead Cross-functional team on patient experience; set technical direction in a complex, evolving domain. Stay meaningfully hands-on through system design, code, reviews, prototyping, and solving difficult technical problems. Set technical direction and evolve architecture in a complex, rapidly developing product domain. Lead design discussions where product, engineering, data, and clinical considerations intersect. Own hard problems Help evolve Fullscript from transactional patient experiences toward a longitudinal, person-centric model of care. Build systems that bring together clinical data, behavioral signals, and real-world patient context. Make deliberate tradeoffs across speed, quality, reliability, safety, and trust. Bring structure and momentum to ambiguous problems without waiting for perfect information. Raise the bar Establish a high bar for technical and product quality through how you build, review, and make decisions. Create an environment that combines psychological safety with meaningful accountability. Develop engineers through coaching, pairing, feedback, technical debate, and hands-on collaboration. Continually challenge the team to ask: Are we solving the right problem? Is the experience worthy of the people who depend on us? Collaborate at scale Partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Data, and Engineering leaders across Fullscript. Influence broader technical direction as Care Mode and patient experiences become increasingly foundational to the Fullscript platform. Champion patient trust, practitioner workflows, and long-term system health in product and technical decisions. How We Expect You to Think We’re looking for a builder with high agency, strong judgment, and a fundamentally optimistic view of what technology can make possible. You: Default to action. When something is unclear, narrow the problem, propose a path, and move — then adjust with data. Enforce a high bar on reliability and trust: bug discipline, instrumentation, dogfooding. Quality is non-negotiable; so is shipping. Take ownership beyond the boundaries of your formal scope. Are comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving forward with incomplete information. Challenge direction thoughtfully when something doesn’t feel right—and help create a better path. Care about outcomes, not simply output. You’re equally comfortable asking “What should we build?” and “How should we build it?” What You Bring Significant experience building and leading software products end-to-end, from early concepts through iteration and operation at scale. Multiple years of engineering management experience, with a clear commitment to people leadership while remaining deeply technical and close to the work. A track record of owning difficult, non-obvious technical problems with meaningful product and user impact. Comfort moving between hands-on engineering and engineering leadership—sometimes within the same day. Strong technical judgment and an ability to communicate why a decision matters, not simply what should be built. Experience building and operating high-scale applications, with a strong appreciation for reliability, performance, maintainability, and user trust. Strong product instincts and the ability to connect engineering decisions to the experience they create for users. Strong signals for this role include: Deep experience building successful consumer-facing web and/or mobile products, where engagement, retention, usability, and product quality were central to the experience. Experience building consumer experiences that proactively give users a reason to return—through timely, relevant, personalized, or context-aware interactions that reduce effort and sustain engagement over time. Fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools, with strong judgment about how to use AI to explore options, challenge assumptions, accelerate implementation, and improve technical decision-making. Strong instincts around responsiveness, fast feedback loops, perceived performance, and the details that make software feel lightweight and intuitive. Experience designing for moments when users may be overwhelmed, disengaged, or uncertain about what to do next. Experience with React, React Native, Rails, GraphQL, Apollo. Specific technologies matter less than depth of technical thinking and craftsmanship. Bonus signals we value: Experience building products in regulated, safety-sensitive, or high-trust domains. A track record of raising quality bars, not simply increasing velocity. An ability to challenge people constructively and leave teams stronger and more energized as a result. How We Build We care deeply about craft, empathy, and trust. Our engineering values are captured in the Fullscript Developer Handbook. We believe complexity should be clarified rather than surfaced, technology should deepen human care rather than replace it, and great teams outperform lone heroes. This is an opportunity to help establish how Fullscript builds and engages patients on mobile. You’ll join an experienced team, strong product leadership, and the opportunity to shape the technical approach, product experience, and engineering practices that take it forward. It combines the scope and ambiguity of a new product with the resources and scale of an established company. About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity
The Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Growth & Expansion (ECSM) owns the full lifecycle of Fullscript's enterprise accounts — from onboarding through long-term account expansion. This role bridges the gap between Fullscript's platform and the complex needs of enterprise clients, but its primary mandate is growth: converting a single-department foothold into a multi-department, system-wide partnership. The ECSM builds and executes the strategic account plan that unlocks new specialties, service lines, and affiliated practices, working at the executive level to do it, while ensuring existing departments continue to realize and expand the value of the platform.
By leveraging a personalized, consultative, and strategic approach, the ECSM will help accounts align their operational goals with Fullscript's capabilities — ensuring immediate value from onboarding and continued, compounding growth across the account. The ECSM will be responsible for achieving key performance and expansion metrics, including prescribing practitioner growth, ordering patients, account-level revenue growth, and new departments/specialties activated.
What you'll do
Account Onboarding & Expansion Strategy
Design tailored onboarding strategies that address the unique needs of multi-location and multi-department organizations, ensuring consistent implementation across all locations
Map the account's full organizational structure — departments, service lines, and affiliated/member practices — to identify and prioritize the highest-value expansion targets beyond the initial contract
Build and execute a multi-year account growth plan that converts a single-department contract into a system-wide, multi-specialty partnership
Translate department-level pilot results into a business case for expansion, tailored to each new department or specialty's priorities
Executive Relationship Management & Account Growth
Position Fullscript's value, technology, and buyer needs to multiple stakeholders — including C-level executives, medical, finance, and operations — via virtual and in-person discovery meetings, training, and business reviews
Serve as the primary and trusted advisor for expansion conversations, building relationships with the executives, service line directors, and clinical leadership who control expansion into new specialties, departments, or affiliated practices
Monitor accounts for key milestones, such as platform adoption rates and revenue growth, to identify opportunities that deepen engagement, foster long-term partnerships, and position underutilized Fullscript features to increase value and revenue
Navigate complex, matrixed governance and procurement processes to secure buy-in and agreements for new departmental rollouts
Relationship Management, Enablement & Cross-Functional Execution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (executive, medical, marketing, support, and data teams) and external stakeholders to create shared goals, including increasing patient engagement, streamlining workflows, and driving platform usage
Coordinate training sessions for practitioners and staff, including live demos, walkthroughs, and ongoing education programs to ensure users understand and maximize the platform's value
Partner with clinical liaisons, marketing, and implementation teams to replicate successful playbooks into new specialties and departments within the same account
Assist with the integration of Fullscript into existing workflows, such as EHR systems, tooling, and catalog customization, while identifying opportunities for further efficiency
Pipeline Ownership, Reporting & Insights
Maintain a deep, current understanding of accounts in pipeline — timelines, progress, metrics, financial overview, challenges, and risk mitigation — alongside a clear, department-by-department expansion pipeline including stakeholder maps and revenue potential
Prepare and deliver regular executive-level updates and business reviews to internal leadership and account stakeholders, articulating value delivered to date and the case for expansion
Share product feedback from clients, troubleshoot issues, escalate product requests and bugs, and represent the account's broader network needs internally to shape Fullscript's approach to future enterprise growth
What you bring to the table
Customer-focused and strategic, with a strong ability to build and grow relationships with key stakeholders, including C-suite executives, service line directors, and multi-stakeholder buying committees
Proven experience managing and expanding complex enterprise accounts — as an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, or similar — with a demonstrated track record of growing a single-department or single-location contract into a multi-department, system-wide partnership
Understanding of the US medical systems, health system/MSO organizational structures, governance, and procurement processes, and an appreciation for integrative and functional medicine
Strategic account planning and stakeholder-mapping skills — this is a growth- and expansion-focused role, not solely a support/satisfaction-focused one
Proficiency in Fullscript's value proposition and platform, delivering client-focused solutions based on customer needs
Excellent listening, negotiation, executive communication, and presentation abilities
Strong verbal and written communication skills, and cross-functional orchestration skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multitasking environment where change is the norm
Proficiency in CRM and sales software, such as Salesforce and Gong, and strong analytical skills
What we can offer you
Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa, Toronto, or Calgary preferred for this role.
Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters
RRSP/401k match and competitive compensation packages to invest in your future
Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.
Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products

The Opportunity
Customer Support is one of the clearest ways practitioners and patients experience Fullscript. As we scale across more queues, channels, products, and customer needs, we need stronger workforce planning foundations to support service quality, operational efficiency, and a better agent experience.
We’re looking for a Workforce Management Manager to build the structure, discipline, and operating rhythm behind our WFM function.
This is a hands-on manager-level role for someone who has worked inside high-volume support or contact center environments and knows how to turn volume, handle time, staffing, shrinkage, service levels, routing, and scheduling constraints into clear operating plans.
You’ll assess our current workforce planning function, improve forecasting and capacity models, strengthen intraday operations, evaluate tooling, and help leaders make better decisions around coverage, hiring, routing, scheduling, and cost.
This role is not just about reporting on what happened. It’s about building the operating rhythm, models, tools, and trust that help Customer Support plan ahead instead of constantly reacting.
What you'll do
Assess Fullscript’s current WFM processes, tooling, reporting, and operating rhythms, then build a practical plan to mature the function.
Own forecasting and capacity planning across multiple support queues, channels, and workflows, including phone, chat, email, tickets, Tier 1, Tier 2, and operational support teams.
Turn data from CRMs, WFM tools, and support platforms into staffing recommendations, hiring plans, training timelines, schedules, and coverage strategies.
Build staffing models that account for contact volume, order volume, handle time, shrinkage, PTO, training, ramp time, service levels, occupancy, wait times, and abandonment risk.
Partner with Support, Finance, Recruiting, Training, Product, Data, and operational leaders to align staffing plans with business priorities and customer experience goals.
Design and improve scheduling practices across shifts, PTO/vacation planning, training blocks, offline work, and intraday coverage needs.
Establish intraday management processes, including queue monitoring, reforecasting, staffing adjustments, escalation paths, and real-time decision-making.
Evaluate and improve routing strategies across phone, chat, email, and ticket queues, including skill-based routing, queue prioritization, load balancing, and dynamic staffing allocation.
Build dashboards, documentation, and operating cadences that make WFM planning more consistent, visible, and trusted.
Use data to influence decisions, defend recommendations, and clearly explain the operational impact when recommendations are delayed or not approved.
What you bring to the table
5+ years of experience in customer support, contact center operations, workforce management, capacity planning, or support operations, ideally with progression from a call center environment into WFM.
2+ years in a lead, manager, or functional owner role focused on workforce management, real-time operations, scheduling, or capacity planning.
Hands-on experience with WFM tools such as Assembled, Playvox, Verint, NICE/IEX, Calabrio, Tymeshift, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, intraday management, shrinkage, occupancy, utilization, service levels, adherence, wait times, and abandoned calls.
Experience with interval-level staffing models, queue-based planning, real-time workforce management, or Erlang C.
Ability to turn volume, productivity, service-level, and cost data into staffing models, hiring plans, scheduling recommendations, and clear operational tradeoffs.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to influence stakeholders, push back when needed, and defend recommendations with data.
Comfort operating independently in a hands-on builder role. You can roll with ambiguity, identify gaps, build the process, and keep the function moving without a large team around you.

Experience with CRM or support tools such as Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Amazon Connect, Talkdesk, Five9, or similar systems.
Experience designing advanced routing strategies across phone, chat, email, ticketing, and proactive outbound workflows.
Experience supporting specialized or back-office queues such as escalations, order operations, labs operations, or other non-frontline workflows.
Experience partnering with Finance on workforce economics, cost-to-serve, headcount planning, budget tradeoffs, or staffing investment cases.

About Intouch Insight  
  Intouch Insight has been helping multi-location brands across North America turn customer feedback and operational data into action since 1992. We've built our reputation on our range of customer experience measurement services and software products, which are trusted by hundreds of North America's most-loved brands, including well-known names in restaurants, retail, grocery and convenience.  
   
  The opportunity  
  We are looking for a  Customer Success Manager (CSM)  to join our team.  As a CSM, you show our clients Customer Experience done right, by guiding them through the process of onboarding, implementation, training, and on-going adoption of our services and product suite.  As part of the Operations team, you work collaboratively across the organization to ensure on-time delivery of programs.   
   
  A hands-on approach will enable you to work confidently within our coast-to-coast team, learning about an ever-developing suite of products, and translating that knowledge to consistently provide real customer value.  
   
   Responsibilities and Duties   
  Overall Responsibilities:  
 
  Own the customer relationship post sales  
  Develop a trusted advisor relationship with customers  
  Provide appropriate business outcomes to ensure the achievement of customer goals   
  Ensure customers receive value through business insights not just data  
  Act as a customer advocate within the company and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to ensure customer retention and customer success  
  Appropriate level of client engagement as per Intouch’s client classification  
  Manage Hubspot as appropriate  
  Effectively manage monthly customer invoicing in a timely manner  
  Forecast customer volumes and track monthly project achievements.   
  Complete contract renewals, as applicable  
  Proficiency in market research principles and concepts  
 
     
  Customer Intake:  
 
  Complete full range of onboarding functions and duties   
  Complete presentations and trainings of our product suite  
  Collaborate with the customer and internal team in development of market research questionnaires using market research best practices  
  Maintain and own project timelines  
  Determine client reporting needs and assist in creating custom dashboards and reports as needed  
 
     
  Ongoing Customer Journey:  
 
  Educate customers on continuous platform improvements   
  Promote cross-platform usage of products to find opportunities for upsell/cross sell  
  Increase revenue of current client portfolio  
  Other duties as appropriate to represent our Vision, fulfill our Mission, and live by our Values and guiding principles.  
 
     
   Qualifications, Skills & Attitudes:   
 
  Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience  
  A minimum of 3+ years of experience in Customer Success Management, Client Management or Project Management  
  Detail-oriented and demonstrated commitment to high-quality output  
  Demonstrated ability to proactively contribute value in a team environment.

 Intouch Insight provides some of North America’s top brands with actionable insights into their customers’ experiences and helps them achieve operational excellence while earning customer loyalty and improving business outcomes.

  Your responsibilities  
 As a Data Analyst at Intouch Insight, you’ll use your skill and experience to identify, analyze and interpret results and trends to provide insights for our clients. You will plan and create reports/presentations and work with our Customer Success and Sales team to communicate findings to our clients and prospects. You will also be invited to review clients’ customer experience objectives and work with our internal teams to determine the best way to deliver high quality data (strategy, processes, tools) that meet our clients’ expectations.  2 years of relevant experience in a data analysis role, with proven analytical and research skills.

 Ability to write, explain and present analysis clearly and concisely to internal and external stakeholders. 
 Ability to generate business-relevant insights from raw data, with or without the usage of AI. 
 Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint. 
 Knowledge of statistical principles (ex. correlation, regression, statistical significance, etc.) and experience using BI Tools (especially Tableau) to analyze datasets. 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. French skills are an asset. 
 Ability to perform data cleansing, wrangling and validation. 
 Foundational skills with AI on generation of insights, presentations and charts. 
 Familiarity with Python (data analysis, Pandas, scikit-learn, JSON) is an asset. 
 
   
  Qualifications  
 
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field is preferable, but relevant experience in lieu will be considered. 
 Experience in the CX industry and/or Marketing Studies is an asset. 
 Data analysis/science-related certifications are an asset. 
 
   
 Pay range - $60,000-$70,000 per year

The Role

We're looking for a Sales Manager to lead and energize a small sales team. This is a player-coach role: part of your week will be spent coaching, motivating, and removing roadblocks for your reps, and part of it may be spent directly securing and managing a book of house accounts.

We are a lean, tight-knit team where everyone's contribution is visible and you will thrive here if you are hands-on by nature, energized by daily sales activity, and good at bringing out the best in a small, nimble team. We sell across the mid-market and enterprise levels, leveraging both inbound and outbound strategies. If you like being close to the action - coaching reps one day, jumping on a client call the next - this is your kind of place.

What You'll Do

• Lead, coach, and motivate a small team of sales reps - running regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and call-coaching to build skill and energy and to ensure continuous improvement of key sales metrics (eg close rates).

• Set the tone for the team day to day: hands-on, energetic, and engaged rather than purely strategic or hierarchical.

• Take responsibility for the delivery of the sales department’s quota.

• Professionally respond to RFI’s and RFP’s as required to secure new business

• Take responsibility for the management of house accounts as required.

• Own team-level pipeline health and forecasting and be responsible for the accurate and timely reporting of sales team KPI’s to leadership.

• Help recruit, onboard, and ramp-up new sales reps as the team grows.

• Work closely with marketing, customer success, and product teams to ensure a smooth client hand-off and ensure successful ongoing execution.

• Identify and act on opportunities to improve the sales process, tools, and messaging.

• Jump in on deals directly when needed - helping to close, unblocking a stuck opportunity, or covering for a rep.

• Leverage technology to drive the efficiency and effectiveness of our sales process, utilizing the latest in AI tooling to improve our team’s performance.

•

What We're Looking For

• 3–6+ years of B2B sales experience, with some team leadership or mentorship experience.

• A genuine hands-on style - you'd rather be in the field, on calls, and writing RFP responses than buried in strategy decks.

• Experience motivating and developing a remote team; you know how to keep energy and accountability high without heavy process.

• Comfortable carrying some individual sales responsibility yourself, alongside managing others.

• Ability to travel if/as required to support sales team, prospects and clients.

• Experience in market research, customer experience measurement, SaaS, or a related B2B services space is an asset.

• Strength in utilizing technologies including Microsoft product suite, CRM tools, and emerging AI tools.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

• Excellent communication skills and a natural relationship-builder, both with clients and with your team.

• The ability to work one day of the week in the Kanata Office would be an asset.

•

Compensation

• Base salary of 120k-130k, plus a variable compensation package tied to performance.

Why Intouch Insight

• An entrepreneurial and collaborative environment where your impact is visible and immediate.

• The chance to shape how a sales team operates, rather than inheriting a rigid playbook.

• Work with recognizable, established brands across North America.

Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. 
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview
Are you passionate about security, compliance, and supporting mission-critical work? We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Facilities Security Officer (FSO) to lead and maintain our government security clearance programs. 
In this role, you will serve as the primary administrator of the company's Facility Clearance (FCL) and personnel security clearance program, helping ensure our continued ability to perform classified work for Government customers. You will also play a critical role in managing compliance with Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) requirements, supporting facility clearance eligibility, government reporting obligations, and mitigation activities. You'll partner with employees, leadership, government representatives, and cross-functional teams to maintain compliance, support cleared personnel and strengthen our overall security posture. 
NOTE: Candidate must reside in Virginia. 

Compensation & Benefits
The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. $80,000 - $130,000 USD

- Generous time off policies 
- Competitive compensation 
- Volunteer opportunities  
- Reward and recognition programs   
- Employee committees & resource groups  
- Healthcare and retirement benefits 
 
Indicators of Success 
 
We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
 
How We Work
 
At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
 
We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
 
The Most Important Thing
 
We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: 
 
CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. 
OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. 
DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. 
EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
 
Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

Role OverviewWe’re looking for a seasoned Front-End Architect who thrives on technical depth and broad influence. You’re as comfortable designing architecture as you are shipping code, and you care deeply about developer experience, scalability, and performance. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale.
As a Front-End Architect, you’ll help shape the foundation of how all our SaaS products are built and experienced. Our goal is to enable product teams to deliver faster, safer, and more consistent customer experiences, and you’ll play an instrumental role in that journey. You’ll collaborate with Senior Engineers, Product Managers, and UX Designers to create a cohesive frontend platform that unites multiple SaaS products into a single, scalable application.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role: Part Architect, Part Builder, and Part Mentor. You’ll lead by example, designing reusable UI frameworks, modernizing legacy codebases, and guiding engineering teams toward better patterns, tooling, and practices.
Why You’ll Love This Role? 
You’ll have outsized impact. The work you do will unlock speed and consistency across multiple SaaS products, laying the groundwork for our next-generation unified platform.
You’ll solve meaningful technical challenges. From platform architecture to developer experience, you’ll tackle problems that blend scale, complexity, and usability.
You’ll join a culture that values autonomy and trust. We empower experienced engineers to make decisions, move quickly, and see their work make a measurable difference. No ivory towers.

## Role overview

This role combines end‑to‑end Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP)) leadership with advanced strategic procurement for March Networks & Vivotek hardware. The director is accountable for aligning demand, supply, and financial plans while building and managing a world‑class supply base that enables successful product hardware build strategies with our global Contract Manufacturing partners, including Delta and Sanmina.

## Key responsibilities

## S&OP / IBP ownership

• Architect, implement, and continuously improve the S&OP / IBP framework, calendar, and governance across Sales, Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

• Define the S&OP key metrics including, standard templates, KPIs, and RACI to ensure a disciplined, repeatable process.

• Lead monthly demand, supply, and executive S&OP reviews; ensure decisions are translated into MPS/MRP, capacity plans, and commercial commitments.

• Integrate demand forecasts, supply plans, and financial plans to deliver revenue, service level, and inventory objectives while managing risk for both March Networks and Vivotek demand (SSS LOB)

• Benchmark and embed best practices, tools, and analytics to support scenario planning and decision quality.

## Demand, supply, and inventory planning

• Lead development of a consensus demand plan by integrating sales input from March and Vivotek sales regions, market intelligence, and statistical forecasts, including NPI demand.

• Oversee forecasting methodologies, forecast accuracy and metrics, and demand risk/opportunity management.

• Lead Operations / Supply Chain to translate demand into capacity, supply, and inventory plans that meet service and working capital targets.

• Lead scenario planning for upside/downside demand, component constraints, customer priorities, inventory investment, and revenue recovery strategies

## Strategic Procurement for SSS LOB

• Provide advanced procurement leadership to the Hardware Engineering organization throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept through volume production for Taipei, Poland, Milan and Ottawa design teams

• Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships across key hardware commodities, including Memory/SOC/ICs/processors, PCBs, connectors, fans, and electro‑mechanical components.

• Lead enterprise supply risk management including geopolitical, sanctions, tariff, lifecycle, allocation, and single-source component risks while developing mitigation strategies.

• Act as the primary business interface between supply partners, Hardware Engineering, Product Line Management, and Operations.

• Lead component price negotiations and manage commercial release milestones to meet build schedules, cost, and margin objectives.

• Evaluate supplier capability, reliability, capacity, financial health, and cost competitiveness to support both NPI and long‑term supply strategies.

## Contract Manufacture and Outsourcing

• Supports global contract manufacturing partners, including Delta, Sanmina, and future partners across North America, Europe, and Asia.

• Drive and negotiate cost model negotiations with existing and new outsource partners to maximize the SSS LOB’s margin contribution.

• Supports global third-party and outsourced logistics locations for inventory management, configuration capabilities, and direct order fulfillment, including inbound, outbound, and intercompany shipment logistics.

• In collaboration with the Technical Operations team, engages contract manufacturers early and formally in DFM/DFA by conducting joint design reviews, BOM rationalization, and component risk assessments to ensure manufacturability, test strategy, and lifecycle/obsolescence considerations are built in.

• Manages a rolling 6–12-month forecast, including fixed, flex, and forecast windows, with MPS/MRP visibility and clear rules for expedites, reschedules, and minimum order quantities to stabilize planning and ensure supply continuity.

• Manages raw material risk and liability exposure by leveraging Kinaxis to provide visibility into work orders, WIP, purchase orders, and inventory, reconciled against demand.

## BOM analysis, risk, and lifecycle management

• Drive component portfolio rationalization across all 4 design teams to reduce the number of suppliers and components being supported.

• Perform in‑depth Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis to inform S&OP and procurement decisions, including long lead‑time risk and early‑purchase strategies.

• Drive end‑of‑life (EOL) component analysis, Product Change Notification (PCN) reviews, and dual‑sourcing strategies to protect continuity of supply.

• Assess manufacturing cost structures for NPI designs and provide component‑level and finished‑goods cost models to Product Line Management and Finance.

• Serve as the point of escalation for material shortages impacting builds, pilot runs, and volume product builds, coordinating mitigation across planning, engineering, and suppliers.

## Commercial and contractual leadership

• Lead procurement contract, NDA, and commercial term negotiations with key suppliers in alignment with corporate policies and risk appetite.

• Conduct business and financial reviews of potential and existing suppliers to support sourcing decisions and S&OP risk reviews.

• Manage pricing updates and verification for Engineering, Product Line Management, and Finance to ensure alignment of standard costs with S&OP assumptions and financial plans.

## Executive engagement and change leadership

• Present S&OP outcomes, supply risks, procurement strategies, and scenario analyses to executive leadership, driving data‑driven decisions.

• Champion cross‑functional alignment between Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Procurement, resolving conflicts and enforcing accountability for inputs and actions.

• Lead change management to elevate S&OP and strategic sourcing maturity, including process improvements, tool adoption, and capability building across the organization.

• Participate in Product Line readiness and gate reviews, clearly articulating status, risks, mitigation plans, and commercial implications.

## Performance management and governance

• Define and monitor KPIs spanning both domains: forecast accuracy and bias, OTIF, inventory turns, capacity utilization, material availability, NPI launch readiness, cost variance, and savings.

• Ensure that S&OP decisions and sourcing strategies are reflected in ERP/APS data, material masters, and procurement records.

• Drive continuous improvement in planning, sourcing, and NPI commercialization, quantifying financial and operational benefits (e.g., reduced expedites, improved fill rates, lower obsolescence, better margins).

## Qualifications and experience

• 10+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or procurement in the high‑tech / networking or electronics industry, including strategic sourcing and supplier management.

• 5+ years of direct experience leading S&OP/IBP or integrated demand/supply planning processes, ideally in a hardware or systems environment.

• Hands‑on experience with NPI processes and BOM analysis, including cost modeling, lifecycle/risk assessment, and supplier selection.

• Demonstrated success negotiating complex commercial agreements, including pricing, contracts, and NDAs with semiconductor and electronics suppliers.

• Strong understanding of MRP/MPS, capacity planning, and inventory management, and how they connect to S&OP and financial planning.

• Proficiency with ERP and planning systems (e.g., SAP or similar), sourcing tools, and advanced Excel/analytics; experience with product lifecycle or Agile/PLM systems is an asset.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership skills; proven ability to influence cross‑functional stakeholders and executives and to drive decisions under time pressure.

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including financial analysis, scenario modeling, and supply risk mitigation.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; Master’s degree is an asset.

## Personal attributes

• Strategic, systems thinker who can connect commercial, technical, and operational decisions end‑to‑end.

• Highly collaborative and team‑oriented, with the presence to lead cross‑functional forums and executive reviews.

• Comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, ambiguous environment with multiple concurrent NPI programs and evolving customer demand.

• Results‑driven with a focus on disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and measurable impact on revenue, margin, and service.

VICE PRESIDENT, PROFESSIONAL SERVICES
Job Description

At March Networks, our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you will enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. You will be part of a growing global technology company that encourages teamwork and innovation, and where friendships are forged with colleagues all over the world. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

Reporting directly to the CEO and President, the Vice President of Professional Services is responsible for leading, scaling, and continuously improving the end-to-end post-sales services organization for the Smart Security Solutions LOB (March Networks and Vivotek), including Professional Services, Technical Support, Network Operations Center (NOC), Cloud Services, Customer Success, Training, and Implementation. This executive will own the operating model, service delivery governance, technical enablement strategy, and financial performance of the services organization, ensuring that customer deployments, managed services, support operations, and adoption programs are delivered with high quality, predictability, and profitability.

The Vice President of Professional Services will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, recurring revenue retention, and business growth by evolving service delivery models, standardizing implementation and support processes, improving resource utilization, and embedding automation, analytics, and AI into the service lifecycle. This leader must also have demonstrated success leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones, establishing common operating standards, escalation frameworks, service-level accountability, and a cohesive culture while ensuring consistent execution and customer outcomes worldwide.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic, data-driven, and AI-enabled leader with deep experience transforming complex service organizations in SaaS, cloud, intelligent edge, IoT, or enterprise technology environments. This individual combines strong commercial judgment, technical fluency, operational discipline, and customer-centric leadership, and can align delivery excellence with strategic business objectives, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

## Key Responsibilities

## Strategic Leadership

• Develop and execute a multi-year services strategy and operating roadmap that advances the organization from reactive execution to standardized, metrics-driven, outcome-based delivery aligned with corporate growth objectives.

• Define the target operating model across Professional Services, Support, NOC, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and Training, including service catalog, engagement models, escalation paths, and ownership boundaries across the customer lifecycle.

• Lead the incorporation of AI, workflow automation, knowledge management, and analytics into core service motions such as case deflection, triage, onboarding, project delivery, health scoring, and incident response to improve efficiency, predictability, and customer experience.

• Partner with Product Management, R&D, IT, Security, and Sales leadership to ensure that product roadmap priorities, for serviceability, and ease of deployment architecture, as well as supportability requirements are reflected in both R&D commitments and execution.

## Operational Excellence

• Oversee the end-to-end delivery of all professional services engagements, implementation programs, onboarding activities, support operations, cloud service processes, and managed services commitments, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, in compliance with contractual obligations, and at target gross margin.

• Establish and enforce delivery governance mechanisms including stage gates, project reviews, technical design reviews, resource management disciplines, and executive escalation processes for high-impact strategic customer programs.

• Build scalable, repeatable delivery methodologies, statements of work, implementation playbooks, support runbooks, and training frameworks that increase scalability, improve quality, and shorten time-to-service.

• Automate ticket management, incident response, root-cause analysis, service restoration, and problem management disciplines, including clear ownership of SLA attainment, backlog aging, response times, and resolution times.

• Implement service performance dashboards and operating cadences that provide visibility into bookings, backlog, capacity, utilization, project margin, support case trends, renewal risk, and customer health.

## Financial Management

• Own services P&L performance, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, utilization, headcount productivity, subcontractor spend, and cost-to-serve.

• Develop robust forecasting, budgeting, and reporting frameworks for bookings, revenue recognition readiness, delivery backlog, staffing demand, and margin performance, enabling proactive business decisions and resource balancing.

• Lead disciplined change-order and scope-governance processes to ensure that out-of-scope work is identified early, documented, approved, priced appropriately, and converted into profitable revenue.

## Organizational Design

• Continuously evolve the organizational structure, role clarity, spans and layers, and regional coverage model across Customer Success, Technical Support, Managed Services, Cloud Operations, and Technical Training to support growth, specialization, and scalability.

• Create standardized operating procedures, knowledge transfer models, and tooling strategies across regions to ensure globally consistent execution between March Networks and Vivotek support staff.

• Work cross-functionally with R&D, Product Management, and IT to improve serviceability, observability, deployment automation, release readiness, and support transition processes, outlining a clear vision for transforming the current services and platform offering into a differentiated, scalable, and efficient operating model.

## Client, Partner Engagement & Vendor Management

• Serve as an executive sponsor and escalation point for strategic customers and complex deployments, building trusted relationships that support adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term account value.

• Partner closely with the Sales organization to strengthen the positioning, packaging, and attach rate of value-added services, recurring support, software, and managed offerings, while ensuring sold engagements are technically sound, commercially viable, and operationally deliverable.

• Optimize customer lifecycle motions across onboarding, implementation, adoption, support, training, and renewal readiness to improve customer outcomes and reduce churn risk. Common SaaS customer success metrics used to manage this include churn, retention, NPS, CSAT, CES, and customer health scoring.

• Manage strategic outsourcing, subcontracting, and service delivery partners, including partner selection, commercial terms, delivery governance, performance management, and compliance with quality and timeline expectations.

## Qualifications

## Education

Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. MBA or other advanced business or technical degree preferred.

## Experience

• Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in professional services, technical services, consulting, customer success, support operations, or managed services within the software, SaaS, cloud, IoT, or enterprise technology sector.

• At least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing complex, multi-function services organizations with global or multi-regional teams.

• Proven track record of transforming service delivery organizations to improve scalability, utilization, delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

• Strong experience with cloud operations, SaaS delivery models, subscription-based customer lifecycle management, and post-sales operating metrics.

• Demonstrated expertise in resource planning, backlog management, utilization management, project margin control, forecasting, and services financial management.

• Experience implementing or optimizing customer success programs, onboarding models, adoption frameworks, and retention strategies using measurable KPIs such as churn, retention, NPS, CSAT, CES, and health scores.

• Familiarity with AI, workflow automation, analytics, and knowledge-centered service strategies that improve support efficiency, delivery quality, and customer experience.

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with R&D, Product Management, IT, Security, Sales, and Finance.

• Experience managing third-party service providers, subcontractors, and global delivery models with clear governance and quality controls.

• Outstanding executive communication, stakeholder management, change leadership, and people development capabilities.

## Preferred Technical and Domain Experience

• Experience in intelligent video, video management systems, cloud video platforms, physical security, IoT-connected devices, edge-to-cloud architectures, or enterprise loss prevention technologies is highly desirable.

• Experience with service organizations supporting hybrid environments that include hardware, firmware, software, SaaS, networking, and cybersecurity considerations is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with service management, CRM, and professional services automation platforms such as Salesforce, Service Cloud, Jira, ServiceNow, ConnectWise, Certinia/PSA, or equivalent tooling is an asset.

• Knowledge of ITIL-based support operations, incident/problem/change management, observability practices, and SLA-driven managed services environments is preferred.

o Familiarity with software lifecycle tools.

o Hands-on experience with release management processes for multi-application environments.

Principal Advanced Optical Packaging Engineer
Location: Ottawa, Ontario | Type: Full-time

The Opportunity
Ranovus is seeking a Principal Advanced Optical Packaging Engineer to develop and industrialize packaging technologies for next-generation optical engines used in AI and data-center connectivity. This hands-on role covers package/process architecture, flip-chip and BGA assembly, hybrid laser integration, fiber attach, optical alignment, thermal-mechanical risk management, burn-in, tooling, automation, and manufacturing transfer. Working directly with design teams, equipment developers, suppliers, CMs, and OSAT partners.

What You Will Own

• Package & Process Architecture: Translate product requirements into packaging/assembly strategies; define build sequences, inspection points, rework, and test gates; lead DFM/DFA/DFT/DFR reviews; identify risks and drive DOEs/qualification.

• Flip-Chip, Die Attach & Electrical Integration: Develop/qualify flip-chip and fine-pitch die-attach processes (copper-pillar, BGA, LGA, WLCSP); define reflow, solder paste, flux, and cleaning approaches; manage warpage, CTE mismatch, and voiding; develop underfill/encapsulation processes; define AOI, X-ray, and cross-section inspection methods.

• Laser Packaging & Hybrid Integration: Lead hybrid laser-to-carrier and laser-to-ePIC assembly process development; work with laser die, lenses, isolators, and couplers; define alignment, attachment, and burn-in/test flows; manage supplier specs for laser components.

• Fiber Attach & Optical I/O: Develop repeatable fiber-array attach processes (single-mode, PM fiber, multi-fiber arrays); define alignment strategy, adhesive/cure processes, and loss-control methods; support automated fiber-attach station development (motion, vision, dispensation, calibration).

• Thermal-Mechanical & Materials: Evaluate thermal paths and manage package stress/warpage/CTE mismatch; select and qualify solders, underfills, adhesives, TIMs, and encapsulants; partner with mechanical/simulation specialists.

• NPI & Manufacturing Transfer: Lead processes from POC through NPI, qualification, and production ramp; define tooling, SOPs, PFMEAs, and control plans; drive root-cause/corrective action; decide what stays in-house vs. transfers to partners

• Required Experience

• 10+ years in advanced optical packaging, photonic packaging, optoelectronic assembly, semiconductor packaging, or precision micro-assembly.

• Demonstrated ownership of packaging processes from development through NPI/production transfer.

• Hands-on experience in several flip-chip bonding, fine-pitch die attach, copper-pillar/solder-bump interconnect, BGA/LGA assembly, substrate/interposer integration, laser die/subassembly packaging, fiber-array attach, active/passive optical alignment, underfill/encapsulation/adhesive processes.

• Strong grasp of how optical, mechanical, thermal, electrical, material, and manufacturing requirements interact in an optoelectronic package.

• Practical knowledge of soldering, wetting, flux, intermetallics, surface finishes, underfill, adhesives, curing, and contamination control.

• Experience with DOEs, process characterization, qualification builds, and failure analysis.

• Experience defining process windows, inspection criteria, and manufacturing controls.

• Ability to distinguish lab demonstrations from robust, transferable manufacturing processes.

• Experience with external manufacturing partners, equipment suppliers, or component vendors.

• Strong technical judgment and communication skills.

Particularly Valuable Experience

• Laser/laser-array/hybrid laser-photonic subassembly packaging; co-packaged or external laser sources.

• Single-mode edge coupling, lensed coupling, mode-field conversion, isolators, turning optics.

stem Architect Verification Engineer

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

ABOUT RANOVUS

Ranovus is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, developing next-generation co-packaged optics (CPO) solutions for AI and data center interconnects. Our Odin optical engine integrates a Quantum Dot Multi-Wavelength Laser, Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC), and ASIC into a single co-packaged module – delivering the performance and density required by hyperscale AI infrastructure.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The System Architect Verification engineer develops and runs behavioral simulations and control verification tests for the optical engine (OE). Working in System Verilog and RTL, you will validate control algorithm, bring-up sequences, and link training algorithms before silicon is available – ensuring firmware and ASIC logic are correct before the first chip arrives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and maintain System Verilog behavioral models of PIC, ASIC, and Laser subsystems for pre-silicon system simulation.

• Build and run control verification testbenches: mission mode, bring-up sequences, link training, OE calibration, and fault recovery state machines.

• Verify closed-loop (feedback) control algorithms used to calibrate and stabilize PIC components, such as bias and wavelength locking loops.

• Perform RTL-level verification of ASIC control blocks in collaboration with the ASIC team.

• Develop and maintain regression environments for control algorithm and bring-up validation.

• Run corner case simulations across PVT (process, voltage, temperature) conditions and aging scenarios.

• Correlate simulation results against lab measurements to validate model accuracy.

• Support pre-silicon firmware validation in collaboration with the FW team.

• Extend the system simulation environment as new blocks and features are added.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• S. in Electrical Engineering or related field with 6+ years of experience, or Ph.D. with 3+ years of experience, in digital or mixed-signal verification using SystemVerilog.

• Familiarity with RTL simulation tools.

• Understanding of closed-loop (feedback) control concepts for controlling PIC components (e.g., bias/wavelength locking control loops) and hardware bring-up sequencing.

• Basic understanding of optical/photonic components such as micro-ring modulators (MRM), photodetectors, and similar devices.

• Python or MATLAB for scripting, data analysis, and regression automation.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Verilog-A or Verilog-AMS for modeling analog or optical components.

• Experience with optical or photonic system simulation.

• Familiarity with SPICE or mixed-signal analog simulation.

• Understanding of PAM4 link behavior and BER analysis.

• Exposure to SerDes or high-speed interface IP verification.

当社は、車載・民生・産業用途向けに、マイコン、SoC、アナログ、パワー製品など幅広い半導体製品を製造しています。AI・自動車・産業機器など、多様な市場に対して革新的な半導体ソリューションをグローバルに提供しており、世界の技術発展を支える重要な役割を担っています。

We are looking for a talented Snr Staff Digital Design Engineer with a BSc/MSc in Electrical/Computer Engineering (EE/ECE) and industry experience of 10 plus years. Successful candidate will be reporting to the Snr Manager of Design Engineering.  Our team works on the most advanced digital power management ICs in the industry. Job Duties: 
- Develop, debug, and verify digital designs in pre and post silicon environment 
- Write tests to verify bulk design intent as per specification. 
- Learn, develop and improve scripts to facilitate design automation flows. 
- Manage assigned design blocks in design requirements, architecture, and implementation 
- Research and present new tools in aid of design development process 
- Act as technical mentor for junior engineers. 
- Represent digital design as functional digital design lead in design projects.   - BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering (EE/ECE) and 10+ years of relevant industry experience 
- Prior design project work experience showing collaborative and innovative thinking 
- Proficient in developing CDC / RDC / LINT clean designs in Verilog 
- Comfortable with debugging mixed-signal designs in System Verilog based test benches 
- Exposed to gate level simulation debug. 
- Experience in designing industry standard serial interfaces (I2C, I3C, SPI, I2S etc) 
- Strong analytical skills and debug methodology 
- Good written and verbal communications skills 
- Working experience with Cadence or Synopsys design tool flows. 
- Hands-on technical leadership role resulting in successful projects.  Preferred skills: 
- Proficient in scripting languages such as Python/Perl 
- Knowledge of ARM cortex M-series processor and computer architecture in general. 
- Exposure to mixed signal designs w/ basic understanding of analog circuits. 
- Experience in digital backend design flow (synthesis / STA / P&R) 
- Full design flow experience (specification, micro-architecture, RTL implementation, backend implementation).   The expected annual pay range for this position is €61,000–€82,000.  Background of Recruitment  
We need to integrate the demand management system into one system. This new forecast management system is a web system that we are developing on our own. We are in need of a person who can support a series of tasks such as system requirement definition, development, testing, user testing, etc., as well as system maintenance and operation. 
 
 Job Responsibilities  
- Project management (requirement definition, development, testing, user testing, etc.) of the demand planning management system, which is our area of responsibility in the overall system integration project. 
- In particular, since the forecast management of Japanese distributors will change significantly, we have to serve as a window person with Renesas sales company members and coordinate various requests, developments, etc. 
- Requirement definition :  
 Coordinate with business members of the Renesas Group who are managing forecst (mainly US members, so business English conversation skills are required) and summarize the system requirements. 
- Development, testing :  
 Communicate the system requirement definition to the development vendor, and conduct system review and user acceptance testing after development is completed. This includes technical work with the development vendor (SQL, Java, Wijimo, etc.). (SQL, Java and Wijimo, etc.) 
- System maintenance & Operations : 
  Requiement for improvement from business users in forecast system operation, improvement activities for stable system operation, etc. 
- The Demand Management System requires close system integration with the SCM Planning System, so we have to develop and operate in collaboration with each other.   ・Strong communication skills (e.g., you can ask questions without hesitation, you  regularly reports and consults with their superiors ). 
・Experience in a series of operations such as demand management to production planning for about a few or more years. 
・Experience with SQL DB operations and web system development languages (Java, etc.) 
・Intermediate level ( or more ) of Business English (ability to participate in discussions in English)

As an AI Compiler Engineer on the Renesas HPC team, you will be responsible for driving compiler and code generation technologies that unlock the full compute potential of Renesas next-generation automotive System-on-Chip platforms, including advanced 3 nm silicon for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Your work will directly impact how AI workloads — from perception and sensor fusion to in-vehicle assistants and advanced driver assistance — are translated into highly optimized, safe, and power-efficient execution on Renesas hardware. 
This role bridges software compiler development, AI model lowering/optimization, and hardware-software co-design, enabling Renesas SoCs to deliver industry-competitive performance, efficiency, and functional safety required by multi-domain automotive applications.. 
 
【Job Description】 
・Lead AI compiler architecture across model ingestion, graph optimization, lowering, code generation, and runtime integration 
・Design and implement graph‑level optimizations (operator fusion, quantization‑aware rewrites, memory‑aware scheduling, partitioning) 
・Drive performance optimization for target NPUs, including tiling, tensor layout, and multi‑core execution strategies 
・Partner with SoC and AI accelerator architects to influence hardware features through compiler insights 
・Own performance KPIs for real automotive AI workloads using simulators, profilers, and silicon‑correlated models 
・Ensure compiler outputs meet automotive requirements (real‑time behavior, determinism, quality expectations) 
・Mentor senior engineers and set technical direction without people‑management responsibilities  【Impact & Differentiators】 
Renesas’ Gen5 R-Car automotive SoC lineup, including flagship 3 nm devices like the R-Car X5H, is among the first highly integrated multi-domain automotive SoCs built on advanced 3 nm process technology, designed to run ADAS, IVI, gateway, and next-gen SDV workloads on a centralized platform. These platforms deliver high AI performance (e.g., multi-hundreds of TOPS), scalable chiplet-based acceleration, and power efficiency tailored for electrified and autonomous vehicles while meeting stringent functional safety standards.  An AI Compiler Engineer enables this hardware vision by ensuring that state-of-the-art AI models and computational kernels are efficiently mapped to the silicon fabric — directly enhancing performance, reducing latency and energy, and accelerating software adoption in automotive ecosystems where compute efficiency and safety are paramount.   【Must-Have】 
・MS/PhD (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, EE, or related field 
・Deep experience building AI compilers, accelerator backends, or graph optimization frameworks 
・Strong expertise in graph optimization and performance optimization for NPUs or custom accelerators 
・Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TVM‑like systems, or proprietary compiler IRs 
・Excellent C/C++ and Python skills 
・Solid understanding of AI inference workloads (CNNs, transformers, perception or generative models) 
・Strong communication skills are required, e.g. agile development experience in Scrum team (Product Owner or Scrum Master) 
 
【Nice-to-Have】 
・Experience with automotive or safety‑critical systems 
・Background in heterogeneous SoCs (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU)

Strong executive communication and presentation skills.  Experience with documentation and reporting tools such as Jira / Confluence, Power BI, or similar is a plus. Some markets you join. This one you help build.  AI compute is outgrowing the ground. As GPU and AI-class systems move into space and other demanding high-reliability settings, the power electronics that feed them have to survive radiation, wide temperature swings, and years of operation with no chance of a service call, at volumes well beyond anything the space industry has produced before. Standard commercial-grade parts cannot meet that bar. Renesas can, and we are opening a new high-reliability (Hi-Rel) growth area to do it: radiation-cognizant power management built on our power portfolio and decades of Hi-Rel heritage.  We are looking for a Staff Business Development Specialist to lead the way into this market. This is a market-creation role, not a territory to maintain. You will find where the real opportunities are, build the customer base from the first conversation, and turn early technical engagements into design wins. You will sit across the table from the GPU and AI-silicon vendors, space-systems primes, and hyperscale operators defining this field, and you will work alongside our product, design, applications, and sales teams to turn those relationships into revenue. If you want your fingerprints on an industry while it is still taking shape, this is that job.  Responsibilities  In this role, you will:  • Identify, pursue, and capture new business in a market Renesas is entering for the first time, from first contact through design-in and production.  • Own senior technical and commercial relationships across the target accounts, from AI-silicon vendors to space-systems primes to hyperscale operators.  • Size the addressable and serviceable market, and build the go-to-market plan that prioritizes accounts, applications, and timing.  • Shape customer requirements early, respond to RFIs and RFPs, and lead proposal development in coordination with product and applications teams.  • Develop pricing and value strategy for radiation-cognizant solutions relative to commodity and fully rad-hard alternatives.  • Run competitive intelligence on incumbent power and Hi-Rel suppliers, and use it to sharpen positioning and roadmap input.  • Support executive reviews and corporate funding proposals with market data, revenue projections, and a defensible business case.  • Work cross-functionally with design, applications, product marketing, and regional sales to align the portfolio with customer needs and to drive design-ins to closure.   • 10 or more years in business development, strategic sales, or product marketing, in semiconductors, power management, aerospace and defense, or high-reliability and space markets.  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field. At Renesas, we are more than just a semiconductor company; we are the engine behind a "safer, smarter, and more sustainable" future. Headquartered locally in the heart of San Jose, our Silicon Valley team is at the forefront of innovation in Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT technologies. Joining our San Jose office means joining a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your work directly impacts the next generation of AI-driven infrastructure and green energy solutions.    We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Analog Engineer to join our Analog Design team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, simulation, verification, and development of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for automotive, industrial, and power management applications. This role requires strong technical expertise in analog circuit design, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary, global engineering teams.   Key Responsibilities     Circuit Design & Optimization: Perform transistor-level circuit design, simulation, and optimization for high-performance analog and mixed-signal blocks.       Block-Level Architecture: Design and develop precision references and bias circuits, operational amplifiers, comparators, LDO regulators, oscillators, timing circuits, data converter support circuits, and power management/isolation-related analog circuits.       Layout & Physical Design Support: Support IC floorplanning and work closely with layout engineers to ensure robust analog layout implementation.       Silicon Validation: Analyze silicon measurement results, conduct lab evaluation, and drive necessary design improvements.       Qualification & Reliability: Support product qualification, characterization, and reliability testing activities.       Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (or B.S. with equivalent, demonstrated technical expertise).    Technical Fundamentals: Deep understanding of CMOS device physics and analog circuit fundamentals.       EDA Tools: Hands-on experience with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, and standard circuit simulation tools.       Process & Reliability: Practical knowledge of semiconductor process technologies and reliability considerations.       Soft Skills: Excellent technical documentation skills, strong verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, global team environment.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with GaN (Gallium Nitride) device applications and driver design.       Experience with isolated IC design methodologies and high-voltage power management circuits.         The expected annual pay range for this position is $135,000 - $160,000. Renesas' Performance Core Power (PCP) Business Group is scaling its Custom AI Power product line — Power Modules, Digital Controllers, and Lateral Power Stages — to serve the compute infrastructure of the world's largest AI platform providers. Both the Business Group and the Custom AI Power product line are growing extremely fast. This organization is structured around dedicated Business Unit (BU) teams for each of the "Big 3" hyperscale/AI accelerator customers: AWS, Google, and NVIDIA.  We are hiring a Director to take full, end-to-end ownership of the business for one of these two currently open seats — AWS or NVIDIA. This is senior leadership role where the BU Leader is the general manager of the business for their customer - accountable for strategy, product roadmap, portfolio decisions, P&L health, while leading a cross-functional team.   What You'll Own    Business & Strategy Leadership    Serve as the single point of accountability for the AWS or NVIDIA business within Custom AI Power — strategy, roadmap, revenue/margin outcomes, and execution of the products already designed-in.  Build and maintain the multi-generation product roadmap (Modules, Digital Controllers, Lateral Power Stages) in direct alignment with the customer's roadmaps.  Portfolio management decisions — what to pursue, what to pass on, and how to sequence investment across competing opportunities.  Own the business case and investment justification for new product/program starts, partnering with Finance and the Custom AI Power Leader.  Set and defend priorities within centralized organization’s (design, operations, packaging, test, etc) resources to meet BU’s execution needs    Customer & Executive Engagement    Act as the primary business-level relationship owner with the customer's power, silicon, systems and business teams — building trust at the working level and up through their leadership.  Represent the voice of the customer internally, and represent Renesas' capabilities and roadmap externally, including at executive business reviews.  Lead pricing, forecasting, commercial and manufacturing strategy discussions in partnership with Sales and Finance.    Cross-Functional & Team Leadership    Directly lead Product Management, Customer Program Management, and Product Marketing resources dedicated to the BU.  Partner closely with Module Design Engineering, Customer AEs, Module Manufacturing, and the Module Execution team to align capacity with roadmap commitments.  For the first ~12 months, personally own end-to-end execution of a key product from NPI through volume ramp — working the details alongside the team, not just directing from above. Hands-on involvement across every aspect of execution — design, silicon, test, vendors (inductors, capacitors, substrates), internal and external manufacturing – is a core, ongoing expectation of this role, not a temporary phase to graduate out of.  Build organizational capability over time — hiring, developing, and eventually delegating execution ownership as the business scale     10+ years in the power management / power semiconductor industry, with deep technical grounding in power delivery (modules, digital controllers, power stages, or closely related power conversion technologies).  Prior experience running a business or product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap ownership, portfolio decisions, and business/financial management — not solely a product marketing or applications role.  Track record engaging directly with large, sophisticated customers (hyperscalers, cloud infrastructure, or AI/compute silicon providers strongly preferred) at both working and executive levels.  Experience leading cross-functional teams (product management, program management, marketing, and/or engineering) without necessarily having direct reporting authority over every function involved.  Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, still-forming business — building process and structure rather than inheriting it.    Skills & Attributes    Strong technical fluency in power management to earn credibility with both customer engineering teams and internal design/engineering teams.  General-manager mindset: equally comfortable in a roadmap review, a pricing negotiation, and an engineering design review.  High degree of self-direction and ownership — willing and able to be hands-on with execution details in year one while building toward broader strategic scope.  Excellent executive communication and cross-cultural collaboration skills, given the global, cross-site nature of the design and operations teams (US, Taiwan, China). This position is in CMSD (Configurable Mixed-Signal Division), which is part of Renesas’ Analog & Mixed-Signal Product Group. The CMSD R&D team develops and industrializes highly configurable mixed-signal products for a wide range of applications, including but not limited to consumer, communication, computing, data center, industrial, and automotive applications. The CMSD team is the pioneer and dominant market leader of the highly successful GreenPAKTM family of products. The CMSD team is continuously expanding the product portfolio that includes high-performance analog IP’s, DC-DC converters, and FPGA solutions.     As a Senior Manager Analog Engineering you will lead a team of analog designers and be the technical project lead for the development of our configurable mixed-signal ASICs. You will be responsible for all technical aspects of the project, from the initial concept phase through definition and architecture selection to design development, verification, and collaboration with cross-functional teams (test development, qualification etc.) to prepare the product for market release. Be action-oriented and leverage project management skills to work effectively with deployment and technical support teams.
