Under supervision, operates and supports MOCVD manufacturing processes in a semiconductor cleanroom environment. Performs routine wafer handling, equipment checks, recipe execution, production tracking, data recording, preventive maintenance support, and shift passdown activities while following documented procedures, safety requirements, cleanroom protocols, and quality standards. Escalates abnormalities promptly to supervision, engineering, maintenance, or safety contacts to protect personnel, equipment, product quality, and schedule commitments.  This department is a 24/7 operation.  Candidates must be flexible in working weekend and night shifts as appropriate.   JOB RESPONSIBILITIES   The following list of duties and responsibilities represents the essential functions of the job. An employee may be required to perform additional duties not listed below on an occasional or frequent basis.   Change into cleanroom garments and required PPE per standard operating procedures so cleanroom standards, contamination control, and personal safety requirements are met.  Clean and maintain work surfaces, wafer handling tools, vacuum wands, transfer fixtures, carriers, load stations, wet benches, and related MOCVD support areas per procedure or whenever contamination is suspected, so risk of particle or product contamination is controlled.  Complete assigned lab tasks, daily equipment checks, chamber/support-area cleaning, consumable checks, and scheduled preventive maintenance support for MOCVD tools and associated equipment.  Record production, PM, metrology, recipe, lot, gas, chemical, material, and equipment status data in required systems and logs so process quality, traceability, and equipment readiness can be monitored.  Communicate clearly and promptly so questions, abnormalities, and handoff items are identified and addressed in a timely manner.  Review and provide verbal shift overlap with operators, technicians, engineers, and supervisors as needed.  Read, write, and send accurate shift passdown covering tool status, lot status, open issues, safety concerns, material needs, and next steps.  Notify supervisor, engineering, maintenance, facilities, or ERT contacts of process problems, tool alarms, safety issues, low gases or chemicals, leaks, abnormal tool conditions, wafer damage, or any area of concern.    Perform required pre-run checks per standard operating procedures before processing product so misprocessing, contamination, and unsafe operation are avoided:  Verify MOCVD tool status, chamber readiness, interlocks, alarms, room conditions, chiller status, and required utilities/gases are within acceptable limits.  Confirm the lot is tracked in the applicable manufacturing execution system before processing.  Verify the previous process step is complete, the traveler is current, and the correct recipe, run conditions, and tool are selected.  Verify wafer identification, lot number, carrier, quantity, orientation, and traveler information match before loading.    Handle, load, unload, and transfer wafers carefully using approved tools and procedures so wafers are not broken, scratched, contaminated, misidentified, or misprocessed.  Execute assigned MOCVD production activities such as wafer preparation support, recipe loading/running, growth monitoring, run completion checks, wafer inspection support, and post-run documentation in accordance with approved procedures.  Assist engineers, maintenance personnel, and experienced operators with troubleshooting support, chamber-related tasks, consumable changes, inventory checks, and continuous improvement activities within training and authorization limits.  Prior to the end of shift, organize the work area, update passdown, place work in a safe and clear handoff condition, clean tables and workstations, clear clutter, return tools/materials to proper locations, and communicate open items to the next operator.  Follow all quality, safety, environmental, attendance, cleanroom, chemical handling, gas safety, wafer handling, and company policies as specified in procedures, training, permits, or other applicable requirements so personnel safety, product quality, productivity, and compliance standards are met.     Experience/Performance    Minimum 2 years of semiconductor manufacturing, cleanroom, wafer fabrication, or related technical manufacturing experience preferred; MOCVD, epitaxy, high-vacuum equipment, or compound semiconductor experience is a plus.  Education: High School diploma or equivalent required; technical certificate or Associate degree in Electronics, Semiconductor Technology, Manufacturing Technology, or related field preferred.  Able to read, write, speak, and understand English; able to perform basic math and accurately complete production records, travelers, logs, and system transactions.    Skills - Able to:    Follow written procedures, manufacturing travelers, recipes, safety instructions, and verbal direction with strong attention to detail.  Learn and perform MOCVD operating procedures, including pre-run checks, wafer loading/unloading, recipe execution, chamber support tasks, and basic equipment care.  Use applicable Manufacturing Execution System transactions, WipTrac entries, production schedules, metrology records, and maintenance logs accurately and on time.  Demonstrate basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook/Teams, database entry, and electronic passdown communication.  Monitor MOCVD-related process indicators such as room conditions, chiller status, gas pressures, chemical/material levels, recipe status, alarms, and equipment readiness.  Communicate clearly during shift passdown and promptly escalate safety, quality, process, equipment, gas, chemical, or facilities concerns to supervision, engineering, maintenance, or ERT contacts as required.  Work assigned shifts, weekends, overtime, and schedule changes as needed to support 24/7 manufacturing and MOCVD growth demand.    Physical - Able to:    Meet vision standards required for wafer handling, visual inspection, labeling, and identification verification.  Sit, stand, walk, bend, and work in cleanroom garments for extended periods.  Lift, carry, push, or pull up to 25 pounds as required for materials, tools, carriers, and cleanroom supplies.  Demonstrate manual dexterity for wafer handling, use of tweezers/vacuum wands, small tools, load/unload activities, and equipment interface operation.    Working Conditions    Cleanroom and controlled manufacturing environment supporting semiconductor wafer processing and epitaxial growth.  Requires use of cleanroom garments and personal protective equipment, including smocks, chemical gowns, safety glasses, gloves, face shields, respirator-related controls if applicable, and other required PPE.  May be exposed to or required to work around hazardous chemicals, metal-organic sources, process gases, hydride gases, compressed gas systems, and chemical delivery systems.  May be exposed to equipment hazards, vacuum systems, high-temperature components, radiation sources, alarms, and controlled access areas.  May be exposed to extreme temperatures, noise, exhaust systems, wet benches, and other manufacturing support equipment. The STA Engineer is responsible for ensuring robust timing closure and signoff readiness for block- and full-chip designs across all modes and corners. This role owns timing constraint development and validation, performs detailed setup/hold and variation-aware analysis, and partners closely with Synthesis, CTS, Physical Design, and Design teams to debug violations and drive ECO-based optimizations through tapeout.   Responsibilities:    Perform full-chip and block-level Static Timing Analysis (STA) across all modes and corners.  Analyze and debug setup, hold, recovery, removal, clock gating, and signal integrity-related timing violations.  Work closely with Physical Design, Synthesis, CTS, and Design teams to achieve timing closure.  Develop and maintain timing constraints including SDC creation, validation, and signoff readiness.  Drive timing closure through ECO implementation and timing optimization.  Analyze timing impact due to process, voltage, and temperature variations.  Support timing signoff for pre-layout and post-layout stages.  Perform cross-functional reviews for timing convergence and provide recommendations.  Generate timing reports and communicate closure status to project stakeholders.     7–10 years of experience in Static Timing Analysis (STA) and timing closure for block and/or full-chip designs.  Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals, timing concepts, and semiconductor design flow.  Hands-on experience in setup/hold analysis, path-based analysis, OCV/AOCV/POCV, derates, and MMMC concepts.  Good understanding of clock tree, clock uncertainty, latency, skew, and jitter.  Experience in timing constraints development and debugging.  Strong knowledge of SDC, timing exceptions, false paths, multicycle paths, and case analysis.  Familiarity with timing closure techniques and ECO methodologies.  Hands-on experience with industry-standard STA tools such as Synopsys PrimeTime or Cadence Tempus.  Good scripting skills in Tcl, Perl, or Python.  Ability to analyze and resolve timing violations independently.    Nice to have    Exposure to low-power timing analysis and UPF/CPF-aware STA.  Familiarity with SI-aware timing, Crosstalk analysis, and IR-drop-aware timing closure.  Knowledge of advanced technology nodes and variation-aware signoff methodologies.  Exposure to automation and flow development.  Experience in cross-functional collaboration with PD, RTL, and Signoff teams. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Product Support Engineer with advanced expertise in Altium solutions, PCB design workflows, and enterprise engineering environments. This role serves as a senior technical leader within Customer Support, providing expert support for complex customer-reported issues involving Altium Designer, Altium 365, Enterprise Server technologies, library and data management, and integrations with PLM and other enterprise systems.  The successful candidate will investigate and resolve challenging technical issues that occur within customer environments, perform deep root cause analysis across multiple technologies, collaborate closely with R&D and cross-functional teams, and mentor fellow support engineers. Success in this role requires a strong foundation in PCB design, electronic product development workflows, and Altium products, combined with working knowledge of enterprise systems, integrations, authentication technologies, and related infrastructure commonly used alongside our solutions.  This position is focused on supporting and troubleshooting Altium products within complex customer ecosystems rather than providing consulting services or designing customer enterprise architectures. The ability to understand how our products interact with PLM, enterprise data management platforms, identity management systems, and other connected technologies is critical to effectively diagnosing and resolving customer issues.   Key Responsibilities include but not limited to:    Take ownership and support a prioritized customer base and accounts defined by management  Serve as an escalation resource and document technical findings for broader consumption across Product Support Engineering and other stakeholders.  Support the entire customer base through a variety of channels, with a focus on FAQs, Knowledge Base articles, Online Help, and Community Forum participation.  Document all customer issues, case activities, and escalations in accordance with support processes.  Drive root cause analysis efforts for high-impact customer escalations and coordinate with R&D, Product Management, and Engineering teams.  Create technical content such as online help, user guides, video tutorials, knowledge base articles, quick start guides, and similar materials.  Provide live coaching and assistance to team members.  Act as a senior technical escalation resource, independently driving resolution of highly complex customer issues and providing technical leadership across multiple product and workflow domains.  Test pre-release products and features while helping prepare technical teams for upcoming releases.  Maintain a high level of knowledge and professionalism        Qualifications  include but not limited to:    Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent   A solid understanding of electronic design software, verification and automation  Advanced experience supporting PCB design workflows is required. Experience with Altium products and platform solutions is strongly preferred.  6+ years of experience supporting electronic design software, enterprise engineering platforms, or related technical solutions.   Previous Experience in Technical Support role preferred  Fluent in English   Fluency in additional languages is a plus   Excellent verbal and written communication skills   Deep knowledge in two or more areas is essential: PCB Design, High-Speed Design, RF Design, Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, Data/Library Management, PCB Manufacturing, PLM Workflows, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Integrations, or Enterprise Server Technologies.  Experience supporting customer environments that include PLM, enterprise data management, authentication systems (e.g., SAML, OAuth, Active Directory), server technologies, or other enterprise engineering platforms is highly desired.  Experience with Complex PCB Simulation/Signal Integrity/Analysis is a plus  Experience in technical demonstrations and presenting training materials  Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues spanning desktop applications, cloud services, enterprise integrations, authentication systems, and related customer environments.  Must possess excellent group and interpersonal communication and presentation skills, written skills, and the desire to work in a fast-paced environment with passion and enthusiasm for Altium Corporate Goals, Visions, Products, and Solutions  Be driven, self-managed, and motivated    Working conditions: This job may require occasional travel.  When not traveling, time will be spent in the office fielding escalations from the technical team, and proactively assisting with the team casework.     The expected annual pay range for this position is $100,000 - $130,000. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate. ## Our Team

Semtech's New Product Introduction (NPI) Product Engineering Team is the central engineering function behind every new product we bring to market. Our team of focused and talented engineers takes full ownership of new product development — driving each program from conception through end-of-life with a commitment to flawless execution. Working closely with all internal cross-functional teams, our engineers define and drive DfT testability requirements, test coverage, production characterization (across process, voltage, and temperature variations), ATE-to-bench correlation, cost and yield optimization, test time reduction, project logistics, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing. We take pride in delivering high-quality products that exceed customer expectations and drive business success — and our versatile, results-driven team makes it happen.

## Job Summary

We are currently looking for a Sr. NPI Product Engineer to join our team. This role sits at the heart of new product development — engaged from product concept through end-of-life — collaborating closely with all internal cross-functional teams to drive program success. This is a unique opportunity for a passionate and driven engineer to influence key engineering and product decisions and make a meaningful impact on the cutting-edge products we deliver to our customers worldwide.

This is an exciting opportunity to work within a world-class NPI development team, focused on designing and developing advanced high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductor IC products in cutting-edge CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. Our products are built with purpose and precision — operating at data rates of 25–400Gbps and beyond — delivering faster, more reliable connectivity for AI data centers, PON, and 5G wireless networks. Reporting to the Manager of NPI Product Engineering, the Sr. NPI Product Engineer will take full ownership of all NPI activities — driving and executing from product concept through final product release while maintaining the product life cycle

## Responsibilities

## 1. NPI Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration (25%)

• Lead and drive all NPI activities from product concept through final product release while ensuring product conformance to specifications, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing

• Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Project Lead, Design, Marketing, Validation, Test Engineering, Characterization, Quality & Reliability, Applications Engineering and Operations to ensure successful product development and delivery

• Actively participate in the milestone reviews of NPI program logistics, timelines, and milestones, providing regular updates to management and stakeholders

• Prepare all NPI product release and OSAT related manufacturing documentations for production transfer and product maintenance

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior product engineers

## 2. Design for Testability/Manufacturability (35%)

• Lead team to define Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Testability (DfT) requirements for NPI products and provide feedback to design for implementation to ensure comprehensive and efficient production test coverage

• Support test engineers in the development, implementation, verification and optimization of ATE test programs ensuring the testability/manufacturability features are considered and implemented, and that test coverage and quality is achieved while maintaining accurate cost models

• Lead product characterization, correlation and release activities, ensuring all datasheet specifications are validated and met

## 3. Characterization, Data Analysis & Yield Optimization (30%)

• Develop comprehensive product characterization plans encompassing both wafer-level and bench characterization tests, ensuring thorough test coverage across all product specifications and operating conditions

• Conduct rigorous data analysis of ATE and bench characterization results across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, including ATE-to-bench correlation studies, PCM data analysis, process capability analysis to ensure product conformance to specifications and yield modeling for new products

• Plan and execute Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize product performance, drive yield analysis, test time reduction, and test optimization efforts — identifying and resolving yield limiters in close collaboration with Design, Test, Quality, and Foundry Process teams

• Contribute to product validation and reliability qualification plans working closely with Test, Characterization, Validation, and Reliability Engineering teams to ensure alignment and successful execution

## 4. Manufacturing Quality, Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement (10%)

• Work with foundry process/packaging engineering in the resolution of problems that occur during wafer fabrication, packaging, die sort and final package test processes

• Drive the resolution of failure analysis, root cause and corrective actions for field returns

• Monitor and maintain product life cycle, identifying opportunities for cost reduction and continuous improvement

## Minimum Qualifications:

• BSc in Electrical Engineering or related field and a minimum of 8 years relevant work experience.

• Experience in semi-conductor technology, product, test and/or design engineering.

• Experience with quality systems including corrective actions, 8D reports, non-conformance reports, and failure analysis reports.

• Knowledge and experience with statistical theory and data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, JMP, Galaxy, dataConductor) for design of experiments, yield reporting and modelling.

• Experience in high-speed digital ATE test platforms (e.g. Advantest, Teradyne) or equivalent rack solutions is an asset.

• Strong knowledge of high-speed serial digital interconnect components and test methodologies

• Experience with JEDEC, and/or Mil quality requirements.

## Job Summary

As Senior Product Engineer — Lifecycle Engineering, you will take ownership of sustaining engineering activities across mature, high-volume semiconductor products.

You will lead technical initiatives that improve yield, optimise test performance, resolve complex production challenges, and enhance manufacturing stability across the full product lifecycle.

This is a highly visible, hands-on engineering role where data-driven decision making, structured problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration directly contribute to engineering excellence and business performance.

## Responsibilities

• Lead yield improvement and margin optimisation initiatives across internal manufacturing sites and external suppliers (20%)

• Own lifecycle engineering from production ramp through to end-of-life management, ensuring ongoing product health and stability (20%)

• Investigate and resolve critical production issues impacting quality, yield, or test performance using structured methodologies such as 8D and CAPA (20%)

• Partner with Test, Design, Quality, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to embed manufacturability, cost efficiency, and test optimisation into lifecycle activities (20%)

• Apply statistical data analysis and continuous improvement practices to identify optimisation opportunities and influence data-driven engineering decisions (20%)

## Minimum Qualifications

• BS in Electrical Engineering or related discipline

• 5–8 years of experience in semiconductor product, test, or design engineering, ideally within sustaining or lifecycle roles

• Strong experience in yield analysis, margin improvement, and cross-functional technical problem solving

• Familiarity with ATE platforms such as Advantest or Teradyne, or equivalent bench test environments

• Experience with statistical process control, data analysis, and design of experiments

• Fluent professional English (written and spoken)

## Desired Qualifications

• Experience working across global manufacturing sites and supplier networks

• Proficiency with tools such as Excel, JMP, Galaxy, dataConductor, or similar analysis platforms

• Exposure to high-speed serial interfaces, video/datacom systems, or JEDEC/Mil quality standards

• Strong documentation discipline and structured engineering approach

• Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced production environments with competing priorities

## Why Join Us?

• Work on products that have global impact across high-performance connectivity markets

• Collaborate with experienced engineering teams across design, test, quality, and operations

• Take ownership of initiatives that directly influence product performance, cost, and profitability

• Thrive in a culture that values initiative, expertise, and continuous improvement

## Career Growth Philosophy

At Semtech, innovation starts with people. We are committed to supporting professional development through mentorship, continuous learning resources, and a collaborative engineering environment.

Our performance-driven culture recognises meaningful technical contribution, encourages growth, and enables engineers to expand both their influence and expertise while shaping the future of Semtech’s product portfolio.

This is a strategic, hands-on B2B technology marketing role for a marketer who can own programs end to end, think in full-funnel metrics and use modern tools, including AI, to deliver measurable business results. 
 You will lead marketing for Southeast Asia and India, while supporting programs across Australia, North Asia and the Middle East in partnership with regional sales, channel partners and global marketing teams. The role reports to the Senior Director, Regional Marketing - APAC & Middle East and plays a key part in expanding Solace's market presence and revenue impact across the region. 
   What You’ll Do    
 Regional Strategy & Planning 
 
 Own the regional marketing strategy and execution plan for Southeast Asia and India; support plans for Australia, North Asia and the Middle East. 
 Partner with APAC sales leadership to build quarterly marketing plans aligned to pipeline, revenue and account growth priorities. 
 Adapt Solace's global campaigns into regionally relevant programs, tailoring messaging, channels and tactics for each market. 
 
 Demand Generation & Pipeline Acceleration 
 
 Plan and execute full-funnel marketing programs across online and offline channels, including webinars, virtual and in-person events, ABM campaigns, email marketing, regional digital campaigns and partner-led activities. 
 Drive lead generation, lead progression and mid-funnel conversion using data, intent signals, audience segmentation and relevant content assets. 
 Measure program performance and optimise tactics to improve lead quality, conversion rates, pipeline contribution and ROI. 
 
 Events, Programs & Partner Marketing 
 
 Manage regional online & offline programs from planning and logistics through execution, follow-up, reporting and post-campaign optimisation. 
 Own regional marketing budgets with accountability for ROI, cost-per-lead and pipeline impact. 
 Build and execute co-marketing programs and co-branded content with key systems integrators, technology partners and regional channel partners. 
 
 Sales Partnership & Strategy Alignment 
 
 Work closely with regional sales teams to identify priority accounts, campaign needs and pipeline-building opportunities. 
 Provide sales teams with relevant assets, campaign insights, automation support and follow-up recommendations. 
 Communicate marketing performance, learning and next actions clearly to sales, partners and global marketing stakeholders. 
 
 AI & Marketing Technology 
 
 Use AI and AI-powered tools to improve marketing efficiency, audience targeting, personalisation, campaign execution and lead generation outcomes. 
 Test, learn and scale practical AI use cases across the regional marketing function. 
 Manage core marketing platforms and reporting tools, including Marketo, Salesforce, webinar platforms, analytics dashboards and campaign automation tools. 
 
  Marketing Operations & Regional Advocacy 
 
 Manage campaign reporting, performance dashboards, budget tracking and operational administration. 
 Support regional customer advocacy, case study and reference activities in partnership with sales, customer marketing and global marketing.

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management or a related field. 
 10+ years of hands-on B2B enterprise technology field marketing experience, ideally across multiple APAC markets. 
 Strong knowledge of Southeast Asia and India; working knowledge of Australia, North Asia (Japan, Korea, Hong Kong/Greater China) and the Middle East preferred. 
 Proven ability to own the full marketing program lifecycle: strategy, planning, execution, measurement and optimisation. 
 Strong digital and lead generation skills across webinars, virtual events, digital advertising, email marketing, online lead generation and ABM tactics. 
 Proficiency in Marketo and Salesforce essential; experience with AI tools, webinar platforms and analytics tools highly preferred. 
 Strong command of full-funnel B2B marketing metrics, including leads, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, revenue, conversion rate and ROI. 
 Ability to localise global campaigns for diverse APAC markets while maintaining brand and campaign consistency. 
 Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management and time management skills, with strong attention to detail. 
 Self-starter with the maturity, business acumen and confidence to operate independently across a complex, multi-geography remit. 
 Bilingual or multilingual capability preferred; English plus any regional Asian language is an advantage. 
 Singapore-based, with ability to travel regionally and internationally.

Solace is the leading real time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Global enterprises such as RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, and United Airlines rely on Solace to build intelligent, real time experiences for their customers, partners, and employees.

About the Role

This is a fantastic time to join Solace! We've been working with enterprises across Japan and Korea for years, and we're now building our APAC SDR Hub right here in Singapore. This is our first dedicated SDR role for these markets, so you'll help shape how we prospect and grow across Japan and Korea from day one. You'll learn what Solace does and why it matters, generate and qualify pipeline through outbound and inbound prospecting, and team up with our Account Executives to open doors with major enterprise accounts.

You're a Fit If You Are

• Fluent in Japanese, Korean, and English, spoken and written

• Tenacious, curious, and genuinely excited by tech and AI

• Comfortable prospecting by phone, email, and LinkedIn

• A sharp, confident communicator

• A team player who enjoys a fast moving environment

What You'll Do

• Prospect into target accounts across Japan and Korea, using outbound and inbound strategies

• Engage prospects by email, phone, LinkedIn, and events

• Qualify leads and book meetings for Account Executives

• Clearly explain Solace's value to technical and business stakeholders

• Keep CRM activity and pipeline data accurate and current

What You'll Bring

Must Haves

• Full professional fluency in Japanese, Korean, and English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Strong communication skills and a confident, professional presence

• A proactive, curious mindset and a genuine interest in a sales career

• Ability to thrive in a fast moving, rapidly growing environment

Nice to Haves

• Prior experience in sales, customer facing, or SaaS/tech roles

• Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce or SalesLoft

Why Join Now

• Be our first SDR dedicated to our established, growing Japan and Korea markets

• Learn enterprise sales from experienced leaders and mentors

• Join a close knit team that genuinely enjoys winning together

• Competitive compensation and benefits

Fair, Inclusive Hiring

Solace is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We use AI tools to support the initial resume screen, but every interview and hiring decision is made by our human recruitment team.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/747.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

Overview

This is a remote-first position, ideal for a senior sales professional with experience navigating complex, consultative sales cycles within large organizations.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and securing new enterprise accounts, expanding relationships within existing customers, and positioning Solace as a critical enabler of both traditional event-driven architecture (EDA) and next-generation AI-driven initiatives.

As organizations accelerate their adoption of artificial intelligence, real-time data movement has become a foundational requirement. Solace plays a key role in helping enterprises modernize their integration strategy to support AI workloads—by ensuring that data is delivered securely, efficiently, and in real time across distributed systems.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders and executive decision-makers to demonstrate how Solace’s platform can serve as the backbone for modern AI-ready infrastructure.

In This Role, You Will

• Be responsible for establishing, cultivating, and improving Solace’s relationship with clients.

• Identify new business opportunities to grow with both new clients, and within existing clients – and they lead the sales process from start to finish.

• Develop and execute territory and account plans that address short-term and strategic goals which include pipeline building, revenue attainment, profit margin, client wallet share, and customer satisfaction.

• Be a “hunter” and must be a self-starter who is able to work independently. At the same time, be a strong team player — capable of collaborating widely and building a deep relationship with their pre-sales engineer(s) and others.

• Ultimately, accountable to win new business, and in the process will build strong client relationships (at both the working and executive level), negotiate complex deals, and establish long-lasting client relationships.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• Consultative selling

• Ability to build strong executive relationships

• Proven ability to close large, complex, deals

• Track record in selling middleware products, solutions, and services

• Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven ability to connect with clients

• Ability to pull together a team and lead complex negotiations

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

• 5+ years of experience managing client relationships in the Enterprise IT space

• Proven track record of sales success in other IT companies

• Familiarity with MEDIC / MEDDPICC sales process

• Willingness to travel as much as 30% of their time (2-3 days a week)

• Ability to work without sponsorship required

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

  About the Role  
 We at Solace believe we build the world's best event broker - the backbone of real-time business, trusted to move billions of messages a day across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments with unmatched reliability and performance. 
   
 At the heart of the Solace Event Broker lies the datapath - the engine responsible for moving messages at high rate, with low latency and utmost reliability. The Dataplane Adapters team owns the protocol surface: the MQTT, AMQP, REST, RDP, and Kafka adapters that let clients and applications connect, publish, and consume messages. This work spans our custom hardware appliance - built around FPGAs and a Cavium network processor - and our software broker running on Intel server processors. The code is highly multi-threaded and performance-oriented, and our developers regularly go deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals to deliver features that meet our strict performance and reliability bar. 
   
 We are looking for energetic developers that relish the challenge of building complicated features with C++ in this multi-threaded environment. Candidates should enjoy going deep to learn about messaging protocol internals, TCP and OS networking behaviour, and the details of the Linux kernel. 
   
  The Ideal Candidate   
 
 2+ years’ experience writing multi-threaded performance-oriented code in C++

Location: London, UK (remote). North America considered with a commitment to EMEA-shifted hours.

Reports to: VP, Sales

About TrueContext

#CareersThatKickSaaS! TrueContext is a field intelligence platform that connects frontline workers to enterprise systems of record, so teams in the field can capture, act on, and learn from structured data in real time. We serve enterprise customers in Med Tech, Building Systems, Utilities, and Oil and Gas. Backed by Battery Ventures, we are scaling the platform and building the defining name in field intelligence.

The Opportunity

This is a new business role. You will be the person responsible for adding enterprise logos across EMEA, working a territory of global manufacturers, service organizations, and utilities who run field operations at scale and are still doing it on paper, on spreadsheets, or on tools that were never built for enterprise complexity.

You are not opening a cold market. Some of our most significant enterprise customers are already in Europe, running critical operations on our platform, which means you sell with real reference customers, proven deployments, and a product that has been tested in the region rather than a pitch deck and a promise.

As the territory matures, we expect this seat to take on commercial ownership of the accounts it lands. We are hiring for that trajectory, which is why we look for candidates who can grow and retain a book as well as win one.

What You'll Own

Pipeline

• Building and working your own outbound pipeline across the region, in partnership with Marketing and our outbound team. The strongest performers here do not wait for leads.

• A territory plan by vertical and account tier, with a clear thesis for where the next three deals come from.

• Representing TrueContext at industry events, customer sites, and executive briefings across EMEA.

Enterprise Sales Cycles

• Full cycle ownership of new enterprise logos, from first contact through signature.

• Multi-threaded cycles across field operations, IT, procurement, security, and legal, typically four to nine months.

• Positioning TrueContext above commodity forms tools and below full FSM platforms, with Sales Engineering running proof-of-value on the customer's real workflows.

• Navigating European procurement realities including GDPR and data residency, security review, and multi-entity contracting.

Landing Well

• Handing off to Implementation and Customer Success with a deal that can actually be delivered: real scope, real success criteria, and the value metric the customer will judge us on.

• Staying close to the accounts you win, including the executive above your champion, so the second purchase is easier than the first.

Forecast Discipline

• A forecast leadership can rely on, and Salesforce accurate enough that no one needs to interpret it.

• EMEA market reality brought back to the business: competitive pressure, pricing, localization, regulation, and product gaps that cost you deals.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years in Enterprise B2B SaaS sales, including 3 years selling into EMEA enterprise accounts.

• A demonstrable new logo record: self-sourced pipeline, six-figure ACV, procurement-heavy multi-stakeholder cycles.

• Experience growing accounts after the initial win, through added capacity, tier upgrades, new business units, or new use cases. We want a closer who does not lose interest once the ink is dry.

• Credible renewal and retention experience, including the commercial conversations that come with it. As this seat takes on a portfolio, you will be trusted with those outcomes.

• Success selling to operational buyers in field service, maintenance, quality, EHS, or manufacturing operations.

• The ability to sell value against a materially cheaper alternative and hold price.

• Willingness to travel up to 40 percent across the region.

• Preferred: regulated or asset-intensive verticals, a second European language, familiarity with ServiceNow, SAP, Maximo, or Salesforce Field Service, and experience at a PE-backed company moving up-market.

Location and Hours

A London-based candidate working remotely is preferred, with regular travel across the UK, DACH, Benelux, the Nordics, and the Middle East. A North America based candidate will be considered with a firm commitment to shifted hours that cover the European business day. That is a standing expectation of the role, and will be discussed openly during the process.

Why This Role

We have a durable enterprise customer base, a platform that solves problems commodity tools cannot, and a mandate to grow substantially. New business in EMEA is the sharpest edge of that plan, and this is the seat with the most direct influence over how fast we get there. You will not inherit a finished playbook. You will write it, with direct access to the executive team.

Some Extra Benefits:

• Competitive base with an uncapped commission plan weighted to new business performance.

• Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day).

• Yearly wellness allowance and a remote-first working model.

• Company-wide & team social events.

TrueContext is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

*Preferably located in Ottawa, ON, open to remote Canada

  The Opportunity   
 The Sales Engineer is the technical face of TrueContext in every deal. You will partner directly with Account Executives to understand what prospects are trying to solve in the field, translate those problems into compelling product demonstrations, and remove every technical objection standing between a prospect and a signed contract. This is not a back-office support role. You will be in the room (or on the call) for nearly every meaningful sales conversation, shaping how customers experience our platform for the first time.  
 The right person for this role has genuine technical curiosity, can build a demo environment that mirrors a prospect’s real-world operations, and is equally comfortable presenting to a field operations director as to a CIO. You will work across utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, and other verticals where TrueContext wins by proving that our platform solves problems other tools cannot.  
   
  What You’ll Own   
  Technical Discovery and Solution Design   
 
 Lead technical discovery calls to understand the prospect’s field operations, existing systems landscape (FSM, EAM, ERP, CRM), and integration requirements  
 
 
 Map customer business problems to TrueContext capabilities and build solution architectures that address workflow, data capture, and enterprise integration needs  
 
 
 Serve as the subject matter expert on TrueContext’s platform architecture, API and integration framework, offline capabilities, and AI features  
 
   
  Demos and Proof of Value   
 
 Build and deliver customized product demonstrations tailored to each prospect’s industry, use case, and technical environment, following structured demo methodologies (Demo2Win, Great Demo, or equivalent)  
 
 
 Develop and maintain reusable demo environments and industry-specific solution templates for priority verticals (utilities, oil and gas, industrial manufacturing)  
 
 
 Lead proof-of-concept engagements where required, defining success criteria with the prospect and managing execution to close  
 
   
  Sales Partnership and Deal Progression   
 
 Partner with Account Executives to advance opportunities through the pipeline, owning the technical win in each deal  
 
 
 Participate in RFP/RFI responses, providing accurate technical content and competitive positioning  
 
 
 Identify and address technical objections and competitive threats early, escalating product gaps to Product Management with clear business context  
 
 
 Support trade shows, industry events, and field marketing activities as a technical representative of TrueContext  
 
   
  Knowledge and Enablement   
 
 Stay current on TrueContext product releases, platform capabilities, and AI features so you can speak with authority in every conversation  
 
 
 Contribute technical content to sales enablement materials, competitive battle cards, and internal knowledge bases  
 
 
 Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on what you are hearing from prospects, including feature requests, integration gaps, and competitive losses  
 
   
  What We’re Looking For   
 
 3+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales role in B2B SaaS, ideally selling into field operations, field service, or asset-intensive industries  
 
 
 Strong technical foundation: you can speak credibly about APIs, integrations, mobile architecture, and enterprise IT environments without needing a script  
 
 
 Demonstrated ability to build compelling, customized product demonstrations that connect platform capabilities to business outcomes  
 
 
 Experience working alongside enterprise sales teams and presenting to audiences ranging from field supervisors to CIOs  
 
 
 Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to manage multiple active deals in parallel without losing quality or follow-through  
 
 
 Fluent with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) and uses them actively to research prospects, prepare demos, and accelerate technical work  
 
 
 Prior experience with field service platforms, mobile data capture, or workflow automation tools is a strong plus  
 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on technical experience is equally valued  
 
   
  Why This Role   
 TrueContext is at an inflection point. We are investing in AI, expanding into new verticals, and building the sales organization to match our ambition. The Sales Engineer who joins now will have direct influence on how our platform is positioned and sold in the market, working closely with a growing team that has a clear mandate to scale. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with real room to grow. 
   
   
  Some Extra Benefits:  
 
 Company-wide & team social events 
 Wellness yearly allowance 
 Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day) 
 ½ day FriYAYs (from Victoria Day until Labour Day) 
 Catered lunches 2x per week 
 An amazing office space with plenty of snacks, drinks, and space to collaborate 
 Hybrid work environment (3 days a week in the office) if located in Ottawa, ON 
 
   
 This role requires up to 30% travel based on territory alignment. 
   
 Compensation Range: $140,000 - $160,000 annual on target earnings (inclusive of variable compensation)

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are You the Person We're Looking For?

Do you enjoy finding complex problems before customers do? Are you passionate about building automation that improves product quality, reliability, and performance? If you're a Software Developer in Test who thrives on solving technical challenges and wants to contribute to software powering some of the world's most critical systems, we'd love to hear from you. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract position providing maternity leave coverage within the QNX Power Management Test Team.

The Power Management Test Team at QNX is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Software Developer in Test to help ensure the quality and reliability of QNX Power Management technologies. In this role, you will do far more than execute tests. You'll develop and enhance automated test frameworks, investigate complex system issues, perform root-cause analysis, and work closely with developers to support high-quality software releases.

Working in a hands-on lab environment, you will validate software on embedded hardware platforms and contribute to all verification activities related to QNX Power Management features. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys software development, automation, debugging, and continuous quality improvement.

## Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and optimize automated test cases to continuously improve test coverage, and efficiency

• Debug, analyze test results, generate and document defects, and verify fixes

• Produce detailed test reports based on the results with high accuracy

• Execute comprehensive test suites on new software builds using reference and customer hardware, and analyze results

• Maintain test lab environments

• Create, update, and maintain test plans and test cases based on product requirements and feature specifications

• Configure, integrate, and validate software deliverables on embedded hardware platforms

• Collaborate closely with software developers, and fellow test engineers

• Reproduce and investigate reported issues using systematic debugging and root-cause analysis techniques

## Essential Skills and Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

• Must have: Strong programming background with expert-level proficiency in Python, C, and shell scripting

• Extensive experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks

• Deep understanding of Linux internals and extensive hands-on experience with system configs, scripting, and debugging in enterprise environments

• Knowledge of Power Management testing on different hardware

• Solid understanding of formal test theory, test methodology, and experience in developing automated tests and testing tools

• Demonstrated experience writing test plans and test cases, executing tests and reporting results

• Proven technical leadership and mentoring experience

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables

• Familiar with source versioning, problem reporting and constant integration systems (SVN, Git, JIRA, Jenkins end-to-end CI/CD pipelines)

• Working knowledge of QNX or other embedded operating system is an asset

• Experience in debugging, root-cause analysis, and system validation for embedded hardware and software environments

## Why Join QNX?

• Work on technology deployed in more than 275 million vehicles worldwide

• Help deliver software used in safety-critical and mission-critical environments

• Solve challenging problems at the intersection of embedded systems, automation, hardware, and software

• Collaborate with highly skilled engineers and embedded software experts

• Influence product quality through innovation in test automation and verification strategies

https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Renesas.body: Role Summary   We are seeking a highly motivated Senior EDA Physical Design Engineer with 3 to 8 years of industry experience to develop, deploy, and support advanced physical implementation methodologies for semiconductor designs.   In this role, you will combine hands-on physical design expertise with EDA methodology development and customer-facing technical support. You will evaluate emerging EDA technologies, develop robust and scalable RTL-to-GDSII implementation flows, and help engineering teams achieve their performance, power, area, runtime, and quality objectives.   You will work in a collaborative, global environment with product engineering, EDA teams and EDA vendors. The position is suited to an engineer who enjoys solving challenging implementation problems, developing production-quality design flows, and helping engineering teams adopt effective physical design methodologies.   Key Responsibilities   Physical Design Implementation and Optimization     Perform and support physical implementation activities, including floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, post-route optimization, and signoff preparation.       Analyze and resolve complex issues related to timing closure, congestion, routing, power integrity, design-rule compliance, and implementation quality.       Evaluate quality-of-results trade-offs across timing, power, area, routability, runtime, and design robustness.       Support hierarchical and large-scale SoC implementation methodologies.       Collaborate with relevant teams to achieve physical signoff readiness.     Methodology Development and Deployment     Develop, validate, document, and deploy robust physical implementation methodologies and production-quality EDA flows.       Create reusable flow components, scripts, checks, reporting utilities, and automation infrastructure.       Standardize implementation procedures and reports to improve consistency across projects.       Validate methodology changes using representative designs, regression testing, and measurable quality-of-results criteria.       Support migration and adoption of new implementation platforms, including flow porting, validation, testing, and user onboarding.       Apply disciplined software engineering practices, including version control, modular design, testing, release management, and technical documentation.       Drive improvements in flow robustness, scalability, usability, runtime, and quality of results.     New Technology Evaluation and Proof of Concept     Research and evaluate new EDA tool functions, implementation technologies, and semiconductor design methodologies.       Define technical evaluation criteria and conduct proof-of-concept activities using representative designs.       Compare alternative tools and approaches based on quality of results, runtime, scalability, automation, usability, and integration requirements.       Identify technical limitations, deployment risks, and methodology improvement opportunities.       Document findings and present recommendations to engineering, product, and technical leadership teams.       Convert successful evaluations into repeatable, supportable, and production-ready methodologies.       Explore AI-assisted EDA capabilities and emerging automation technologies to improve engineering productivity and design outcomes.     Cross-Functional Collaboration     Work closely with EDA R&D vendors, product engineering, and design teams to identify requirements and resolve implementation challenges.       Provide structured technical feedback to product and R&D teams based on project deployment and customer experience.       Collaborate across multiple sites and time zones to share best practices and maintain consistency across projects.       Participate in technical reviews, methodology planning, issue prioritization, and continuous-improvement initiatives.       Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, results, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.     Customer Engagement and Technical Support     Provide hands-on technical support to semiconductor customers and internal project teams adopting physical implementation methodologies and EDA flows.       Investigate, reproduce, debug, and resolve complex issues related to tools, scripts, constraints, implementation methodologies, and design quality.       Guide customers through flow setup, methodology adoption, optimization, and issue resolution.       Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, training materials, and implementation recommendations.       Coordinate with product and R&D teams to escalate issues, communicate customer requirements, and track technical resolutions.       Build trusted technical relationships through responsiveness, ownership, sound engineering judgment, and clear communication.       Help ensure that deployed flows remain robust, scalable, and effective across multiple concurrent projects.      Education and Experience     Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical discipline.       3 to 8 years of relevant industry experience in ASIC physical design, semiconductor implementation, EDA or CAD engineering, physical implementation methodology development, or EDA applications engineering.     Technical Expertise     Strong hands-on experience with synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, congestion mitigation, and power and area optimization.       Practical knowledge of RTL-to-GDSII implementation and physical signoff methodologies.       Experience with Synopsys Fusion Compiler, IC Compiler II, Cadence Innovus or equivalent physical design tools.       Strong understanding of static timing analysis, SDC constraints, clocking strategies, and setup and hold timing closure.       Experience optimizing performance, power, area, congestion, runtime, and overall quality of results.       Familiarity with hierarchical SoC implementation, low-power design concepts, physical verification, and EDA flow integration.     Debugging, Automation, and Problem Solving     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex tool, flow, constraint, and design issues.       Proficiency in scripting and automation using Tcl, Python, or shell scripting in a Linux or Unix environment.       Ability to develop maintainable, reusable, and well-documented flow infrastructure.       Experience interpreting implementation reports, log files, timing reports, congestion data, and quality-of-results metrics.       Ability to work independently, prioritize technical issues, and take ownership of deliverables through resolution.       Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new tools, technologies, and methodologies.     Communication and Collaboration     Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.       Ability to explain complex implementation issues, technical trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.       Experience working directly with customers, design teams, or EDA tool users.       Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver technical demonstrations, training, and methodology guidance.       Ability to work effectively in a global, multi-site, and cross-functional engineering environment.       Collaborative working style, customer-support mindset, and commitment to high-quality technical delivery.     Preferred Skills     Advanced Tcl, Python, Perl, or shell scripting experience for EDA flow automation.       Hands-on experience with RTL-to-GDSII implementation and physically-aware synthesis.       Experience developing or optimizing integrated Synopsys Fusion Compiler flows covering synthesis, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and timing closure.       Knowledge of multi-mode, multi-corner analysis, advanced-node implementation challenges, and hierarchical SoC design.       Experience deploying or standardizing physical implementation methodologies across multiple projects. We are seeking a Sr. Staff Strategic Capacity PM to own long-term capacity gap identification, provide solution proposals, and lead the initiatives to solve capacity constraints. This role will develop integrated demand/capacity models, maintain internal and external supply chain capacity profiles by site, support surge planning, and lead constraint engineering to identify and solve hidden systemic bottlenecks early enough to align capacity, cost, and DFM actions before NPI start and production ramp. 
The ideal candidate combines strong quantitative modeling skills, semiconductor supply chain knowledge, constraint engineering discipline, and program management experience to deliver predictable capacity availability at scale, reduce late capacity escalations, prevent surprise bottlenecks at ramp, and connect capacity investment and qualification roadmaps to business needs. 
 
 Responsibilities:  
 
 Long-term Demand & Capacity Modeling    Develop and maintain component-level demand/capacity models across product lines, technology nodes, manufacturing flows, and planning horizons.  Build scenario-based models for base, upside, downside, and surge demand to support executive capacity decisions.  Establish planning assumptions, model governance, and refresh cadence to improve forecast consistency and decision quality.    Supply Chain Capacity Profiles & Constraint Management    Create and maintain supply chain capacity profiles across internal and external manufacturing sites, including front-end, back-end, test, and critical supplier constraints.  Identify structural capacity constraints early and define mitigation paths before NPI start or production ramp commitments.  Support surge planning by modeling practical upside capacity, recovery timing, qualification dependencies, and risk buffers.  Drive fewer late capacity escalations by converting long-range signals into actionable capacity readiness plans.    Constraint Engineering & Systemic Bottleneck Resolution    Identify hidden systemic bottlenecks across design, manufacturing, test, supplier capability, yield, cost, and capacity interfaces before they impact ramp execution.  Lead data-driven root cause analysis using operational, engineering, supplier, yield, and cycle-time data to isolate constraint drivers and quantify business impact.    Program Management    Program Manage the constraint resolution initiatives from detection through mitigation, closure, and recurrence prevention across cross-functional teams.  Feed structural fixes into DFM, capacity planning, cost reduction, qualification, and supplier readiness roadmaps.  Mitigate systemic scaling failures by converting recurring bottlenecks into durable process, design, sourcing, or capacity solutions.    Facilitate cross-functional capacity reviews to align demand signals, site readiness, supplier capability, and qualification plans.    Risk Management & Analytics    Conduct sensitivity analysis on demand volatility, supplier constraints, site readiness, surge scenarios, and systemic scaling risks.  Drive continuous improvement in modeling methods, data quality, and planning tools to improve capacity predictability at scale.  Improve recovery speed from issues that do occur by establishing decision paths, mitigation playbooks, and feedback loops into capacity and DFM planning.     Required    Bachelor’s degree in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.  7+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, supply chain planning, or operations strategy.  Strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication and supply chain with Program Management leadership experience.  Experience identifying systemic bottlenecks, leading data-driven root cause analysis, and driving solutions across engineering, manufacturing, supplier and planning teams.  Advanced analytical and modeling skills (Excel, VCO, AI Optimization, SQL, Python, or similar tools).  Excellent communication and presentation skills.       Preferred    MBA or Master’s degree in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain or related field.  Strong stakeholder management, communication, collaboration, and partnership skills across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and OSAT partners.  Familiarity with statistical forecasting methods.  Knowledge of industry cycles and long-lead semiconductor equipment planning. 本ポジションでは現在複数名の採用を予定しております。同一内容の求人が複数掲載されている場合がございますが、ご応募は1件のみで問題ございません。ご応募内容は採用チームにて一括で確認させていただきます。 
 【募集背景】  
当社では、次世代パッケージ技術（Flip Chip、SiP など）の開発を中心に、半導体後工程における技術革新を積極的に推進しています。

Job Summary  
 
This role interfaces with cross functional teams on all phases of product life cycle. This role is responsible for driving yield enhancement, reducing test costs and ensuring the overall quality and manufacturability of the devices. Key Responsibilities  1.Review and provide disposition on low-yield production lots, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.  2.Work closely with test engineering, assembly, quality, internal factory and OSAT to resolve issues efficiently and ensure smooth production flow.  3.Execute day to day sustaining activities (Overall lot rejection rate improvement, EQA hold rate reduction, SYL/ SBL sustaining, etc.) to ensure delivery fulfillment.  4.Qualification and validation of new products, tester platform migration and various engineering activities.  5.Gross Margin Improvement Initiatives (Yield improvement, etc.).  6.System integration.    Must Have Qualifications:   •A bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Electronic Engineering, or related field.  •> 3 years of experience in High Volume Semiconductor Manufacturing environment preferably in Test Product Engineering, Test Engineering or Product Engineering  •Strong understanding of product knowledge & test methodology of analog/digital/power product, failure analysis, reliability test, RCA.  •Proficiency in statistical data analysis tools (JMP, Spotfire, etc.).  •Strong communication skills to interact with people at all levels 
 
 Good to Have Qualifications:   •Experience with module devices  •Experience with Visual Basic/C++ programming  •Experience with ATE tester platforms (Teradyne ETS364/Flex, Advantest). Role Summary   We are seeking a highly motivated Senior EDA Physical Design Engineer with 3 to 8 years of industry experience to develop, deploy, and support advanced physical implementation methodologies for semiconductor designs.   In this role, you will combine hands-on physical design expertise with EDA methodology development and customer-facing technical support. You will evaluate emerging EDA technologies, develop robust and scalable RTL-to-GDSII implementation flows, and help engineering teams achieve their performance, power, area, runtime, and quality objectives.   You will work in a collaborative, global environment with product engineering, EDA teams and EDA vendors. The position is suited to an engineer who enjoys solving challenging implementation problems, developing production-quality design flows, and helping engineering teams adopt effective physical design methodologies.   Key Responsibilities   Physical Design Implementation and Optimization     Perform and support physical implementation activities, including floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, post-route optimization, and signoff preparation.       Analyze and resolve complex issues related to timing closure, congestion, routing, power integrity, design-rule compliance, and implementation quality.       Evaluate quality-of-results trade-offs across timing, power, area, routability, runtime, and design robustness.       Support hierarchical and large-scale SoC implementation methodologies.       Collaborate with relevant teams to achieve physical signoff readiness.     Methodology Development and Deployment     Develop, validate, document, and deploy robust physical implementation methodologies and production-quality EDA flows.       Create reusable flow components, scripts, checks, reporting utilities, and automation infrastructure.       Standardize implementation procedures and reports to improve consistency across projects.       Validate methodology changes using representative designs, regression testing, and measurable quality-of-results criteria.       Support migration and adoption of new implementation platforms, including flow porting, validation, testing, and user onboarding.       Apply disciplined software engineering practices, including version control, modular design, testing, release management, and technical documentation.       Drive improvements in flow robustness, scalability, usability, runtime, and quality of results.     New Technology Evaluation and Proof of Concept     Research and evaluate new EDA tool functions, implementation technologies, and semiconductor design methodologies.       Define technical evaluation criteria and conduct proof-of-concept activities using representative designs.       Compare alternative tools and approaches based on quality of results, runtime, scalability, automation, usability, and integration requirements.       Identify technical limitations, deployment risks, and methodology improvement opportunities.       Document findings and present recommendations to engineering, product, and technical leadership teams.       Convert successful evaluations into repeatable, supportable, and production-ready methodologies.       Explore AI-assisted EDA capabilities and emerging automation technologies to improve engineering productivity and design outcomes.     Cross-Functional Collaboration     Work closely with EDA R&D vendors, product engineering, and design teams to identify requirements and resolve implementation challenges.       Provide structured technical feedback to product and R&D teams based on project deployment and customer experience.       Collaborate across multiple sites and time zones to share best practices and maintain consistency across projects.       Participate in technical reviews, methodology planning, issue prioritization, and continuous-improvement initiatives.       Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, results, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.     Customer Engagement and Technical Support     Provide hands-on technical support to semiconductor customers and internal project teams adopting physical implementation methodologies https://jabil.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/Jabi.body: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.             Job Family:      General Design Services                  Job Profile Title :  Principal Design Engineer     Job Posting Title :    Principal Systems Engineer – Optical Transceivers      Location/ Division Specific Information-     CAN - Ottawa/ P05        How will you make an impact? –       We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to lead the development of next-generation optical transceivers for hyperscale data center and AI networking applications. This individual will play a critical role in driving system-level innovation, translating customer and industry requirements into product specifications, and leading cross-functional teams through product development, qualification, and deployment.  The ideal candidate possesses expertise in optical communications, coherent or direct-detect optical systems, DSP architectures, electrical and optical interfaces, and emerging data center networking standards. This role requires both technical leadership and strong collaboration across silicon, optics, packaging, firmware, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams.  As a Principal Systems Engineer, you will define the architecture and technical direction of next-generation optical interconnect solutions, enabling the massive bandwidth demands of AI clusters and hyperscale data centers. Your work will directly influence product strategy, industry standards, and the future of high-speed optical networking.       What will you do? -       Define system requirements and product architecture for next-generation optical transceivers.    Develop transceiver specifications, link budgets, performance targets, and system trade-off analyses.    Lead architecture decisions involving optical engines, DSPs, laser technologies, packaging, thermal management, and host electrical interfaces.    Evaluate various modulation schemes, lane rates, and optical interconnect architectures to optimize performance, power, cost, and manufacturability.    Serve as the technical lead transceiver product development, influencing technology roadmaps and strategic investments.    Mentor engineers across systems, optics, hardware, firmware, and validation disciplines.    Drive design reviews and resolve complex cross-functional technical issues.    Represent the company in customer engagements and industry technical discussions.    Optical and Electrical System Analysis, including Define and analyze optical link performance, Link budgets/ Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR)/ BER/FEC performance/ Power consumption, and  Reliability margins    Perform system-level modeling and simulation of optical and electrical channels.    Analyze and optimize high-speed interfaces operating at 200G/lane and beyond.    Work closely with DSP and ASIC teams to define equalization, FEC, and signal integrity requirements.    Product Development & Validation, including Collaborate with optics, ASIC, packaging, firmware, and operations teams from concept through production release.    Define validation methodologies and interoperability test plans.    Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for system-level performance issues.    Support customer qualifications, field deployments, and technical escalations         How will you get here? –       Education:      BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or related technical field is required       Experience:      12+ years of experience in optical communications, networking systems, or transceiver development is required    Demonstrated experience developing high-speed optical modules is required       Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:       Strong understanding of:    Optical communication systems    Silicon photonics    High-speed SerDes architectures    DSP-based communication systems    FEC and coding techniques    Experience with optical standards and interoperability requirements    Strong analytical and system-level problem-solving capabilities    Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills    Systems thinking and architecture leadership    Cross-functional collaboration; Customer engagement; Strategic technology planning; Data-driven decision making; Mentoring and team development       Preferred Qualifications:      MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, is preferred    Prior experience with:    1.6T PAM4 optical modules    Co-packaged optics (CPO)    Linear Receive Optics (LRO)    Linear Pluggable Optics (LPO)    Silicon photonics integration    Advanced packaging technologies    Expertise in coding for test and verification in languages such as Python or other, preferably    Proven record of technical leadership and architectural ownership of complex products is a plus                                            BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address.
