We are seeking a Senior Analog Engineering Manager to lead the development of DDR5 and next-generation DDR6 PHY solutions for advanced SoCs. This role requires deep technical expertise in high-speed memory interfaces, combined with strong people leadership and program ownership.  The successful candidate will manage a team responsible for end-to-end delivery of high-performance, low-power DDR PHYs, from architecture through silicon bring-up, while shaping the roadmap for DDR6-class signaling and architecture                                          Technical Leadership (DDR5 / DDR6)   Own and guide the architecture, design, and implementation of DDR5 PHYs and contribute to DDR6-ready architectures.  Provide technical oversight for critical analog and mixed-signal blocks, including:  High-speed TX/RX datapaths  Advanced equalization, termination, and training circuits  DLL/PLL-based clocking solutions for multi-GHz operation  Voltage, reference generation, and power-aware IO design  Drive closure on timing, jitter, noise, SI/PI, and PVT robustness for aggressive DDR5/DDR6 data rates.  Ensure compliance with JEDEC DDR5 specifications and alignment with evolving DDR6 standards and industry direction.  Lead post-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and yield improvement, including lab and customer-system correlation.                                         People & Organization Leadership   Build, lead, and mentor a team of analog and mixed-signal designers focused on high-speed memory interfaces.  Set technical direction, performance expectations, and development plans for senior and principal engineers.  Drive hiring, onboarding, and team scaling aligned with DDR5 production and DDR6 development needs.  Foster a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and execution excellence.                                            Program & Cross-Functional Execution   Own DDR5/DDR6 PHY execution balancing schedule, quality, and risk  Partner closely with: Digital PHY and controller teams SoC integration and system architecture, Package, PCB, SI/PI, and validation teams, Product, program management, and customers  Interface with foundries, IP vendors, and standards bodies as needed to ensure successful delivery and future readiness.                                       Methodology, Quality & Roadmap   Establish robust design and signoff methodologies for next-generation high-speed PHYs.  Drive continuous improvement in simulation accuracy, mixed-signal verification, and silicon debug efficiency.   Lead long-term DDR5 sustainment and DDR6 technology roadmap planning, including architectural trade-offs and scaling strategies.  Anticipate challenges from data-rate scaling, power efficiency, and advanced process technologies     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (PhD preferred).  12+ years of experience in analog/mixed-signal IC design with deep focus on high-speed memory interfaces.  5+ years of people-management and technical leadership experience.  Proven hands-on delivery of DDR5 PHYs or late-stage DDR4 designs transitioning to DDR5  Strong expertise in: High-speed IO design and signal integrity, PLL/DLL and low-jitter clocking architectures,Mixed-signal verification and silicon validation, Advanced CMOS process considerations for IOs                                     Preferred Qualifications   Direct involvement in DDR6 architectural studies or early-stage development.  Experience at advanced nodes (7nm, 5nm, and below).  Background in multi-generation memory PHYs or scalable PHY platforms.  Ability to lead teams delivering multiple concurrent tape-outs.  Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and executive audiences.                               Leadership Profile   High technical credibility with the ability to dive deep when needed  Strong execution mindset with disciplined risk management  Effective mentor and team builder  Strategic thinker with a roadmap-driven approach to DDR evolution  Comfortable balancing hands-on engagement with organizational leadership      Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier . About the Role   Renesas is seeking a Principal FPGA Emulation & Prototyping Engineer to build and own the FPGA-based platforms that emulate our mixed-signal power ASICs before silicon. Working shoulder to shoulder with our silicon RTL and DSP architects, you will bring their designs up on FPGA to validate real-time digital, mixed-signal, and power-control architectures pre-silicon — proving out control loops, catching RTL issues early, and de-risking tape-out.  These FPGA platforms are emulation vehicles, not production hardware. Success is measured by how faithfully and how fast they reproduce the target silicon: functional equivalence to the golden ASIC RTL, real-time (or near-real-time) performance for closed-loop power and DSP validation, and deep visibility for pre-silicon debug.   What You'll Do    Partner closely with silicon RTL and DSP architects to bring ASIC designs up on FPGA — advising on FPGA-ability and turning architectural intent into a working, real-time emulation platform.  Adapt ASIC RTL for FPGA emulation while preserving functional equivalence to the golden design — handling clock-gating conversion, memory/SRAM macro mapping, reset and initialization schemes, tri-state/bus conversion, and stubbing or modeling of analog/mixed-signal blocks.  Map designs onto the FPGA fabric to fit and to hit emulation speed — steering resource inference (DSP/multiplier slices, block vs. distributed memory), clocking, and pipelining so the design achieves the real-time performance the validation requires.  Build the real-time environment around the digital core: model or interface to the analog and power stages (ADC/DAC/PWM, gate drivers, plant/converter models), including hardware-in-the-loop with real or emulated power hardware where needed.  Develop deep pre-silicon debug and visibility — logic analysis, long-run waveform capture, triggering, and assertions — and enable firmware/software co-development ahead of silicon.  Define and continuously improve the emulation methodology, RTL/FPGA-ability guidelines, flows, and automation (TCL/Python).  Provide technical leadership: mentor engineers, lead reviews, and drive emulation and tooling decisions across the silicon and systems teams.     Required Qualifications    Extensive FPGA design and implementation experience (typically 10+ years), including a track record of FPGA prototyping or emulation of ASIC/SoC designs.  Expert-level RTL design in SystemVerilog and/or VHDL, with deep familiarity working from ASIC-style RTL.  Deep understanding of FPGA internal architecture and primitives — DSP/multiplier slices, block and distributed RAM, carry chains, and clocking — and a proven ability to map designs onto these resources to fit large ASIC RTL and reach real-time emulation performance (memory/SRAM macro mapping, DSP inference, clock-enable conversion, control-set and fanout management).  Hands-on experience adapting ASIC RTL for FPGA: clock-gating conversion, memory macro replacement, reset schemes, tri-state conversion, and multi-clock/CDC handling.  Strong command of the full FPGA implementation flow — synthesis, place-and-route, timing analysis, and constraint development (XDC/SDC) — on large Xilinx and/or Intel (Altera) devices, using Vivado and/or Quartus.  Hardware bring-up and debug experience: in-system logic analysis (ILA/SignalTap), lab instrumentation, and long-run pre-silicon debug.  Proficiency scripting for automation (TCL, Python).  Demonstrated technical leadership — mentoring, reviews, and driving cross-team technical decisions.  BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).    Preferred Qualifications    Real-time, hardware-in-the-loop emulation and modeling of analog/mixed-signal and power stages (ADC/DAC/PWM interfaces, plant/converter models).  Understanding of digital power-conversion control and mixed-signal systems — converter topologies, control loops, PWM/PFM, and magnetics — to build faithful models and validate power-control architectures.  FPGA DSP implementation and real-time emulation of DSP datapaths: FIR/IIR/CIC filters, interpolation/decimation, FFT, FEC, including high-throughput techniques such as folding/unfolding.  Experience with commercial FPGA prototyping platforms such as Synopsys HAPS, Cadence Protium, or Siemens Veloce.  Model-based design with Simulink and/or Xilinx System Generator.  High-speed interface experience: JESD204B, PCIe, 1G/10G Ethernet, Aurora.  ASIC design or tape-out exposure, including DFT/scan considerations in emulation.  Ability to architect and build a custom in-house FPGA prototyping platform — board architecture, high-speed PCB design, signal integrity, and bring-up — a plus as we may develop our own hardware in the future.  Embedded/microcontroller and firmware co-development experience (C/assembly); MATLAB, C/C++. https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Renesas.body: We are seeking an experienced Manager of Semiconductor IC Packaging Assembly Engineering to support assembly sustaining engineering and manufacturing execution for advanced semiconductor packaging technologies. This role supports AI/data center infrastructure power packaging applications, including Smart Power Stages, Vertical Power Stages, Power Modules, and Discrete FET packages, with additional exposure to wide-bandgap (WBG) technologies including SiC and GaN, DBC and AMB substrates, and advanced interconnect technologies. This position will focus on yield improvement, process stability, quality support, process change execution, and manufacturing readiness while working closely with Package Engineering, Product Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external OSAT partners to support New Product Introduction (NPI) transfer into high-volume manufacturing (HVM).  The ideal candidate combines strong semiconductor packaging assembly knowledge with hands-on technical execution, structured problem solving, and cross-functional coordination skills to improve manufacturing performance, product quality, and process robustness. This role serves as a technical contributor and coordination point between Package Engineering and manufacturing partners by helping translate package development requirements, qualification plans, process controls, and ramp readiness needs into reliable manufacturing execution.   Key Responsibilities:    Manufacturing & Sustaining Engineering Execution    Support sustaining engineering activities across semiconductor package assembly technologies and assigned product lines.  Execute manufacturing improvement activities related to yield, cycle time, quality, throughput, and cost.  Apply engineering practices for process control, defect reduction, and continuous improvement.  Provide technical input to assembly engineering plans aligned with package technology and product needs.  Work with Package Engineering and OSAT teams to support manufacturable designs and stable production controls.    Yield Monitoring & Continuous Improvement    Monitor assembly yield performance, trends, and corrective action progress.  Support data-driven yield improvement activities using statistical and structured problem-solving methodologies.  Investigate process, reliability, and customer quality issues through disciplined root-cause analysis.  Maintain and review KPIs and dashboards to track manufacturing performance and improvement progress.    Quality & Reliability Management    Work with Quality and Reliability teams to support internal, industry, and customer requirements.  Support containment, corrective, and preventive actions for manufacturing and field quality issues.  Support process controls and qualification requirements across OSAT sites.  Support customer, supplier, and internal quality audits and reviews.  Work with manufacturing partners to resolve issues and support shipment of qualified products.    Process Change Management    Support process change management for materials, equipment, tooling, flows, and sites.  Assess engineering changes for technical, quality, reliability, supply, and operational impact.  Support qualification plans for transfers, second sourcing, equipment changes, and cost reductions.  Maintain documentation, change control records, and manufacturing readiness materials.    NPI to High Volume Manufacturing Ramp    Support manufacturing engineering activities for NPI-to-production transfers.  Participate in manufacturability reviews and package-process integration discussions during product development.  Support manufacturing readiness, process optimization, and structured ramp execution for new products.  Support process, qualification, material, site, and capacity readiness for high-volume ramp.  Coordinate ramp execution tasks with engineering, supply chain, and quality teams.    OSAT Partner Management    Work with global OSAT and contract manufacturing partners supporting development and production activities.  Track partner performance related to yield, quality, cycle time, reliability, and capacity readiness.  Participate in technical reviews, audits, benchmarking, and qualification assessments for manufacturing partners.  Collaborate with suppliers and OSAT partners on transfers, process optimization, scaling, and cost improvement activities.    Team Collaboration & Technical Support    Provide technical support and guidance to engineering team members on assigned projects and issues.  Promote collaboration, technical discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement within project teams.  Help improve engineering processes and technical practices to support product and manufacturing needs.  Support knowledge sharing and technical capability growth within the engineering organization.  Contribute packaging assembly expertise to support product execution, customer readiness, and manufacturing ramp.       Required Qualifications:    Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related technical discipline.  12+ years of semiconductor manufacturing and packaging engineering experience with exposure to IC assembly operations, package development, qualification, and NPI-to-HVM transfers.  5+ years of experience leading technical projects, coordinating engineering activities, or mentoring engineers in semiconductor manufacturing environments.  Strong expertise in semiconductor package assembly processes including wirebond, flip chip, wafer-level packaging, multi-chip modules, molding, singulation, SMT, and advanced packaging technologies; experience with power packaging, power SiP/modules, Smart Power Stages, Vertical Power Stages, Power Modules, Discrete FET packages, power devices, and wide-bandgap packaging such as SiC and GaN is highly valued. Knowledge of DBC, AMB, and advanced interconnect technologies is a strong plus.  Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing yield analysis, SPC, DOE, reliability, process control methodologies, package/process qualification methods, and statistical analysis tools.  Experience working with global OSAT partners and outsourced manufacturing ecosystems, including qualification support and ongoing technical coordination with subcontractors and contract manufacturers.  Experience supporting NPI-to-HVM product ramp execution.  Strong knowledge of semiconductor quality systems, change management, and qualification methodologies.  Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.    Preferred Qualifications:    Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering or related field.  Experience with advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D/3D packaging, SiP, fan-out, embedded die, heterogeneous integration, wafer-level packaging, multi-chip modules, advanced interconnects, and substrate technologies such as DBC and AMB.  Familiarity with automotive, AI/data center infrastructure power, high-performance computing, power semiconductor, and wide-bandgap product manufacturing requirements.  Experience working with geographically distributed engineering teams and manufacturing operations.  Knowledge of reliability standards including JEDEC, IPC, and customer qualification requirements. This role serves as a key technical interface to Package Engineering by helping translate package development intent, qualification requirements, process windows, and ramp readiness into stable, cost-competitive, high-volume manufacturing execution. Work with Package Engineering and OSAT teams to ensure manufacturable designs and robust production controls. Execute data-driven yield improvement initiatives using statistical and structured problem-solving methodologies.  Investigate process, reliability, and customer quality issues through disciplined root-cause analysis.  Maintain KPIs and dashboards to track manufacturing performance and engineering effectiveness. Develop and execute qualification plans for transfers, second sourcing, equipment changes, and cost reductions.  Maintain disciplined documentation, change control, and manufacturing readiness processes.    NPI to High Volume Manufacturing Ramp    Serve as a manufacturing engineering interface for NPI-to-production transfers.  Drive manufacturability reviews and package-process integration during product development.  Support manufacturing readiness, process optimization, and structured ramp execution for new products. OSAT Partner Management    Coordinate with global OSAT and contract manufacturing partners supporting development and production.  Track partner performance related to yield, quality, cycle time, reliability, and capacity.  Participate in technical reviews, audits, benchmarking, and qualification assessments for manufacturing partners.  Collaborate with suppliers and OSAT partners on transfers, optimization, scaling, and cost improvement.    Team Collaboration & Technical Capability Development    Provide technical guidance and day-to-day support to assembly engineering team members.  Promote collaboration, technical discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.  Help strengthen engineering processes and technical capabilities to support evolving business and technology needs.  Support technical mentoring, knowledge sharing, and capability growth within the engineering organization.  Contribute packaging assembly expertise to support product execution, customer readiness, and manufacturing ramp.     Required Qualifications:    Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related technical discipline.  15+ years of semiconductor manufacturing and packaging engineering experience with strong exposure to IC assembly operations, package development, qualification, and NPI-to-HVM transfers.  3+ years of experience leading technical projects, mentoring engineers, or managing small engineering teams in semiconductor manufacturing environments.  Strong expertise in semiconductor package assembly and related processes including FET wafer metallization processing, thin die processing, wirebond, clip attach, flip chip, solder die attach, reflow, molding, package singulation, package buffing/grinding, die embedding, and SMT.  Deep understanding of semiconductor manufacturing yield analysis, SPC, DOE, reliability, process control methodologies, package/process qualification methods, and statistical analysis tools.  Experience working with global OSAT partners and outsourced manufacturing ecosystems, including benchmarking, selection, qualification, and ongoing technical management of subcontractors and contract manufacturers.  Demonstrated experience supporting successful NPI-to-HVM product ramp execution.  Strong knowledge of semiconductor quality systems, change management, and qualification methodologies.  Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.    Preferred Qualifications    Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering or related field.  Experience with advanced packaging technologies for power packages, such as SiP/modules, multi-chip modules, Smart Power Stages, Vertical Power Stages, Power Modules, and Discrete FET packages are essential. Wafer-level packaging and substrate-level packaging design and technology knowledge are a strong plus. Wide-bandgap packaging knowledge for SiC and GaN dies including knowledge of DBC, AMB, and advanced interconnect technologies are highly valued. 2.5D/3D packaging, fan-out, embedded die, and heterogeneous integration will also gain points. Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling its AI-focused power delivery business. Products include high-performance digital power VRMs, multiphase controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), Vertical Power Stages (SPS with integrated capacitors and multiple silicon die), Power Towers (power modules integrating multiple SPS-equivalents with capacitors and inductors), and power MOSFETs.    As an Application Engineer for the Renesas Performance Computing Power Application Engineering team, you will be part of a fast-paced power management applications team serving the AI and cloud infrastructure market. You will engage cross-functionally with a diverse team, including marketing, IC design, firmware engineering, and systems engineering teams, to deliver the most innovative power solutions.   Responsibilities    A broad comprehension of DC/DC power conversion is required, including familiarity with digital multiphase PWM controllers. Key responsibilities include:   Work with senior applications, design and test engineers to validate new digital multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stages to evaluate system-level performance.  Work with senior applications engineers and evaluate new algorithms in the lab using a combination of FPGA, Microcontrollers, and custom Analog Front End.  Behavioral modeling of DC-DC converters, including IC blocks, using SIMPLIS and/or MATLAB to support the design engineering team with new control architectures.  Develop EVBs, including responsibility for component selection, layout, and thermal design  Develop collateral such as datasheets, performance reports, and application notes to support customer engagement.    This role requires a good understanding of power management, including magnetics, control loop theory, and component selection. Experience in embedded programming and synthesizing Verilog code into FPGA is highly desired.    Alternatively, an MS non-thesis option with 2 years of equivalent industry experience will be considered.  Experience with DC/DC converters with a good understanding of multiphase buck converters is a must.  Coursework in digital systems, Verilog. Mixed-signal integrated circuits are highly desired.  Understanding of control loop theory and its application in power converters.  Proficiency in using lab equipment, including network analyzers, oscilloscopes and waveform generators.   Experience with automation of lab testing.    Education    A New College Graduate (NCG) with an MS or a Ph.D. preferably with a thesis/dissertation focused on power management/power electronics is required. 【募集背景】 
産業・民生・車載市場におけるマイコンへの要求は、従来の性能向上だけでなく、低消費電力、高いセキュリティ・機能安全性、ソフトウェア開発効率の向上など、ますます高度化・複雑化しています。  当部門では、こうした市場要求を将来のMCU製品へ反映するため、システムアーキテクト機能を強化しています。システムアーキテクトは、事業部やマーケティング部門から提示される製品コンセプトや要求仕様をもとに、CPU、バスアーキテクチャ、メモリ構成、周辺機能、電源・クロック構成などMCU全体のアーキテクチャを検討し、製品の実現性、競争力、コスト、消費電力を総合的に最適化する重要な役割を担います。  また、製品構想段階から量産に至るまで、ハードウェア設計、ソフトウェア開発、製品企画などの関係部門と連携しながら、次世代MCUの実現をリードします。自身の技術的なアイデアや判断が製品の方向性や市場競争力に直結するため、MCU開発の最上流から製品化まで一貫して携わることができる、チャレンジングで影響力の大きいポジションです。 
 
【職務内容】 
・マイクロコントローラ（MCU）のシステムアーキテクチャ設計 
・市場要求および顧客要求を分析し、次世代MCUの製品仕様・システム構成を策定 
・CPU、メモリ、バス、アナログ機能、通信機能、セキュリティ機能などを含むMCU全体のアーキテクチャ設計 
・性能、消費電力、チップ面積、製造コストを考慮した最適なハードウェア構成の立案 
・新規機能や周辺機能の採用検討および仕様定義 
・半導体設計エンジニア、ソフトウェアエンジニア、製品企画部門と連携した製品開発の推進 
・開発プロジェクトにおける技術レビューおよびアーキテクチャ観点での意思決定 
・将来のMCUプラットフォームおよび製品ロードマップ策定への参画   【MUST】

https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/2f.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The Director, Cloud Engineering is responsible for the strategy, operation, security, governance, and financial stewardship of Magnet's cloud platform and shared engineering services. This Leader partners closely with Engineering, Product, UX, Security, IT, Compliance, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure our cloud platform enables rapid product innovation while meeting the highest standards for reliability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency. This role combines technical acumen, operational excellence, cloud strategy, AI enablement, Financial Operations ("FinOps") discipline, vendor management, and organizational leadership. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for ensuring Magnet's cloud platform remains secure, reliable, compliant, cost-effective, and capable of powering the next generation of digital investigation products. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada. Compensation & Benefits The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you. If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable). $200,000 - $250,000 CDN a year Salary range (min - max) Position Type: Current Vacancy Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact aoda@magnetforensics.com should you require any accommodations. All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment. US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Magnet Forensics handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here.

Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next-generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world-class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category-defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovation engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real-world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence.   Renesas has a growing presence in India with headcount approaching 1000+ and significant engagement with government, universities, and the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. With the growing importance of India as both a market and talent hub, the India for India division's mission is to create products, including power and analog ICs, mixed-signal devices, software, and system solutions, that address local market needs. This is a unique opportunity to directly influence future products for a fast-growing Indian market with distinct applications, cost structures, and localization requirements.    We are seeking a Senior Staff Digital Design Engineer to architect and implement the digital content within power, analog, and mixed-signal IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring ownership from requirements and microarchitecture through RTL, synthesis, timing closure, DFT support, and silicon bring-up.   The successful candidate will design control, sequencing, protection, diagnostics, trimming, communication, test, and safety-related logic that works closely with analog circuitry. The emphasis is not on large processor SoCs. It is on high-quality digital design embedded inside power and analog ICs.   You will be expected to resolve ambiguous requirements, make sound area-power-performance trade-offs, develop reusable design practices, mentor engineers, and collaborate across analog design, verification, physical design, test, applications, and product teams.     Responsibilities :     Digital Architecture & RTL Design      Translate product and circuit requirements into robust digital microarchitecture and detailed block specifications.       Design optimized RTL for control, sequencing, protection, diagnostics, trimming, communication, test, and low-power functions within power and analog ICs.       Own block-level integration and contribute to chip-level digital architecture, interfaces, clocking, reset, power-state, and register-map decisions.       Make and document trade-offs across functionality, area, power, testability, timing, reuse, and implementation risk.      Implementation, Timing & DFT      Develop synthesizable Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL, synthesis scripts, timing constraints, and implementation collateral.       Own or guide synthesis, lint, CDC/RDC, low-power checks, static timing analysis, and handoff to physical design.       Support DFT architecture and implementation, including scan insertion, ATPG enablement, test modes, and production-test requirements.       Work with place-and-route teams on timing closure, congestion, power, and post-layout issues.      Verification & Silicon Support      Collaborate with verification engineers on verification planning, assertions, coverage, debug, and specification closure.       Develop directed tests, reference checks, or test vectors where useful to accelerate design validation and production-test development.       Support gate-level and post-layout verification, silicon bring-up, device evaluation, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation.       Develop and document practical workarounds where device errata or silicon limitations require them.      Technical Leadership & Reuse      Drive reusable RTL, design methodology, coding standards, review practices, and automation across projects.       Mentor junior and mid-level digital engineers and lead architecture, RTL, and implementation reviews.       Identify technical and schedule risks early and communicate clear options and recommendations to project leadership.       Collaborate effectively with analog, applications, test, layout, CAD, and product teams across global locations. https://caseiq.bamboohr.com/careers/337.body:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team. This role is crucial in managing and optimizing our infrastructure and deployment processes, ensuring high availability and performance of our services. The Case IQ and Lextegrity product suites process millions of transactions, providing risk scores and insights that help compliance users prioritize reviews and proactively avoid risks like fraud, corruption, and bribery.

What You'll Do

• Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize our infrastructure across Azure and AWS, ensuring the seamless operation of services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker Swarm, Azure Application Insights, Amazon ECS, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Application Load Balancers (ALB), API Gateway, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and more. Support platform administration and security while identifying cost-optimization opportunities as we scale.

• Deployment Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD, automating deployment processes to ensure rapid and reliable software delivery.

• AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Drive the adoption of vibe coding, agentic SDLC, and AIOps practices to improve development velocity, observability, incident response, automation, and platform operations.

• Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance and observability metrics and implement improvements to ensure the high availability and scalability of the compliance monitoring platform.

• Security and Compliance: Implement security and compliance best practices, ensuring all systems and processes adhere to industry standards and regulations.

• Quality Assurance: Work closely with QA to define a testing strategy that empowers them to run automated tests and deploy to their own environments and enables high confidence in functionality with each deployment.

• Collaboration: Work closely with development to ensure the seamless integration and deployment of new features and updates.

• Incident Management: Respond to and resolve system incidents, minimizing downtime and ensuring the reliability of our services.

Who You Are

• Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or similar role.

• Technical Expertise: Strong experience with Azure and AWS services and infrastructure as code. Solid familiarity with containerization technologies, particularly Docker. Experience operating modern SaaS web applications, including auto-scaling, load balancing, gateways, monitoring, observability, and secrets management. Multi-cloud experience is a plus.

• Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform and CDK) for managing cloud resources.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Proven experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Github Action and Jenkins, with a focus on automation and efficiency.

• AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Experience with and knowledge of vibe coding, agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and AIOps tools for intelligent monitoring, incident response, automation, and operational optimization.

• Security Practices and Acumen: Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security measures in cloud environments. Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 web application security risks and a strong understanding of software security principles.

• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues.

• Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team and engage stakeholders across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

• 30 Days: Complete onboarding and required security/compliance training. Build a strong understanding of Case IQ’s platform architecture, cloud environments, deployment processes, observability tools, current infrastructure priorities, and incident-management practices.

• 60 Days: Begin contributing to infrastructure maintenance, CI/CD improvements, monitoring, and deployment workflows with support from the team. Identify quick wins related to reliability, security, documentation, automation, or cost optimization.

• 90 Days: Independently manage assigned infrastructure and deployment work, troubleshoot common production issues, and contribute to reliable, well-documented releases. Partner effectively with Development and QA to improve deployment confidence and environment readiness.

• 6 Months: Deliver meaningful improvements to platform reliability, scalability, observability, security, or deployment efficiency. Help advance infrastructure-as-code, automated testing/deployment practices, and AI-enabled operational workflows.

• 1 Year: Serve as a trusted DevOps partner across Engineering—strengthening the stability, security, and scalability of the platform; reducing operational friction and incident risk; and helping shape a mature, automation-first, AI-enabled SDLC.

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!

• Generous professional development budget

• RRSP/ 401k matching program

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

Role Summary

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for winning complex, strategic new business across the EMEA market. This is a full-cycle enterprise sales role for a consultative seller who can create demand, navigate multi-stakeholder buying groups, and build compelling business cases for Case IQ. You will lead opportunities from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation and close, partnering closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer teams to deliver a thoughtful, high-quality buyer experience. While the role is EMEA-focused, you may support opportunities outside the region as business needs evolve.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we work. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to using AI responsibly to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making. Across all roles, we look for strong human judgment, problem-solving, collaboration, and the ability to thoughtfully apply AI tools while reviewing outputs for accuracy, context, and business impact.

What You’ll Do

• Own the full enterprise sales cycle for assigned EMEA prospects and strategic accounts, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.

• Create pipeline by identifying and engaging senior decision-makers across compliance, HR, legal, ethics, investigations, security, and procurement functions.

• Run high-quality discovery to understand each prospect's risk, compliance, operational, and business priorities, then position Case IQ against meaningful outcomes.

• Lead complex, multi-threaded sales processes involving executive sponsors, end users, technical evaluators, procurement, legal, and other stakeholders.

• Build and deliver compelling product demonstrations, tailored value narratives, and executive-level presentations in partnership with Solutions Engineering.

• Develop clear account strategies, mutual action plans, and close plans that create momentum and maintain alignment across internal and customer teams.

• Maintain accurate opportunity data, next steps, forecasts, and account activity in Salesforce, using pipeline hygiene to support reliable forecasting.

• Achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets while balancing strategic account planning with consistent day-to-day sales execution.

• Maintain strong knowledge of Case IQ's products, market position, customers, sales methodology, and the EMEA regulatory and buying landscape relevant to enterprise prospects.

What Success Looks Like

• 30 Days: Complete onboarding, build a strong understanding of Case IQ's products, customers, target buyer personas, sales process, and EMEA go-to-market strategy.

• 60 Days: Build a focused EMEA territory plan, establish priority accounts and buying personas, and begin creating qualified pipeline through outbound activity and partner-led opportunities.

• 90 Days: Independently lead discovery, product demonstrations, and opportunity strategy for active enterprise deals, with clear next steps and accurate forecasting.

• 6 Months: Consistently progress a healthy enterprise pipeline, manage multi-stakeholder opportunities with confidence, and demonstrate strong commercial judgment through negotiations and deal execution.

• 1 Year: Be a trusted enterprise seller who consistently delivers against revenue expectations, closes strategic EMEA business, and contributes market insight that strengthens Case IQ's regional growth strategy.

Who You Are

• 7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including a demonstrated track record of closing complex enterprise opportunities.

• Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organizations, ideally within governance, risk, compliance, HR technology, investigations, ethics, security, or adjacent enterprise software markets.

• A proven history of achieving or exceeding revenue targets through consultative, value-based solution selling.

• Strong outbound prospecting and account-planning skills, with the ability to create demand rather than relying solely on inbound opportunities.

• Confidence engaging executive-level buyers and navigating complex buying committees across business, technical, legal, and procurement functions.

• Excellent discovery, presentation, product demonstration, negotiation, and closing skills.

• Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect product capabilities to business outcomes, risk reduction, and operational value.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience using CRM tools, ideally Salesforce, to manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and maintain disciplined opportunity records.

• Self-directed, resilient, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (We have employees spanning 7 countries!)

• Benefits Plan through our EOR

• Generous professional development budget

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

Cerio is helping build the infrastructure foundation for the next generation of AI-driven computing.

We are seeking a Vice President, Channel Sales to build and lead Cerio's ecosystem of channel partners across the AI infrastructure, data center, cloud, and digital infrastructure markets. You will develop and execute Cerio's ecosystem strategy, identify and recruit the right strategic channel partners, create compelling partner value propositions, establish scalable programs and enablement, and work closely with sales, technical, marketing, product, and executive teams to turn partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue. You will have significant influence over how Cerio goes to market, develops strategic alliances, builds channel capacity, and establishes its position within the North American AI infrastructure ecosystem.

What you will do

• Build and lead Cerio’s ecosystem strategy by identifying the partners, channels, and market relationships that can accelerate our growth across the AI infrastructure and data center landscape

• Develop partnerships with infrastructure providers, data centers, engineering firms, technology companies, cloud providers, OEMs, distributors, resellers, systems integrators, and other key ecosystem players

• Build relationships with channel partners, creating trusted connections and joint business plans that drive long-term, mutual value

• Create new routes to market by identifying emerging opportunities, partnership models, and ecosystem relationships that expand Cerio’s reach and competitive position

• Transform partnerships into pipeline and revenue by creating partner-sourced, partner-led, and partner-influenced opportunities in collaboration with Sales and developing joint account and go-to-market strategies

• Enable partners to succeed by developing the programs, resources, training, and engagement models they need to effectively position, sell, specify, integrate, and support Cerio’s solutions

• Shape Cerio’s market position by staying ahead of trends across AI infrastructure, data centers, compute, networking, power, cooling, and emerging technologies, and translating market intelligence into actionable growth opportunities

• Accelerate go-to-market initiatives by partnering with Marketing, Sales and Product teams on campaigns, events, thought leadership, account-based initiatives, and partner-specific programs

• Drive measurable ecosystem performance through clear partner priorities, operating rhythms, and KPIs across recruitment, activation, pipeline, revenue, market reach, and strategic relationship development

What we are looking for

• 15+ years of progressive experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem development, business development, channel sales, partner development, alliance management, or related leadership roles.

• Demonstrated success building and growing technology ecosystems, partner programs, or strategic alliance networks.

• Strong understanding of the data center, cloud, AI infrastructure, networking, power, cooling, high-performance computing, or related technology markets.

• Experience working within or alongside the AI infrastructure, digital infrastructure, cloud, data center, technology, energy, or infrastructure sectors.

• An established network of relationships within the data center, AI infrastructure, cloud, technology, or digital infrastructure ecosystem.

• Experience recruiting, onboarding, activating, and managing high-value channel and strategic partners.

• A demonstrated track record of generating revenue through partners, alliances, or ecosystem relationships.

• Strong understanding of distributors, VARs, systems integrators, OEMs, infrastructure providers, engineering partners, and other indirect or ecosystem-based routes to market.

• Experience developing partner programs, incentives, enablement, certification, commercial frameworks, and joint go-to-market plans.

• Strong business acumen and an understanding of channel economics, strategic partnership models, and ecosystem-driven growth.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• The ability to operate strategically while being willing to execute directly.

Total Rewards

Cerio offers a comprehensive total rewards package for this position including salary and incentive bonus plan (range $300,000 - $350,000 OTE), health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth. The salary range provided represents the expected base salary for this position. The final offer amount may be adjusted slightly higher or lower depending on the selected candidate's relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and certifications, as well as the full total compensation package offered. Our People & Culture team welcomes discussions about total rewards during your conversations.

About Cerio

Cerio is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, with offices and projects spanning international markets and Centers of Excellence across Europe and North America. Cerio is creating new scale economics for the AI and cloud era through an open systems platform designed to enable a more sustainable and efficient data center. Our innovation has no boundaries. We have built a culture that embraces flexibility, collaboration, and high performance, supporting both remote and hybrid work environments. Learn more about us at www.cerio.ai

Cerio is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. In addition, Cerio is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities. ## Welcome!

Our Growth is Creating Great Opportunities!

Our team is expanding, and we want to hire the most talented people we can. Continued success depends on it! Once you've had a chance to explore our current open positions, apply to the ones you feel suit you best and keep track of both your progress in the selection process, and new postings that might interest you!

Thanks for your interest in working on our team!

## Job Summary

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the successful execution of new product development projects within Adtran's Optical Engines organization. This role will partner closely with engineering, product management, operations, quality, and manufacturing teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives.

The successful candidate will have experience leading cross-functional hardware development projects, managing project schedules, mitigating risks, and communicating project status to stakeholders at all organizational levels. The Project Manager will play a key role in driving collaboration across geographically dispersed teams while supporting the development of innovative optical networking solutions.

## Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead cross-functional product development projects from concept through production release.

• Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, resource plans, and project deliverables.

• Coordinate activities across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, test, quality, supply chain, and manufacturing teams.

• Drive project execution to meet scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives.

• Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and proactively manage issues throughout the product lifecycle.

• Monitor project progress and communicate status, risks, dependencies, and key metrics to stakeholders and leadership.

• Facilitate project meetings, technical reviews, design reviews, and phase-gate activities.

• Collaborate with Product Management to support product roadmap planning and prioritization activities.

• Work closely with Operations and Manufacturing teams to support new product introduction (NPI) and production readiness activities.

• Manage changes to project scope, schedules, and resources through established processes.

• Ensure compliance with Adtran product development processes and best practices.

• Foster collaboration across global teams and create alignment among functional stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within project management and product development processes.

• Support customer commitments and strategic business objectives through effective project execution.

• Prepare and deliver executive-level project summaries and presentations.

## Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of project management experience leading cross-functional product development projects.

• Experience managing hardware, optical networking, telecommunications, or technology-focused development programs.

We are seeking a  Principal Router Architect  with  10 to 15 years of experience  to define the backbone of next-generation  Zonal and Central Compute Automotive architectures . This role focuses on architecting high-bandwidth, ultra-reliable  Ethernet Routing Engines  and  PCIe subsystems  that serve as the primary data fabric for Autonomous Driving (AD) and Cockpit controllers. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-speed data center-grade throughput and the rigorous  Safety (ISO 26262)  and  Deterministic Networking  requirements of the automotive industry.   Responsibilities:     Automotive Ethernet Routing : Architect L2/L3 switch fabrics supporting  Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN)  standards (e.g., IEEE 802.1AS, 802.1Qbv, 802.1Qbu) to ensure deterministic latency for safety-critical traffic.   PCIe Backbone Architecture : Define  PCIe Gen 5/6  integration for high-speed chip-to-chip connectivity between SoCs, AI accelerators, and storage, including support for  SR-IOV  to virtualize resources across multiple Virtual Machines (VMs).   Functional Safety (ASIL) : Integrate hardware safety mechanisms (ECC, Parity, BIST, and End-to-End protection) to meet  ASIL-B/D  requirements within the routing engine and bus fabrics.   Zonal Interconnect & Bus Fabric : Design the interface between Ethernet/PCIe controllers and internal  NoC/CHI fabrics , ensuring efficient data movement for ADAS sensors (Camera, LiDAR) and telemetry.   Virtualization & Security : Architect hardware-assisted isolation and  Secure On-board Communication (SecOC)  to protect the vehicle network from cyber threats while allowing shared access to network resources.   Infrastructure & Power : Define robust  clock, reset, and power management  schemes capable of operating under automotive thermal profiles and supporting rapid "Instant-On" boot requirements         Education:  Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (PhD desirable)   Experience : 12+ years in high-speed networking or SoC architecture, with at least 5 years focused on  Automotive-grade  silicon.   TSN Mastery : Deep expertise in  IEEE 802.1 TSN  protocols and their hardware implementation for real-time traffic shaping and synchronization.   Protocol Expertise : Expert knowledge of  PCIe (Root Complex/Endpoint)  and  Automotive Ethernet (10BASE-T1S to 10G+ levels) .   Automotive Standards : Familiarity with  ISO 26262  functional safety flows and  AEC-Q100  reliability requirements.   System Integration : Proven track record of integrating routing engines into complex SoCs using  AXI/CHI  bus protocols and managing IOMMU configurations. 【募集の背景】  本チームは半導体デバイスの不良解析業務を担っております。24時間体制で進めておりまして、交替勤務が可能な不良解析エンジニアを募集しております。業務内容としては、半導体テスタオペレーション、X線検査、光学/電子顕微鏡、化学薬品を使った半導体デバイス処理など幅広く活躍の場があり、解析エンジニアにとっては魅力的な環境が揃っております。     【職務内容】  ・半導体テスタ (ATE)を用いた調査対応 
・X線検査装置や光学顕微鏡を用いた検査対応 
・化学薬品を使った半導体デバイス処理対応　etc...     ※就業場所の変更の範囲、従事すべき業務の変更の範囲については、選考時に詳細をお伝えいたします。   【MUST】  ・未経験者歓迎（理系、工学、化学など領域に関する知識や経験をお持ちの方） 
・交替勤務の対応が可能な方  ・英語へ抵抗をお持ちでない方（業務上、レポート作成など発生するため） 
・日本語スキル：ビジネス会話以上     【WANT】  ・半導体デバイスの不良解析経験をお持ちの方 
(特に半導体テスタの操作経験をお持ちの方、X線検査装置の作業経験をお持ちの方は尚歓迎)  ・化学薬品の基礎知識を有されている方 
・マイコン、SoCの基礎知識を有されている方     ルネサスは、「To Make Our Lives Easier（人々の暮らしをより豊かで快適にする）」というPurposeのもと、組込み半導体ソリューションを提供するグローバル企業です。世界30か国以上で活躍する21,000人を超えるエンジニアや課題解決のプロフェッショナルとともに、自動車、産業、インフラ、IoT分野における世界最先端のテクノロジー開発に携わり、より安全で、健康的で、環境にやさしく、スマートな未来の実現に貢献しています。      ルネサスでは、「TAGIE（Transparent、Agile、Global、Innovative、Entrepreneurial）」を企業文化の中核としています。TAGIEは、私たちの働き方や成長のあり方、そしてPurposeの実現に向けた取り組みを支える共通の価値観です。この協調的な精神と挑戦するマインドセットが、半導体技術を通じた産業の変革と、世界中の人々の暮らしへの貢献を可能にしています。      私たちは、競争力のある報酬制度に加え、充実した福利厚生をご用意しています。福利厚生の詳細については、選考プロセスの中でご案内いたします。      私たちとともに未来を創造する挑戦に、ぜひ参加しませんか。皆さまからのご応募をお待ちしております。

Job Summary    This role is responsible for leading MLCC/ inductor/ Embedded substrate strategic sourcing and commercial management, driving cost optimization, ensuring supply continuity, and owning end-to-end supplier strategy. The role requires strong leadership, program management, and cross-functional influence to align business, engineering, and supply chain objectives while driving long-term value creation.    Key Responsibilities    Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, LTAs, capacity agreements, price adjustments, and payment terms for MLCC/inductors/ Embedded substrates.    Own supplier strategy for MLCC/ inductor/ Embedded substrate commodities, acting as a key decision driver in supplier selection and allocation.    Drive cost optimization initiatives using structured methodologies such as cost breakdown analysis, should-cost modeling, and localization strategies.    Lead cross-functional engagement with Engineering and Product Groups to ensure component readiness and alignment across NPI, ramp-up, and lifecycle management.    Ensure supply continuity and resilience by proactively managing capacity planning, allocation strategies, and long-term supply assurance with key component suppliers.    Identify, assess, and mitigate supply chain risks including capacity constraints, geopolitical exposure, cost volatility, and supplier dependency within the passive/component supply base.    Lead contract governance including MSA, NDA, pricing frameworks, and commercial agreements, ensuring alignment with business strategy.    Drive supplier performance management through structured reviews, KPI tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.    Lead escalation of management and resolution of critical issues related to quality, delivery, capacity, and commercial disputes.    Act as a strategic interface between internal functions (Engineering, Product Group, Supply Chain, and Finance teams) and MLCC / inductor / substrate suppliers to ensure alignment on roadmap, cost, and execution priorities.        10+  years of purchasing/procurement experience, preferably in the semiconductor or electronics industry.    Fluent in English is required; Japanese language proficiency is a plus.    Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with passive components (MLCC/ inductors/ Embedded substrate) is a strong advantage.    Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; proficient in PowerPoint for executive-level presentations.    Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.    Experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, or program management is highly preferred. https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/4d.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Summary Magnet Forensics is seeking a detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support the company's global trade compliance program. This is an entry-level to early-career position responsible for conducting daily compliance reviews and screening activities to ensure compliance with applicable export control, sanctions, and trade regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). The successful candidate will perform Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews, restricted-party screening, sales opportunity reviews, end-user due diligence, and transaction monitoring activities. The position plays a critical role in helping the company identify potential export compliance risks before products, software, services, or technology are provided to customers, partners, vendors, or other third parties. This role will work closely with the Legal, Compliance, Sales Operations, Finance, Customer Success, and Procurement teams and will escalate higher-risk matters to senior compliance personnel for further review. The analyst will be responsible for screening transaction parties using Descartes and ensuring appropriate documentation and records are maintained. Magnet's procedures require screening customers, vendors, banks, brokers, consignees, and other transaction participants against restricted party lists throughout the transaction lifecycle. Position Type: New Position Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Renesas.body: Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next-generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world-class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category-defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovation engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real-world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence.   Renesas has a growing presence in India with headcount approaching 1000+ and significant engagement with government, universities, and the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. With the growing importance of India as both a market and talent hub, the India for India division's mission is to create products, including power and analog ICs, mixed-signal devices, software, and system solutions, that address local market needs. This is a unique opportunity to directly influence future products for a fast-growing Indian market with distinct applications, cost structures, and localization requirements.    We are seeking a Senior Staff Layout Design Engineer with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal layout for power and analog IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgment, and the ability to lead layout execution for complex blocks and full-chip designs.   The successful candidate will translate circuit requirements into robust, manufacturable layouts for products such as PMICs, linear and switching regulators, gate drivers, battery-management ICs, and other power and analog devices. The role requires close collaboration with analog designers, CAD, process, package, reliability, and verification teams.   You will be expected to own challenging layout problems, establish best practices, improve methodology and automation, mentor engineers, and drive projects from floor planning through physical verification and tape-out readiness.     Responsibilities     Layout Architecture & Execution     Own floor planning and physical implementation for complex analog, power, and mixed-signal blocks, and contribute to full-chip layout planning.   Collaborate with circuit designers to capture electrical, matching, isolation, current-density, thermal, reliability, and area requirements.   Apply advanced layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, noise isolation, high-current routing, electromigration robustness, thermal behavior, and yield optimization.   Drive routing, integration, and sign-off readiness for block-level and chip-level layouts.     Physical Verification & Sign-off     Own and review DRC, LVS, ERC, PEX, antenna, density, latch-up, and reliability verification as required by the process and product.   Analyse extracted parasitics with designers and support post-layout simulation closure.   Identify physical-design risks early and drive corrective actions with design, CAD, PDK, process, and package teams.   Ensure layout databases, review records, and release documentation meet tape-out quality standards.     Methodology, Automation & IP Reuse     Develop and deploy automation using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar languages to improve quality and turnaround time.   Drive layout methodology improvements, reusable templates, checklists, and portability of IP across products and process technologies.   Work with corporate engineering and CAD teams to resolve tool, PDK, extraction, and process-flow issues.   Evaluate new layout tools and techniques and lead practical adoption within the team.     Technical Leadership & Mentorship     Lead layout reviews and provide clear estimates, progress updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans.   Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers and raise the technical standard of the broader team.   Influence project planning, task allocation, technical decisions, and hiring through demonstrated technical depth.   Operate independently on ambiguous and complex assignments, escalating issues with clear options and recommendations.      Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.   10+ years of relevant experience in analog, power, or mixed-signal IC layout and associated development flows.   Demonstrated ownership of complex block-level layout and meaningful contribution to full-chip integration and tape-out.   Deep understanding of matching, parasitic control, noise isolation, guard rings, latch-up prevention, high-current routing, electromigration, IR drop, thermal effects, and reliability-aware layout.   Hands-on expertise with Cadence Virtuoso and physical verification tools such as Calibre, PVS, or equivalent. Experience with extraction and reliability tools is expected.   Experience working with deep-submicron CMOS and preferably BCD or high-voltage process technologies.   Ability to automate layout or verification tasks using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages.   Proven ability to lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and drive layout methodology improvements.   Strong cross-functional communication skills in a multisite and multicultural environment.   Results-oriented, self-driven, and able to deliver high-quality work under tight schedules with limited supervision.       Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier . safety-related digital functions that interact closely with analog circuitry.   You will be expected to work autonomously, resolve ambiguous specification issues, establish verification flows from scratch where required, mentor engineers, and provide clear evidence that the design meets functional and product requirements before tape-out.     Responsibilities       Verification Strategy & Ownership     Own block-level and full-chip digital verification strategy for power, analog, and mixed-signal IC products.   Develop verification plans from product and design specifications, including feature extraction, test intent, coverage goals, assumptions, and sign-off criteria.   Decompose complex functions into reusable verification components and scalable environments.   Identify specification gaps and drive closure with architecture, analog design, digital design, applications, and test teams.     Environment Development & Execution     Design and develop SystemVerilog/UVM-based testbenches, agents, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, sequences, and coverage models.   Set up verification flows from scratch where needed and own regression execution, triage, debug, and closure.   Apply simulation, assertion-based verification, formal verification, and FPGA or emulation techniques where they provide practical value.   Verify digital behavior across reset, clock, power-state, fault, trim, communication, test-mode, and analog-interaction scenarios.     Mixed-Signal, DFT & Post-layout Support     Collaborate with analog and digital teams to define appropriate models and verify analog-digital interactions at the required abstraction level.   Support DFT verification, scan and ATPG-related checks, production-test vector development, and test-mode verification.   Support gate-level simulation, timing-aware verification, and post-layout verification where required.   Contribute to silicon bring-up, device evaluation, root-cause analysis, and documented workarounds for device errata.     Technical Leadership & Methodology     Drive reusable verification methodology, automation, metrics, documentation, and review standards across projects.   Mentor and train verification engineers through reviews, debug support, and technical guidance.   Provide concise status, coverage, risk, and sign-off assessments to project and technical leadership.   Influence architecture and design choices by identifying verification complexity, observability gaps, and product risks early.      Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.   10+ years of experience in digital verification, including substantial hands-on experience with SystemVerilog and UVM.   Proven ownership of block-level and full-chip verification environments and sign-off for complex semiconductor products.   Strong knowledge of functional verification, assertion-based verification, formal verification, regression frameworks, coverage closure, and debug methodologies.   Experience verifying digital logic embedded in PMICs, power-management, automotive, audio, or other mixed-signal integrated circuits.   Good understanding of RTL, microarchitecture, clocks, resets, low-power states, register interfaces, and common serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, or UART.   Working knowledge of synthesis, STA, DFT, scan insertion, ATPG, and gate-level verification to collaborate effectively across the development flow.   Experience with scripting or automation using Python, TCL, Perl, shell, or similar languages.   Proven ability to mentor engineers, establish verification methodology, and lead technical reviews without requiring formal people-management authority.   Self-driven, results-oriented, and able to deliver under tight schedules in a multisite and multicultural environment.       Renesas is an embedded semiconductor
