We are looking for a creative, hands-on Marketing Programs Manager to build brand awareness, engage customers and partners, and support our growth through impactful marketing programs. This role can be based in Montreal, Toronto, or Ottawa.

You will be responsible for event planning, marketing communications, digital marketing, content creation, and brand development, while identifying innovative ways to leverage AI and emerging technologies to increase marketing effectiveness and reach.

This is an ideal role for an entrepreneurial marketer who can think strategically but also enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute. You will work closely with Sales, Business Development, Product, and Executive Leadership to create programs that strengthen our market presence and generate meaningful customer engagement.

What you will do

• Develop and execute field marketing and event programs, including conferences, trade shows, webinars, and customer events

• Manage event logistics, sponsorships, vendors, budgets, promotional materials, and post-event follow-up

• Develop compelling marketing communications, content, presentations, sales collateral, newsletters, and social media

• Manage digital marketing initiatives including website, email, social media, SEO/SEM, and digital campaigns

• Build brand awareness and strengthen the company's positioning within target markets

• Partner with Sales to support lead generation, customer engagement, and pipeline development

• Leverage AI tools to enhance content creation, market intelligence, personalization, campaign development, and marketing productivity

• Track marketing performance and use data to optimize campaigns and demonstrate ROI

• Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all marketing activities

What we are looking for

• Someone who is strategic, creative, energetic, and highly execution-oriented - a marketer who can develop the plan, make things happen, and measure the results

• 10+ years of marketing experience, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, deep tech, clean tech, or another complex technology environment

• A proven ability to translate technologies into targeted marketing with well researched buying personas and ideal customer profiles

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools and leveraging AI in the marketing pipeline

• Extensive experience in field marketing, event management, and digital marketing

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technology into compelling customer-focused messaging

• Experience developing content and managing multiple marketing channels

• Demonstrated ability to build brand awareness and support lead generation and sales objectives

• Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Entrepreneurial, creative, highly organized, and comfortable working independently

• Curious and enthusiastic about AI and emerging marketing technologies

• Bilingual English/French is highly desirable

Total Rewards

Cerio offers a comprehensive total rewards package for this position including base salary (range $120,000 - $150,000), incentive bonus plan, health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth. The salary range provided represents the expected base salary for this position. The final offer amount may be adjusted slightly higher or lower depending on the selected candidate's relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and certifications, as well as the full total compensation package offered. Our People & Culture team welcomes discussions about total rewards during your conversations.

About Cerio

Cerio is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, with offices and projects spanning international markets and Centers of Excellence across Europe and North America. Cerio is creating new scale economics for the AI and cloud era through an open systems platform designed to enable a more sustainable and efficient data center. Our innovation has no boundaries. (CCB) workflows and impact analysis in a high-stakes semiconductor environment.  · Semiconductor Industry: A very solid knowledge of semiconductor development processes and manufacturing is a March Networks is an established global leader in the video surveillance industry and works with the world’s largest retailers and banking institutions. Our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

## Purpose:

Reporting to the Manager, Customer Operations, the Customer Operations Specialist will assist with the achievement of corporate goals and objectives by acting in a support role for all customer related issues within the Customer Operations Department. The Customer Operations Specialist interfaces internally with all levels and departments in the organization to ensure that customers’ orders are entered and fulfilled in a timely manner and customers’ needs are handled in a seamless and professional manner.

Duties:

· Resolves complex and escalated customer issues with a high level of judgment and discretion, serving as a point of escalation for the team, focusing on customer satisfaction, and resulting in a high level of confidence in the company and its products.

· Serves as a subject-matter resource for customer phone and email support, guiding customers on topics regarding our products such as part number verification, pricing, availability, and lifecycle (New product introduction, End of life).

· Liaises with the Sales, Finance, Product Management, Legal and Operations departments to ensure smooth order flow, delivery of product and successful resolution of customer needs (on time delivery and product shortage mitigation).

· Generates all transactions related to order management in SAP while adhering to company processes for hardware, software and subscription services product lines, ensuring process adherence and identifying/correcting errors before they impact customers.

· Provides shipment confirmations and tracking information to customers as required, supporting the customers on complex or high-priority shipments requiring judgment calls (e.g., expedited freight, split shipments, customs issues).

· Provides pro-forma invoices, freight quotes and certifications for international shipments as required, including non-standard or high-complexity cases.

· Functions with a high degree of independence, exercising sound judgment and decision-making authority on daily operations, escalations, and special projects with minimal oversight from the Department Manager

## Education:

· College diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

· At least 5 years’ experience as a customer service representative in a technology environment

## Qualifications and Experience:

· Demonstrated experience working with international customers in various time zones

· SAP experience in Order Management (SD) is required

· Salesforce (Sales Cloud) experience would be an asset

· Sound problem solver and decision maker

· Professional demeanour and excellent customer service focus

· Strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

· Excellent interpersonal, organizational, influencing, and communications skills for both customer and inter-company interactions

· Ability to manage customer expectations

· Ability to work

o Independently and as part of a team

o Well under pressure and meet deadlines

o In a fast-paced, dynamic environment, ability to prioritize and multitask

· Attention to detail, investigative, committed to quality

· Resilient, ability to maintain composure in stressful situations

· Proactive mindset, with a high desire to resolve issues

Why Work at March Networks?

• Global Exposure

• Medical/Dental benefits offered immediately from Day 1

• Health club reimbursement

• Professional development support

• Company holiday closure

March Networks is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Applicants can make their accommodation needs known to us in their application.

Please note March Networks uses AI as part of the recruitment process.

Hiring salary range for this position is between $60,000 - $65,000. This is an existing vacancy with one opening.

Collaborate directly with customers to define system requirements and develop innovative solutions that meet performance, area, and power constraints.  Oversee high-level verification planning, DFT strategy, and lab evaluation in partnership with applications and test engineering teams to ensure designs are production-ready.  Drive the identification and implementation of company-wide improvements in engineering methodologies, policies, and strategic initiatives.  Support roadmap planning and ensure technical advice is aligned with external market trends and evolving CMOS process technologies. Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to multicultural teams and external customers. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The AI & Automation Engineer helps teams work smarter by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and apply AI where it can add meaningful value. Working across Business Applications, Data & Analytics, and IT, you will build practical solutions that simplify work, improve efficiency, and support business outcomes. This role reports to the VP of Business Systems. Please note: This role requires hands-on coding experience, and candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their technical skills during the interview process. Compensation & Benefits The Compensation Range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Job Opportunity: Senior Finance Manager & Analyst

Company: RANOVUS Inc.

Location: Ottawa, Ontario

Department: Finance

Reports To: CFO

About Us:

Ranovus is a semiconductor company with global operations helping power the data behind next generation AI and data center networks. We design and build advanced hardware that moves massive amounts of information quickly and efficiently between computer systems in data centers around the world. Our technology improves performance while reducing energy use and environmental impact, supporting the rapid growth of AI and cloud services.

At Ranovus, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team that values learning, flexibility, and meaningful work with global impact.

Position Overview:

As the Senior Finance Manager & Analyst, you will bridge the gap between corporate finance and our international operational teams. You will lead a small finance team and act as financial partner to R&D, PLM, Sales, and Manufacturing Operations across Canada, Germany, and the USA. Beyond core FP&A duties, this role will spearhead the implementation of a cloud FP&A tool and lead the migration from QuickBooks Online to an enterprise ERP.

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Partnering & FP&A: Build and manage global budgets and rolling forecasts across multi-national teams; deliver variance analysis and financial insight to department heads.

• Project Accounting: Design and execute project accounting for R&D/Operations initiatives, ensuring alignment with SR&ED and grant reporting requirements.

• Cost Accounting: Support Manufacturing on standard costing, inventory valuation, and product-line margin analysis.

• Systems Transformation: Lead selection/implementation of a cloud FP&A tool and scope the QBO-to-ERP migration (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct).

• Financial Reporting & Audit: Manage month/quarter-end reporting, year-end close, external audits, government/SR&ED audits, and GAAP/IFRS-compliant internal controls.

• Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and develop a small finance team; present financial updates to senior leadership and the CFO.

Key Qualifications:

• 12+ years of progressive finance experience, with direct, hands-on ownership of financial analysis, reporting, and consolidation, along with previous experience leading or mentoring a finance team.

• Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams within the technology, manufacturing, and/or R&D sector, with semiconductor industry experience considered an asset.

• Demonstrated experience leading multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation and experience leading or supporting ERP implementations or system migrations.

• Advanced Excel/MS Office skills; working knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Power BI) and ERP systems.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce; CPA designation is an asset.

• Strong business judgment, communication skills, and comfort operating across time zones and cultures in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

What We Offer:

• Competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive benefits, paid time off, professional development, and more.

• The opportunity to join one of Canada’s premier hi-tech leaders at a pivotal moment, playing a direct role in developing world-class, innovative solutions that are actively powering the next generation of global AI infrastructure.

• A collaborative, innovative, and fast-paced international environment where your career can grow alongside the company.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

We are committed to delivering a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage of the process. Ranovus Inc. is committed to leveraging new technologies and working efficiently. As a result, artificial intelligence systems may be used to support elements of our hiring process. These tools are designed to enhance consistency and efficiency, not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in joining Ranovus. We look forward to connecting with you.

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

As a GTM Engineer, you will serve as a technical force multiplier across the business, building the AI agents, automations, and applications that scale how every team operates — from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support to Product, IT, Engineering, Finance, and HR — while sitting within the centralized Business Operations function. This role is responsible for engineering solutions that operationalize data, tooling, and workflows across the organization, replacing manual processes with reliable systems, driving visibility into performance, enabling leadership decision-making, and advancing automation and innovation across the business. You’ll be expected to bring hands-on engineering skill, innovative problem-solving, and a results-oriented approach to support the business in achieving its goals.

You will own key cross-functional tools, integrations, and automations, partner closely with technical and business teams to connect and activate data across platforms, and deliver high-impact applications, reporting, and insights that inform roadmap planning, investment decisions, performance management, and operational excellence.

In this role (remote-first: Canada), you’ll report to our VP, Business Operations & Strategy and work closely with teams across the organization. Expect a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you’ll wear multiple hats, be accountable and recognized for being creative and results-oriented. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we work. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to using AI responsibly to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making. Across all roles, we look for strong human judgment, problem-solving, collaboration, and the ability to thoughtfully apply AI tools while reviewing outputs for accuracy, context, and business impact.

What You’ll Do

• AI Agents & Applications: Architect, build, and deploy AI-powered agents, workflows, and applications that scale the productivity of teams across the organization — Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, IT, Engineering, Finance, and HR. Pair AI-accelerated development with sound software engineering, and for larger applications, act as the Technical Product Manager — partnering with our Engineering team to define requirements, scope solutions, and ensure our software development lifecycle (SDLC) is followed.

• Automation Engineering: Design, build, and maintain production-grade automations and integrations across the business — leveraging the existing tech stack, internal automation platforms, APIs, webhooks, and custom scripting — to replace manual processes with reliable, scalable systems.

• Systems Integration & Data Pipelines: Connect and orchestrate data across the platforms each function relies on — spanning the go-to-market, product, finance, and people systems — and into a central data warehouse, building robust ETL and API pipelines that keep systems in sync and data trustworthy.

• Reporting, Dashboards & Insights: Transform integrated and orchestrated data into standardized, automated reporting and dashboards — a core output of the team — driving visibility, accountability, and data-informed decision-making across every function in the organization.

• GTM Systems & Revenue Automation: Engineer the go-to-market stack end to end — streamlining how the revenue organization attracts, converts, retains, and expands customers — to reduce friction across the customer lifecycle and give Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams greater leverage and efficiency.

• Cross-Functional Tooling: Build and own internal tools, scripts, and applications that serve Business Operations and its partner functions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, IT, Engineering, Finance, and HR, acting as both engineer and product owner.

• Deployment, Reliability & Security: Deploy, host, and operate the automations, agents, and applications you build — managing CI/CD, environments, monitoring, and incident response, and establishing standards for data quality, access, and error handling so solutions run securely and reliably in production.

• Business Partnership & Requirements Engineering: Partner with leaders across Business Operations and the broader organization to translate operational problems into technical solutions, scoping requirements and shipping automations that align with strategic objectives.

• Rapid Prototyping & Experimentation: Use AI-accelerated development to quickly prototype, test, and iterate on new integrations, tools, and automations — then apply real engineering discipline to harden what works into secure, supported systems.

• Documentation & Enablement: Document systems and workflows, and enable teams across the organization to adopt and self-serve on the tooling and automations you build.

What Success Looks Like

• 30 Days: Build relationships with key stakeholders, understand the business systems landscape, and identify high-priority operational pain points.

• 60 Days: Deliver initial automation or reporting improvements and align on a prioritized cross-functional roadmap.

• 90 Days: Launch scalable production solutions for priority workflows, with clear ownership, documentation, and success measures.

• 1 Year: Establish a reliable, secure automation and data foundation that measurably improves efficiency, visibility, and decision-making across the business.

Who We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in software/automation engineering, technical operations, or revenue/business operations, with a proven track record of building technical solutions and driving operational improvements in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Hands-on engineering skills, with proficiency in scripting and programming (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL) and a track record of building integrations against REST APIs and webhooks.

• Experience building AI-powered agents, workflows, and applications, with hands-on use of AI and automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n, and modern LLM/agent frameworks.

• Hands-on experience administering, integrating, or automating core business systems across CRM, ERP, marketing automation, sales engagement, and customer success — such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Marketo, Salesloft, and ChurnZero, or comparable platforms.

• Hands-on experience with data and analytics platforms and warehouses such as Snowflake or similar technologies, including building ETL and API-based data pipelines.

• Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to drive insights from business performance and pipeline data.

• Experience deploying, hosting, and operating applications in production, including familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD, monitoring, and cloud environments.

• Knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and best practices for data handling, security, and compliance in a business environment.

• Proven project management skills with experience running multiple concurrent projects on timelines, using project management tools like Monday.com, Asana, or similar.

• Exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving skills, with a systematic approach to troubleshooting and optimizing workflows.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, IT, Finance, HR, etc.) to ensure alignment on business goals and operational efficiencies.

• Results-driven, with a high sense of urgency and accountability in achieving goals and addressing challenges in a fast-paced environment.

• Growth mindset and adaptability, with a strong drive to learn, evolve with industry trends, and implement best practices to support business success.

• Superior communication skills, capable of clearly articulating insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and able to influence across the organization.

• previous experience in a B2B SaaS organization is highly desirable.

• Creative, proactive problem solver who can anticipate operational challenges, think critically about solutions, and bring new ideas to improve the various business functions.

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans the US and Canada)

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!

• Generous professional development budget

• RRSP/401k matching program and company stock options

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through our BambooHR system (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/09.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact aoda@magnetforensics.com should you require any accommodations. All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment. US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Magnet Forensics handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here.

This role is responsible for  leading OSAT  strategic engagement and commercial management, driving cost optimization, ensuring supply continuity, and owning end-to-end supplier strategy. The role requires strong leadership, program management, and cross-functional influence to align business, engineering, and supply chain objectives while driving long-term value creation.   Key Responsibilities     Lead  commercial negotiations including pricing, LTAs, capacity agreements, price adjustments, and payment terms.   Own  OSAT supplier strategy and act as a key decision driver in supplier selection.   Drive  cost optimization initiatives using structured methodologies such as cost breakdown analysis, should-cost modeling, VA/VE, and localization strategies.   Lead cross-functional  program engagement as a product/program management partner, ensuring OSAT readiness across MP, NPI, transfer, ramp-up, and EOL phases.   Ensure  supply continuity and resilience by proactively managing capacity planning, allocation strategies, and supply risk mitigation.   Identify, assess,  and  mitigate  supply chain risks including capacity constraints, geopolitical exposure, cost volatility, and supplier dependency.   Lead  contract governance including MSA, NDA, pricing frameworks, and commercial agreements, ensuring alignment with business strategy.   Drive  supplier performance management through structured reviews, KPI tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.   Lead  escalation management and resolution of critical issues related to quality, delivery, capacity, and commercial disputes, working with stakeholders internally and externally.   Act  as a strategic interface between internal functions (Engineering, Product Group, Supply Chain, and Finance teams) and OSAT partners to ensure alignment of roadmap, cost, and execution priorities.     3+ years of purchasing/procurement experience, preferably in the semiconductor or electronics industry.  Fluent in English is required; Japanese language proficiency is a plus.   Hands-on experience or familiarity with power-related products and components is a strong advantage.   Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; proficient in PowerPoint for executive-level presentations.  Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.  Experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, or program management is highly preferred. Job Summary    Maintenance Engineer setup new equipment, maintains and troubleshoots semiconductor assembly and inspection equipment to ensure high uptime and production efficiency.    Key Responsibilities       Equipment Setup & Testing:  Set up new test equipment, configure equipment flow strategies, optimize automated testing and inspection systems to improve productivity, quality and yield.   Troubleshooting & Repair:  Diagnose and fix issues on automated test equipment (ATE), or machine hardware, finding permanent solutions to prevent recurring failures. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The Senior Federal Account Executive will be responsible for driving new business growth within U.S. Federal Government agencies by leveraging Magnet Forensics’ comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services. This role is aligned to U.S. Federal Government and Intelligence Community accounts and requires a proven track record of selling into the three letter intelligence agencies as well as military service intelligence commands. Compensation & Benefits The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. As an AI Compiler Engineer on the Renesas HPC team, you will be responsible for driving compiler and code generation technologies that unlock the full compute potential of Renesas next-generation automotive System-on-Chip platforms, including advanced 3 nm silicon for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Your work will directly impact how AI workloads — from perception and sensor fusion to in-vehicle assistants and advanced driver assistance — are translated into highly optimized, safe, and power-efficient execution on Renesas hardware. 
This role bridges software compiler development, AI model lowering/optimization, and hardware-software co-design, enabling Renesas SoCs to deliver industry-competitive performance, efficiency, and functional safety required by multi-domain automotive applications.. 
 
【Job Description】 
・Lead AI compiler architecture across model ingestion, graph optimization, lowering, code generation, and runtime integration 
・Design and implement graph‑level optimizations (operator fusion, quantization‑aware rewrites, memory‑aware scheduling, partitioning) 
・Drive performance optimization for target NPUs, including tiling, tensor layout, and multi‑core execution strategies 
・Partner with SoC and AI accelerator architects to influence hardware features through compiler insights 
・Own performance KPIs for real automotive AI workloads using simulators, profilers, and silicon‑correlated models 
・Ensure compiler outputs meet automotive requirements (real‑time behavior, determinism, quality expectations) 
・Mentor senior engineers and set technical direction without people‑management responsibilities  【Impact & Differentiators】 
Renesas’ Gen5 R-Car automotive SoC lineup, including flagship 3 nm devices like the R-Car X5H, is among the first highly integrated multi-domain automotive SoCs built on advanced 3 nm process technology, designed to run ADAS, IVI, gateway, and next-gen SDV workloads on a centralized platform. These platforms deliver high AI performance (e.g., multi-hundreds of TOPS), scalable chiplet-based acceleration, and power efficiency tailored for electrified and autonomous vehicles while meeting stringent functional safety standards.  An AI Compiler Engineer enables this hardware vision by ensuring that state-of-the-art AI models and computational kernels are efficiently mapped to the silicon fabric — directly enhancing performance, reducing latency and energy, and accelerating software adoption in automotive ecosystems where compute efficiency and safety are paramount.   【Must-Have】 
・MS/PhD (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, EE, or related field 
・Deep experience building AI compilers, accelerator backends, or graph optimization frameworks 
・Strong expertise in graph optimization and performance optimization for NPUs or custom accelerators 
・Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TVM‑like systems, or proprietary compiler IRs 
・Excellent C/C++ and Python skills 
・Solid understanding of AI inference workloads (CNNs, transformers, perception or generative models) 
・Strong communication skills are required, e.g. agile development experience in Scrum team (Product Owner or Scrum Master) 
 
【Nice-to-Have】

Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Senior Principal Researcher.

## About the team:

The Emerging Storage Lab is a research group based at Huawei Canada's Toronto Research Centre that is focused on next-generation data and storage technologies and innovations. Our team comprises graduate computer engineers and computer scientists with diverse industry experience, ranging from 0 to over 20 years. This lab investigates various data storage-related topics, including data management, data catalog, data fabric, file systems, storage networks, and AI storage, aiming to advance the field and drive data storage technological progress in the new AI era.

## About the job:

• Define and drive the long-term research agenda for AI-native data platforms, focusing on vector-native data lakes, intelligent caching, and high-performance retrieval infrastructures for LLMs and RAG.

• Pioneer research in Agent memory systems, Knowledge Bases, and RAG-optimized data intelligence, advancing the field of Data-Centric AI.

• Lead research in dynamic data indexing, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), intelligent chunking/parsing strategies, and real-time context freshness.

• Design and prototype next-generation architectures that unify file storage, data lakes, and low-latency vector indexes into a cohesive, AI-ready data stack.

• Publish groundbreaking research at top-tier venues (e.g., VLDB, SIGIR, NeurIPS, SIGMOD) and secure patents for novel approaches.

• Represent the organization as a thought leader through speaking engagements and active participation in the academic and industry community.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate research into production-ready systems with tangible real-world impact.

• Mentor junior researchers and PhD interns, fostering a collaborative, high-impact research environment.

Lead technical integration for flagship joint development programs (e.g., dexterous robotic hands, industrial robotic arms) alongside strategic partners, working against hard trade-show and customer deadlines. Build reusable driver frameworks and reference architectures that scale across engagements rather than one-off, throwaway integrations.  Represent Renesas technically in front of customer engineering leadership during lab visits and demos.  Produce clear technical documentation (architecture, register maps, bring-up guides) usable by both internal teams and customer engineers. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Strong, demonstrable C/C++ skill at both the driver and application level, not just familiarity.  Direct experience bringing up analog/mixed-signal ICs and sensors on third-party platforms you didn't design, from datasheet and schematic alone.  Deep protocol-level command of I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet-based interfaces.  Experience developing in both bare-metal and RTOS environments. • Provide sound clinical knowledge and skills, act as clinical expert and resource, and provide comprehensive, quality client/family centred health care services.

• Provide coaching on the implementation of behaviour care plans and guide appropriate care plan transitions.
• Aid in the transition of long-term care residents with responsive behaviours (new or existing) between community, hospital and neighbouring long-term care homes (LTCHs).
• Collaborate and communicate with BSRT members, Geriatric Mental Health Outreach Team, Psychogeriatric Resource Consultant, Long Term Care Behaviour Support Outreach Team, hospitals, CCAC, primary care and other health care professionals to provide wraparound care.
• Convene and chair regular Behaviour Rounds that enable front line staff to discuss care plans with internal and external resources.
• Identify the need for additional consultation and/or referrals to external services or specialties and coordinate referrals.
• Assist in the implementation and sustainability of care plans and recommendations of external resources by providing coaching to LTCH staff.
• Document all findings and interventions in a clear and concise manner in the client’s clinical record.
• Document statistics and indicators as part of BSSP and submit regular reports
• Advocate for and, protect the individual rights of, residents/clients.
• Raise client-specific challenges/barriers to supervisor, as a means of identifying systemic issues where broader consultations may be required.

• Provide expert clinical assistance to neighbouring LTCH’s.
• Performing other duties as assigned.

• Provide management oversight for enterprise wireless infrastructure across all locations, and guide the team on Azure networking (Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewalls) and secure hybrid connectivity.

• Ensure enterprise Cloud VoIP solutions are effectively deployed and administered, including voice quality, SIP connectivity, QoS, and call routing.

• Own recurring security metrics and reporting for leadership, and serve as first-line escalation for security incident response.

As a Licensed Practical Nurse your typical day will impact the following ways:

• Creating a comfortable and safe environment that provides opportunities for privacy, dignity, autonomy, independence and individuality and maintenance of personal lifestyle and values.

• Optimizing each resident’s potential to achieve or maintain maximum functional ability.

• Exercises sound nursing judgment by reporting any change in resident’s status in a timely manner to the Registered Nurse as necessary, and takes appropriate action.

• Liaising with medical team members, nurse specialists, consultants and supports effective clinical care for all residents.

• Continually assesses his/her own nursing practice and learning needs.

• Participates in and attends in-service programs provided by the community as well as conferences, seminars, and workshops.

• Documents priorities, target dates and strategies or interventions on the individualized care plan in order to achieve the best possible outcomes for each resident.

• Works with the resident, family members, and interprofessional team to systematically collect data for the nursing history on admission, readmission, and change in status, and provides ongoing assessment and appropriate documentation.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Must haves:

• Diploma in Practical Nursing.

• Current registration as a Licensed Practical Nurse with the College of Nurses BC.

• Successful annual completion of RAI MDS certification as per Ministry of Health requirements for AIS.

• Current First Aid with CPR.

• All applicants must successfully pass the prescribed Criminal Records Check. Applicable to British Columbia applicant.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Experience working with optical component and subsystem suppliers on qualification, issue resolution, or technology development activities.

• Experience with optical laboratory characterization and performance testing.

Reporting to a Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering, you will work alongside experienced hardware, optical, firmware, reliability, manufacturing, and test engineers responsible for designing, ramping, and sustaining Ciena’s flagship WaveLogic™ optical modems. These products enable data rates of up to 1,600 Gbps and are used by many of the world’s largest telecommunications companies and cloud providers. In this role, you will help improve product yield, support manufacturing ramp, investigate technical issues, and drive hardware, test, or process changes that improve product quality and manufacturability.

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop a deep understanding of WaveLogic optical modems, from product design through manufacturing ramp and volume production. ## ## How You Will Contribute:

In this intermediate engineering role, you will support product ramp and sustaining activities, with a focus on yield improvement through test, design, and process improvements. You will combine manufacturing data analysis with hands-on lab debug and cross-functional execution to identify issues, recommend corrective actions, and help drive them to closure.

• Hands-on lab debug: Perform hardware and optical debug of failed modules to identify root cause, validate hypotheses, and define corrective actions using lab measurements and engineering analysis.

• Yield data analysis: Review large-scale manufacturing and test data to assess design, process, or test changes that improve factory yield. Analyze trends, outliers, and common failure modes, then work with cross-functional teams to define practical corrective actions.

• Change management: Plan, coordinate, validate, and release design, test, or process change orders that support yield improvement, ramp readiness, product quality, and manufacturability.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with hardware, optical, firmware, test, reliability, manufacturing, operations, and supplier-facing teams to drive technical issues to closure.

• Documentation and communication: Summarize data analysis, debug findings, recommendations, validation results, and change plans clearly for technical and program stakeholders.

## ## The Must Haves:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Engineering Physics, or equivalent.

• 2–5 years of experience in hardware engineering, electrical engineering, optical hardware, telecommunications equipment, networking platforms, manufacturing test, or another complex electronic-product environment.

• Familiarity with product lifecycle stages, including development, qualification, ramp, volume manufacturing, sustaining, field support, or end-of-life.

• Demonstrated proficiency with statistical analysis techniques such as histogram distributions, Q-Q plots, standard deviation, process capability, Cp, Cpk, or related metrics.

• Experience using scripting or programming tools such as Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automation, or engineering debug.

• Ability to work hands-on in a lab environment and interpret electrical, optical, manufacturing, or system-level test results.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to cross-functional engineering and program teams.

## ## Assets:

• Demonstrated interest in prototyping, embedded hardware, hardware bring-up, or lab-based debug projects.

• Familiarity with coherent optical transceivers, optical modems, DSP-based systems, or high-speed communications hardware.

• Familiarity with high-volume manufacturing, manufacturing test flows, factory yield analysis, or production data systems.

• Experience with optical test equipment, electrical test equipment, automated test platforms, reliability qualification testing, failure analysis, or root-cause corrective action processes.

ABOUT GIATEC:

Giatec Scientific Inc. is a global leader in smart concrete testing technologies, bringing real-time data, AI, and IoT solutions to jobsites worldwide. Our core products - SmartRock®, SmartMix®, and MixPilot® - support the full concrete lifecycle, from mix design and production to placement and performance monitoring, helping teams improve quality, efficiency, and sustainability while reducing concrete’s carbon footprint.

Giatec solutions have been used on 15,000+ projects across 85+ countries, and we’ve been recognized as one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies for three consecutive years. We believe our people are key to our success and are always looking for curious, driven individuals to help shape the future of construction technology.

The expected salary range for this role is between $75,000-$115,000. This role represents an existing vacancy within the organization.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

We’re looking for an IT Operations Lead who thrives at the intersection of traditional IT operations and modern AI-driven automation. This is not your typical “keep the lights on” role—it’s a chance to fundamentally reimagine how a growing technology company runs its internal systems.

As the leader of Giatec's IT function, you'll own the full spectrum of IT operations and guide our existing IT team member across day-to-day support and strategic initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone with 5–8 years of hands-on IT experience who is hungry to lead a small team, automate, and innovate.

Responsibilities:

Day-to-Day IT Operations & Support

• Oversee day-to-day IT support and serve as the senior escalation point, partnering with the existing IT team member to triage and resolve helpdesk tickets and ensure timely resolution.

• Administer and maintain core IT infrastructure including Windows/macOS endpoints, cloud services (Microsoft 365, Azure AD/Entra ID), networking equipment, and office A/V systems

• Manage user accounts, access permissions, and identity lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, role changes) across all enterprise platforms

• Maintain hardware inventory, procurement, and asset lifecycle management for laptops, peripherals, and office equipment

• Monitor system health, uptime, and performance using observability and alerting tools

AI-Powered Automation & Process Innovation

• Identify, design, and implement AI-driven automations to eliminate repetitive IT tasks (e.g., automated provisioning, self-service password resets, intelligent ticket routing, AI-powered knowledge bases)

• Leverage AI and scripting tools (PowerShell, Python, Bash, Power Automate, n8n, or similar) to build workflows that reduce manual intervention and accelerate response times

• Stay current with AI advancements in IT operations and proactively recommend tools and strategies to leadership

Disaster Recovery, Security & Business Continuity

• Design, implement, and regularly test disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity plans, including backup strategies, failover procedures, and recovery time objectives

• Manage backup solutions across cloud and on-premises environments, ensuring data integrity and compliance with retention policies

• Implement and maintain security best practices including endpoint protection, MFA, conditional access policies, vulnerability patching, and security awareness training

• Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, remediating findings and documenting compliance posture

• Coordinate with external vendors and managed security providers as needed

Enterprise IT Initiatives & Strategic Projects

• Lead and execute enterprise IT projects such as SaaS platform rollouts, infrastructure migrations, network upgrades, and system integrations

• Develop, document, and maintain IT policies, procedures, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that scale with the organization

• Evaluate new technologies and vendor solutions, preparing business cases and recommendations for leadership

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Operations to understand their technology needs and deliver solutions

• Manage IT budgets, vendor relationships, and software licensing to optimize cost and value

Team Leadership & Mentorship

• Lead, mentor, and develop Giatec's existing IT team member, setting priorities and managing workload

• Delegate frontline support and operational tasks while focusing on strategy and automation

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the IT function

Must-Haves:

• 5–8 years of experience in IT systems administration, IT operations, or a related technical role

• Experience mentoring, leading, or coordinating IT staff.

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID/Azure AD)

• Proficiency in scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) with a proven track record of automating IT workflows

• Experience with endpoint management tools (Intune, JAMF, or similar MDM solutions)

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall configuration, TCP/IP)

• Demonstrated experience designing and testing disaster recovery and backup solutions

• Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices (CIS benchmarks, NIST, or ISO 27001)

• Excellent communication skills—able to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

• Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with AI/ML tools for IT operations (AIOps platforms, Claude integrations, AI-powered monitoring)

• Cloud certifications (Azure Administrator, AWS SysOps, or equivalent)

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment where wearing multiple hats is the norm

• ITIL certification or experience with IT service management frameworks

• Experience managing SaaS integrations and SSO/SCIM provisioning

About Giatec

Giatec is the category-defining digital concrete technology platform and the global leader in unifying concrete production, delivery, and placement into one intelligent system. As the intelligence backbone from plant to pour and beyond, Giatec transforms real-time data into measurable performance, accelerating construction, lowering carbon impact, reducing risk, and ensuring long-term concrete performance at scale. For more information, visit www.giatecscientific.com.

About Bedrock

Bedrock is Giatec's dedicated Support & Ops team, the foundation the solutions stand on. Bedrock keeps production healthy across every product, drives system improvements and tech debt reduction, closes the continuous delivery automation gap, owns engineering escalations from our customer experience team, and runs cross-product regression. It is a small, high-trust, high-visibility team operating on continuous flow while the rest of engineering runs on two-week cycles.

We are hiring the permanent operating lead for Bedrock. This is a hands-on, player-coach engineering leadership role. You will own the day-to-day health of the platform, set the standard for how we operate, and build the AI systems that let a small team support a large product portfolio. This is an AI-heavy engineering role: we expect you to design, deploy, and supervise agents that assist with support, auto-remediate recurring issues, and resolve bugs.

What You Will Do

• Build the AI support layer. Design, deploy, and supervise AI agents that triage incoming issues, draft and execute fixes, and auto-remediate recurring production problems. You will build the agentic workflows that let Bedrock resolve more with less.

• Fix bugs with agents. Use AI agents to investigate and resolve bugs end to end, from reproduction to fix to verification, escalating only what genuinely needs deep product knowledge or architectural judgment.

• Own escalations. Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 engineering support. Take escalations from the customer experience team, diagnose product-specific and cross-product issues, deploy fixes, and serve as the escalation point for complex production incidents that span team boundaries.

• Keep production healthy. Monitor application and infrastructure health across all Giatec 360 products. Maintain dashboards, alerting thresholds, and runbooks, and catch anomalies before they become customer-facing incidents.

• Lead on-call. Carry and lead an alternating-week on-call rotation supporting Giatec customers worldwide. During your on-call week you are the point of contact 24/7, including nights, weekends, and holidays, followed by a week off rotation. You will define the rotation, mature the runbooks, and set the incident response standard. This is a core, ongoing requirement of the role.

• Automate delivery. Close gaps in the CI/CD pipeline. Automate manual deployment steps, environment provisioning, and the regression infrastructure that runs on every pull request, in collaboration with DevSecOps.

• Guard the platform. Run the end-of-cycle cross-product automated regression sweep to catch breaks in shared platform behavior such as login, navigation, shared data, and AI support accuracy.

• Coach the team. Mentor and lead a rotating team. You will onboard each rotation, set them up to contribute quickly, and make the assignment a genuine growth experience.

• Champion quality. Represent production reality in the Quality Guild, bringing firsthand insight on what breaks, what customers report, and where quality investment is most needed.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on production support, site reliability, or operations work on a live product.

• Demonstrated experience building with AI agents and LLM-based tooling. You have used agentic coding tools to ship real work, and you have a point of view on where agents help and where they need human supervision.

• Strong debugging skills across the stack, from web applications and APIs to data pipelines and integrations. You are comfortable diving into code you did not write.

• Solid grounding in monitoring and observability, incident response, and CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• A production-minded, ownership-driven mindset. You have a strong sense of urgency, you respect deployment risk, and you close the loop rather than just routing tickets.

• Clear written communication. You write runbooks, handoff notes, and customer-facing updates that other people can actually use.

• Willingness and availability to lead an on-call rotation on an every-other-week basis, with full 24/7 coverage during your assigned weeks, supporting a global customer base.

Why This Role

Bedrock is positioned as a selective, high-trust assignment, and its lead is one of the most visible engineering roles in the company. You will be trusted with the production health of the entire Giatec 360 platform, you will build breadth across every product and integration we ship, and you will define how an AI-native support and operations function actually works. This is a rare chance to build an AI-heavy support engineering practice from the foundation up, and to have real impact on reliability, delivery speed, and the day-to-day experience of every Giatec customer.

Do you love working with customers and enjoy figuring out how physical technology works? Giatec Scientific Inc. is looking for a Customer Success and Solutions Specialist to join the team behind MixPilot, our IoT hardware platform for the ready mix concrete industry. You will be the person our customers count on to get their hardware deployed, keep it healthy, and make sure their voice is heard inside Giatec.

This is a customer success role with a hardware dimension, not an engineering role. You do not need an engineering degree or years of electronics experience. If you have strong people skills, you are organized, and you have some hands-on exposure to hardware in any form, whether that is IT support, field equipment, telecom gear, lab devices, or tinkering with electronics as a hobby, we want to hear from you. We will teach you our technology; what we cannot teach is a genuine customer-first mindset and curiosity about how things work.

Giatec operates with an AI-first mindset, and you will use AI tools daily to accelerate reporting, analysis, and communication. If you are already using tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot in your work, you will feel right at home.

Please note: this role requires regular travel to customer sites in the United States and Canada. Candidates must be authorized to travel to the United States upon hire, without the need for visa sponsorship or pre-employment immigration processing, and must be able to work in a hybrid arrangement from our Ottawa, ON headquarters.

WHY JOIN GIATEC?

• Play a central role in deploying MixPilot, Giatec's hardware platform for the ready mix industry, alongside the broader Giatec portfolio as the team scales.

• Work with a creative, driven team passionate about reducing the carbon footprint of concrete and reshaping the construction industry.

• Join a purpose-driven company recognized as one of the fastest-growing in Canada for three consecutive years.

• Competitive compensation, flexible health benefits, and a matching retirement savings program.

• Structured onboarding and hands-on training on our hardware, tools, and industry. You will not be expected to know concrete or IoT on day one.

• Significant opportunity for personal and professional growth as the Customer and Engineering Success team scales.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Customer Success and Field Engagement

• Build trusted relationships with plant managers, QC engineers, dispatch teams, and operations leads at customer sites, and act as their advocate inside Giatec.

• Serve as the main operational point of contact for customers rolling out or actively using MixPilot hardware, keeping them informed, unblocked, and successful.

• Conduct on-site visits across the United States and Canada to support installations, check system health, and lead customer training sessions.

• Turn field observations and customer feedback into actionable input for the Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.

Hardware Rollouts and Support

• Coordinate MixPilot hardware rollouts across customer accounts in North America, tracking milestones, removing blockers, and escalating risks before they affect the customer.

• Perform first-line troubleshooting of field hardware such as gateways, sensors, and accessories, and determine whether a device can be fixed on site or needs to come back for repair. Full training on our products is provided.

• Maintain a clear, current view of every active rollout and account in Salesforce, with consolidated visibility for leadership and cross-functional teams.

Inventory and Capacity Planning

• Own the hardware inventory picture, including receiving, counting, and reconciling stock, tracking units by serial number, and managing the returns process with the Hardware team.

• Keep an eye on demand versus available stock as the customer base scales, and work with Supply Chain, Operations, and Product to prevent shortages that would delay customer rollouts.

• Build simple dashboards and reports that show leadership how capacity, demand, and deployments are trending.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement

• Centralize hardware-related issues from the field, the support team, and customer channels into one structured tracking view.

• Compile weekly and monthly summaries on rollout status, hardware performance, and customer pain points, and translate the data into clear recommendations.

• Use AI tools to draft communications, synthesize site visit notes, speed up reporting, and spot patterns across accounts.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

Required

• Two or more years of professional experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer success, customer support, account management, field service, technical support, or operations coordination.

• Hands-on exposure to physical hardware or electronic devices in some form. This can come from IT or technical support, field service, telecom, lab equipment, or manufacturing. You should be comfortable opening up a device, know roughly what components like connectors, batteries, sensors, resistors, and capacitors are, and enjoy troubleshooting.

• A strong customer service mindset, with the ability to build trust with operational stakeholders and stay calm and constructive when things go wrong.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.

• Strong organizational skills, with experience keeping structured records and producing clear reports or summaries.

• Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot as part of daily work, or a demonstrated eagerness to build that habit quickly.

• A Bachelor's degree or college diploma in engineering, technology, business, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Authorization to travel to the United States immediately upon hire, without the need for visa sponsorship or pre-employment immigration processing. This is a firm requirement for the role.

• Ability to work in a hybrid arrangement from the Ottawa, ON region.

Nice to Have

• Experience diagnosing electronics with tools such as a multimeter, or a background as an electronics or instrumentation technician.

• Experience with IoT devices, hardware deployment, or physical inventory management, including stock counts and SKU or serial-number tracking.

• Proficiency with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce, and tools such as Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Excel.

• Experience in construction, ready mix concrete, manufacturing, or industrial operations.

• Familiarity with the operating rhythms of a SaaS or technology company.

• Additional languages, especially Spanish or French.

Your ideas and actions drive our success. - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. The Senior Technical Support Engineer (T3) is the highest tier of our support organization, serving as a bridge between customer support and engineering. You will own the most complex, ambiguous technical escalations that our T1 and T2 teams cannot resolve - including issues that previously required involvement from the Engineering Run Team. THE ROLE As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will serve as the final escalation point within the support organization. You bring a software development background and deep technical instincts to diagnose root causes, reproduce edge cases, write or read code to understand issues at depth, and work directly with the Engineering team to drive resolution. This is not a traditional support role - you will spend a significant portion of your time doing technical investigation work that sits at the boundary of support and engineering. This role requires participation on a on-call rotation including weekends and holidays. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the most complex technical escalations from T1 and T2, serving as the final line of defense. - Investigate and reproduce customer-reported bugs, data inconsistencies, and integration failures across Rewind's supported platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and more) - Read and write code (primarily in the context of debugging and scripting) to diagnose issues, test hypotheses, and validate fixes - Work directly with Engineering to clearly articulate bugs, provide reproducible test cases, and track fixes through to resolution - Manage and resolve issues in customer environments involving API integrations, OAuth configurations, webhook failures, and platform-level permissions - Handle data restoration requests and complex recovery scenarios requiring deep knowledge of Rewind's backup architecture - Own enterprise customer onboarding when required, including installation, deployment, and education, ensuring the customer is fully set up for success - Help build and maintain the internal knowledge base for complex issue patterns, enabling T1/T2 to self-serve future resolutions - Participate in on-call rotations for P1 incidents affecting enterprise customers - Identify recurring escalation patterns and proactively surface product improvement opportunities to Engineering and Product WHAT YOU BRING Required - 5+ years of experience in a technical support, solutions engineering, or software development role - Computer Science degree or equivalent practical experience (you can read and write code) - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Ruby, JavaScript, or similar) - Strong understanding of REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and modern SaaS integration patterns - Experience with cloud platforms and SaaS ecosystems (Atlassian, GitHub, Shopify, or similar) - AWS - CloudWatch for logs, OpenSearch/Kibana for search infrastructure, SQS/SNS for async processing - Ability to read logs, inspect API responses, and debug issues at the network and application layers - Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can explain a complex technical root cause to a non-technical customer and to an engineer on the same day - Comfort working independently in ambiguous, high-stakes situations with limited documentation Nice to Have - Experience with backup, recovery, or data resilience products - Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or Atlassian platform administration - Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB - Prior experience in a SaaS company at a similar scale (Series B / growth stage) - Experience working with enterprise customers and navigating complex account relationships LOCATION There is a strong preference for candidates based in Ontario for easier collaboration. Compensation Philosophy The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly. If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework. Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind. Why join Rewind At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow. We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries. How Rewind Will Support You We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: - Flexible work hours - Employee stock options - Health benefits - 3 weeks vacation - 7 life leave days - 2 Level Up days for professional development - 1 volunteer day - Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December - Paid parental leave - $2000/year wellness/home office allowance - $5000/year professional development allowance Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. • 3+ years of experience in Go to Market or digital creation roles.

• Experience with content management systems, SEO, traffic metrics, web development, design, and marketing brand strategy.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Previous experience developing engaging digital content.

• Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to deliver results independently or as part of a team.

• Ability to meet deadlines and manage project deliverables.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to stay current with GTM-Ex intakes, product launches, offer changes, and shifting business priorities while ensuring timely and accurate updates across enablement platforms and tools.

• Ability to tailor and promote learning solutions based on audience needs.

• Knowledge of business telecommunications products, tools, and systems.

• Telecommunications knowledge within wireless, wireline, data, and cable technologies is considered an asset.

Rogers Business is seeking experienced Point of Sale Growth Specialists to accelerate adoption of Rogers Point of Sale solutions across Canada.
