• Engage assigned digital and marketing-generated opportunities quickly and professionally.

• Conduct discovery to understand the merchant business, current payment environment, operational needs and growth goals.

• Recommend an appropriate Rogers Point of Sale solution and move qualified opportunities through the sales cycle to activation.

• Maintain complete, accurate and timely opportunity records and next steps.

## Partner with SMB Sellers

• Support direct sellers with discovery, qualification, customer presentations, demonstrations, statement reviews and objection handling while maintaining clearly documented ownership, handoffs and next steps.

• Join qualified customer conversations as the payments expert while reinforcing the direct seller as the relationship owner.

• Help sellers identify RPoS opportunities within new and existing customer conversations.

• Provide clear deal guidance, next steps and ownership at each stage of an assisted opportunity.

## Deliver Payments Expertise

• Explain payment processing, merchant acquiring, pricing considerations and POS capabilities in clear business language.

• Assess competitive scenarios and help customers evaluate the operational and commercial value of changing providers.

• Set accurate expectations regarding application, compliance, credit review, order submission, installation and activation.

• Stay current on payments trends, competitor offerings and relevant merchant needs.

## Build Sales Capability

• Lead office hours, deal clinics, demonstrations and short coaching sessions for SMB sellers.

• Share repeatable talk tracks, success stories, competitive insights and lessons from the field.

• Provide feedback to leadership and cross-functional partners on recurring customer, process and product barriers.

## What You Bring

## Required Qualifications

• Experience selling payment processing, merchant services, financial technology or point-of-sale solutions.

• Demonstrated consultative selling and opportunity-management skills.

• Experience engaging business owners and senior decision-makers.

• Ability to explain payment concepts, pricing and operational value in clear customer language.

• Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation and objection-handling skills.

• Collaborative working style and comfort operating in an assisted-selling model.

• Strong CRM discipline, organization and follow-through.

## Preferred Experience

• Experience reviewing merchant statements or supporting competitive payment-provider takeouts.

• Experience selling to restaurant, retail, hospitality, professional services, or health and wellness merchants.

## How Success Will Be Measured

• Activation and conversion performance for assigned inbound opportunities.

• Assisted activations and measurable contribution to field-led opportunities.

• Pipeline accuracy and completeness, follow-up discipline, speed to initial customer engagement and progression of qualified opportunities through defined sales stages.

This role is suited to a payments professional who enjoys both closing business and helping others win. The strongest candidates will be curious, financially confident, customer-focused and comfortable moving between independent ownership and team selling. They will view the success of the full SMB portfolio as a shared outcome.

The Bank values the contributions of women in economics and finance and awards scholarships to support them in these specializations. This scholarship award also:

About the Supervision Department and the Stablecoin Mandate
A stablecoin is a digital asset designed to maintain a stable value relative to an underlying asset, such as those that are pegged to a reference fiat currency (e.g., CAD). Stablecoins are currently primarily used when trading cryptocurrencies but as the payments landscape in Canada and globally evolves stablecoins are introducing innovative ways for consumers and businesses to make payments. Following Royal Assent of the Stablecoin Act, the Bank of Canada will be responsible for regulating and supervising stablecoin issuers and payment service providers using stablecoins. This includes setting and enforcing expectations related to:

Working across established on-premises environments and emerging Azure-based services, you will help strengthen reliability, security and delivery while supporting the Bank's transition to a cloud-first database model.

You will also have access to the Bank's learning and development resources, including relevant certifications, labs and career development opportunities.

## About the position

This role is intended for senior database professionals who combine strong enterprise Oracle and SQL Server administration expertise with demonstrated cloud platform and migration experience. You will support critical production database environments while helping lead the Bank's continued modernization toward Azure-based database services.

This is not an entry point into cloud technologies. You must have practical experience implementing, administering or migrating production database workloads in the cloud and be prepared to apply that experience immediately. You will help guide migration activities, technical decisions and the evolution of the Bank's Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) platform.

This is a hybrid database administration and cloud modernization role. It combines the administration and operational support of enterprise Oracle and SQL Server environments with cloud migration, automation and platform development responsibilities. You will work across on-premises and Azure-based database services as the Bank transitions toward a standardized DBaaS model.

The platform portfolio includes:

• • Azure SQL Managed Instance, the primary migration platform

• Azure Database for PostgreSQL, a strategic growth platform

• Oracle Database@Azure, used for targeted exception scenarios

## What you will do

In this role, you will administer and support critical enterprise databases while helping deliver the Bank's cloud migration and DBaaS objectives. More specifically, you will:

Database Administration and Production Operations

• • Administer and support enterprise Oracle and SQL Server database environments, including availability, performance, capacity, backup, recovery, patching and security.

• Diagnose and resolve complex database performance, reliability and availability issues.

• Support SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and Oracle technologies such as RAC and Data Guard.

• Participate in incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis and the on-call rotation.

Cloud Migration and Hybrid Operations

• • Assess, plan and execute migrations from on-premises SQL Server and Oracle environments to Azure database platforms.

• Develop migration, testing, cutover, validation, rollback and post-migration support approaches.

• Work with platform and application teams to address dependencies, compatibility, performance and operational readiness across hybrid architectures.

• Help guide technical decisions and drive adoption of standardized database services for new and existing applications.

Cloud Platform Development and Automation

• • Help design, implement and evolve Azure-based database services, including Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL and Oracle Database@Azure.

• Provision, scale, patch and decommission databases using automation, infrastructure as code, scripts, pipelines or templated deployments.

• Develop and maintain automation for provisioning, monitoring, backup and recovery workflows.

• Define and apply platform standards, guardrails and onboarding patterns for application teams.

Security, Resilience and Governance

• • Implement high availability and disaster recovery patterns aligned with enterprise requirements.

• Apply requirements for identity and access management, encryption, auditing, data protection, backup and recovery.

• Implement monitoring, alerting and performance baselines to maintain reliability.

• Contribute to architecture deliverables, governance processes and continuous service improvement.

## What you need to succeed

You bring deep enterprise database administration expertise and demonstrated experience working with production cloud database platforms and migrations. You can operate critical Oracle and SQL Server environments, lead or significantly contribute to complex cloud migrations, and help develop secure, reliable and scalable database services. You are a self-starter and strong collaborator who can work independently and influence decisions across technical teams.

In addition, you have:

About the Supervision Department
The payments landscape in Canada and globally is evolving rapidly, driven by technological advancements that are introducing innovative ways for consumers and businesses to make payments. Under the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), the Bank of Canada is responsible for registering retail payment service providers (PSPs) that perform retail payment activities, maintaining a public registry of PSPs, and supervising PSPs’ compliance with operational risk management, fund safeguarding and reporting requirements.

The Bank assesses whether PSPs are managing risks effectively, identifies areas for improvement, and promotes compliance through a range of supervisory, compliance and enforcement tools. These positions will support the ongoing implementation and continuous improvement of the Retail Payments Supervisory Framework.

What you will do
As a Supervisor within Retail Payments Supervision, you will contribute to fulfilling the Bank’s regulatory mandate by supporting work across one or more areas of Registration, Risk Supervision and Enforcement. You will apply supervisory judgment, strong analysis and sound recommendations to help implement the Bank’s legislative and regulatory authorities under the RPAA.

Depending on the area of focus, you may assess registration applications and scope questions, evaluate PSPs’ operational risk and fund safeguarding practices, review PSP reporting and incidents, investigate potential non-compliance, or support the use of appropriate supervisory, compliance and enforcement tools. You will also contribute to policies, procedures, guidance, training materials and process improvements that strengthen the Bank’s approach to supervising PSPs.

• Apply technical expertise and knowledge of supervisory concepts, principles, practices and methodologies aligned to the Bank’s Supervisory Framework.

• Analyze complex information, identify issues and trends, and develop recommendations for Senior Supervisors, Principal Supervisors, Directors and Executives.

• Collaborate with colleagues and internal or external partners to support registration, supervision, compliance and enforcement activities.

• Contribute to business documentation, operational policies, procedures, guidance, training materials and continuous improvement initiatives.

As an innovative and self-motivated problem solver, you can understand, interpret and analyze complex information and issues, exercise sound judgment, and provide clear recommendations. You communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a broad range of audiences. You are equally comfortable working collaboratively within a team or independently, and you bring strong attention to detail while working under tight timelines.

You have the desire to build the knowledge of the broader financial system, the retail payments ecosystem, retail payment service providers, and the role of regulation and supervision in maintaining a well-functioning system. You are flexible, adaptable and able to align your actions with the needs, priorities and goals of a new and evolving mandate.

About the Supervision Department
The payments landscape in Canada and globally is evolving rapidly, driven by technological advancements that are introducing innovative ways for consumers and businesses to make payments. Under the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), the Bank of Canada is responsible for registering retail payment service providers (PSPs) that perform retail payment activities, maintaining a public registry of PSPs, and ensuring PSPs’ compliance with operational risk management, fund safeguarding and reporting requirements.

The Bank assesses whether PSPs are managing risks effectively, identifies areas for improvement, and promotes compliance through a range of supervisory, compliance and enforcement tools. These positions will support the ongoing implementation and continuous improvement of the Retail Payments Supervisory Framework.

What you will do
As an Analyst within Retail Payments Supervision, you will contribute to fulfilling the Bank’s regulatory mandate by supporting work across one or more areas of Registration, Risk Supervision and Enforcement. You will conduct analysis and support the development of sound recommendations to help fulfil the Bank’s legislative and regulatory authorities under the RPAA.

Depending on the area of focus, you may assess registration applications and scope questions, support the evaluation of PSPs’ operational risk management and fund safeguarding practices, review PSP reporting and incidents, investigate potential non-compliance, or support the use of appropriate supervisory and enforcement tools. As an analyst, you will:

• Analyze issues relating to the Bank’s supervision of PSPs

• Contribute to business documentation, operational policies, procedures, guidance, training materials, and continuous improvement initiatives

• Collaborate with colleagues and internal or external partners to support registration, supervision, compliance and enforcement activities

• Contribute to the development of recommendations to support decision making

What you need to succeed
You have a desire to build your knowledge of the broader financial system, the retail payments ecosystem, financial technology, PSPs, and the role of regulation and supervision in maintaining a well-functioning system. You are flexible, adaptable, and able to align your actions with the needs, priorities, and goals of the Bank’s supervisory mandate.

As an innovative and self-motivated problem solver, you can synthesize and interpret complex information and issues. You bring strong attention to detail while working under tight timelines. You can organize and balance a variety of tasks and are equally comfortable working collaboratively within a team or independently. You communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a broad range of audiences.

• A background or designation in law, finance, accounting, economics, business administration, risk, audit, compliance, or enforcement

• Interest in supervisory technology, including artificial intelligence, to support efficient supervisory practices

##

We are looking for a strategic sales leader to inspire, direct, and scale a team of 5 Channel Sales Account Managers spanning the UK, Ireland, Scotland, Germany, Austria and new market, Israel. This isn't a status-quo management role; it’s a regional business-building mandate. You will drive market dominance across Tier I sales channels, ensuring Avaya remains the top-priority revenue driver for our ecosystem partners across these key international markets.

## Your Strategic Mandate

You will own the regional quota by leading a high-caliber team to master the "multiplier effect." Your mission is to:

• Lead & Scale a High-Performing Team: Recruit, coach, and deploy 5 Channel Account Managers across the defined region, fostering a culture of accountability, strategic execution, and top-tier deal velocity.

• Architect Regional Push Demand: Guide your team in executing territory strategies that compel Tier I partners (Distributors, OEMs, and Mass Merchandisers) to aggressively lead with Avaya solutions.

• Elevate Partner Practices: Direct top-level strategy with key GSIs and Alliance partners across EMEA West, aligning their long-term roadmaps with Avaya’s cloud and service evolution to lock in recurring revenue growth.

• Drive Service Expansion: Enable your team to transform partner business models from transactional hardware sales to high-margin, value-added service offers.

• Cross-Border Leadership: Represent Avaya as the executive sponsor for major regional channel events, executive partner QBRs, and cross-functional go-to-market strategies.

## The Leader We’re Looking For

• Proven People Manager: You have a track record of leading, mentoring, and scaling field-based channel sales teams across multi-country regions.

• EMEA West & Israel Market Expert: Deep understanding of the channel dynamics, cultural nuances, and distribution models specific to the UK, Ireland, Germany, and Israel.

• Strategic Channel Architect: Exceptional ability to build regional territory plans, manage complex regional quotas, and align regional strategy with global corporate goals.

• Executive Presence: Skilled at high-level partner negotiation, serving as an executive sponsor to C-suite contacts within key regional distribution networks.

## Why Avaya?

• We provide the platform; you provide the momentum.

• Regional Authority: Lead a core revenue engine across premier European and Middle Eastern tech hubs while selling a portfolio recognized globally as the gold standard in communication.

• Strategic Autonomy: Shape regional channel strategy, influence GSI practice development, and build an elite, cross-border sales team.

• High-Impact Leadership: Own a major regional quota and directly influence Avaya’s global growth trajectory within a structure that values direct leadership impact.

• Total Ecosystem Support: Full access to dedicated field marketing, advertising, technical engineering, and enablement resources to ensure your team and partners win.

## Key Skills

• Demonstrated experience in AI CX/CCaaS Channel Sales Leadership managing remote field sales teams.

• Proven track record of managing multi-country territories across the UKI, DACH, and/or Israel regions.

• Expertise in enterprise solution selling, GSI practice development, and Tier I distribution strategies.

## Lead the Technology. Own the Customer. Solve the Hard Problems.

Avaya is looking for a Senior Technical Account Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for a critical BAE Systems AP2 environment in Northern Virginia.

This is not a traditional Tier 3 support role. You will be the customer's trusted technical advisor and the senior engineering authority for the account—owning complex technical issues, leading high-priority escalations, strengthening technical governance, and providing hands-on technical leadership across a sophisticated enterprise communications environment.

You will work directly with BAE customer stakeholders while leading and mentoring the engineers supporting the account. You'll be expected to understand the environment end-to-end, diagnose complex problems across Avaya communications platforms, SIP, call flows, network infrastructure, Cisco, Linux, Active Directory, and integrated third-party applications/CPE, and bring the right Avaya resources together to drive issues through resolution.

The role is ideal for an experienced systems, communications, voice, network, or technical support engineer who enjoys being the person customers rely on when the problem is complex, the environment is mission-critical, and the solution requires both deep technical expertise and strong leadership.

## What You'll Own

## Be the Technical Authority for the Account

• Serve as the primary technical SME and customer-facing engineering leader for the BAE AP2 account.

• Develop trusted relationships with customer engineering, IT, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders.

• Understand the customer's technical environment, dependencies, priorities, and risks.

• Act as the senior technical point of contact for complex issues and customer concerns.

• Translate customer requirements and technical challenges into actionable plans for Avaya teams.

• Participate in technical governance and customer meetings, providing status, risk assessments, recommendations, and technical direction.

## Solve Complex Enterprise Communications Problems

This role requires someone who can go beyond individual product troubleshooting and understand how an enterprise environment works as a whole.

You will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues involving:

• Avaya Aura and enterprise communications platforms

• Aura Releases 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10

• SIP and SIP signaling

• Call flows and call-flow troubleshooting

• G650

• Network infrastructure and routing

• Cisco environments

• DNS / DHCP

• LDAP / Active Directory

• Linux

• ServiceNow

• Third-party applications and customer-premises equipment (CPE)

You will perform both Break/Fix troubleshooting and implementation consulting, working across technology layers to isolate root cause and determine the appropriate path to resolution.

## Lead Critical Escalations

• Own high-priority and complex technical escalations from initial assessment through resolution.

• Lead troubleshooting efforts during critical customer-impacting incidents.

• Coordinate Engineering, Product, Support, and other Avaya resources as required.

• Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action.

• Maintain clear and proactive communication with customer stakeholders throughout an escalation.

• Identify recurring issues and proactively address technical risks before they become major customer-impacting events.

## Lead and Mentor the Engineering Team

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the two engineers currently supporting the account.

• Serve as their senior technical escalation point.

• Guide engineers through complex troubleshooting and customer issues.

• Establish technical standards, best practices, and operating procedures.

• Help strengthen the team's technical capabilities and ensure appropriate coverage for the customer environment.

• Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

## Strengthen Technical Governance

• Bring greater technical rigor and operational discipline to the customer relationship.

• Partner with account leadership to identify technical risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Ensure technical commitments and action items are clearly defined, tracked, and communicated.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, escalation processes, and knowledge resources.

• Help ensure the customer's technical priorities remain aligned across Avaya organizations.

## ## What We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical capability with customer leadership.

## Required

• 8+ years of experience in systems engineering, communications engineering, network engineering, technical support, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Hands-on experience supporting Avaya Aura environments.

• Strong SIP knowledge and troubleshooting experience.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze and troubleshoot call flows.

• Experience with enterprise network infrastructure and integrated third-party applications/CPE.

• Working knowledge of Cisco, Linux, Active Directory/LDAP, DNS, DHCP, routers, and ServiceNow.

• Experience supporting complex enterprise communications or IT environments.

• Experience leading complex technical customer engagements and escalations.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot problems spanning multiple technologies and infrastructure layers.

• Experience providing technical leadership or mentorship to other engineers.

• Strong customer-facing communication and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical audiences and senior customer stakeholders.

• Ability to operate calmly and effectively during high-pressure, customer-impacting incidents.

• Active TS/SCI clearance.

• Active Full-Scope Polygraph — required prior to hire.

• U.S. work authorization required; no visa sponsorship available.

• Ability to work in the Northern Virginia / Dulles, VA area.

##

## Preferred

• Experience supporting BAE Systems or other defense/intelligence customers.

• Experience supporting federal government or mission-critical environments.

• Experience with multiple generations of Avaya Aura.

• SIP certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

• Deep voice/telecommunications and IP networking experience.

• Experience with G650.

• Strong Cisco networking experience.

• Experience with government security or compliance environments.

• Experience with CMMC, FedRAMP, FISMA, or similar frameworks.

• ITIL certification or experience working in an ITIL-based support organization.

• Experience managing major incidents or enterprise technical escalations.

• Experience leading distributed engineering or technical support teams.

##

## Why This Role

This is an opportunity to become the technical owner and trusted advisor for a strategically important customer environment.

You won't simply be working tickets or waiting for escalations to arrive. You'll know the customer's environment, build relationships with its technical leaders, lead the response when critical issues occur, and help shape how the account is technically supported.

If you are the engineer customers call when the problem is complicated, the environment is critical, and someone needs to take ownership, this role is built for you.

The pay range for this opportunity is from $116,800 to $157,700 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration.  With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit  www.bwxt.com . Follow us on  LinkedIn ,  X ,  Facebook  and  Instagram .

  BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.  

   

  If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.   

   

   Position Overview:   

  As our Thermal Hydraulic Core Design Engineer, you will contribute to a variety of projects in a collaborative team environment, performing thermal analysis of advanced core designs that include a variety of fuel systems, cycle, and coolant types. The Engineer will work within the core design team, interacting with neutronic core design, fuel performance, mechanical, and systems engineers. Depending on the candidate’s qualifications, the role may involve supporting the development of core thermal modeling, simulation, and optimization tools.  

   

   Location:    

  On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office  

   

   Your Day to Day as a Thermal Hydraulic Core Design Engineer:    

 

  Perform thermal analysis of advanced core designs that include a variety of fuel systems, cycle, and coolant types.  

  Control a broad scope of studies, from preconceptual through reference design.  

  Perform a range of core thermal analysis from quick scoping to design quality.  

  Support the development of core thermal modeling, simulation, and optimization.  

  Interact with neutronic core design, fuel performance, mechanical, and system engineers.   

  Work in a core design team contributing to a variety of projects.  

 

   

   Required Qualifications:   

 

  A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.  

  A minimum of four (4) years of related experience is required.  

  Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.  

  Must be able to learn a variety of new procedures, processes and tools while maintaining various stages of production.  

  Must possess understanding of design control and configuration control concepts and project engineering activities (task plans, schedules).  

  Must be a U.S. citizen.   

  Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, which may be required.  

 

   

   Preferred Qualifications:   

 

  Master’s degree in nuclear or mechanical engineering with a focus on thermal hydraulics.  

  Prior experience with verification and validation of thermal analysis tools.  

  Familiarity with physics tools such as Ansys, Relap5-3D, and Flownex.  

  Knowledge of programming languages such as FORTRAN, Python, C, and C++.  

 

   

   What We Offer:   

 

  Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.  

  Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.   

  Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.  

  An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.  

  The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.   

  Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

• Oversee and direct the creation of high-quality regulatory deliverables, including technical reports, topical reports, and license application content to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and regulatory expectations.

• Define and drive regulatory strategy to address major technical and programmatic challenges associated with BWXT AT’s reactor technology development, leading cross functional efforts to resolve complex issues.

• Serve as the executive owner of the licensing basis for one or more reactor technologies, providing leadership in regulatory defense and customer engagement.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to develop technical design bases and integrate regulatory requirements into reactor technology.

• Support the creation of testing programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Lead high level regulatory discussions on technical and programmatic matters, representing the program in strategic interactions with regulators, customers, and key partners.

• Collaborate with project management teams to develop budgets and schedules that achieve regulatory outcomes.

• Facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders concerning the execution of licensing activities and program plans.

• Perform additional organizational leadership duties as needed to advance program and business objectives.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in an engineering or physics discipline is required (i.e. nuclear, mechanical, civil, environmental engineering, or a related field).

• At least twenty (20) years in management or a supervisory role is required.

• Must have demonstrated experience leading the design, evaluation, and technological development of nuclear systems, with a proven ability to guide complex technical programs at an organizational level.

• Must demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, accurately, and timely in both written and verbal formats.

• Must have a proven track record of building and sustaining effective relationships with high level internal and external stakeholders, fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and organizations.

• Must have exceptional interpersonal skills necessary to manage simultaneous licensing activities across various stakeholders.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) and/or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced engineering degree is preferred (M.S. or higher).

• Experience leading and managing teams within regulatory/licensing or engineering environments is preferred.

Success in this role is measured through the implementation of sustainable improvements that enhance operational performance and support a culture of continuous improvement throughout the facility.  

   

   Responsibilities   

   

 

  Lead and facilitate continuous improvement projects using Lean Six Sigma methodologies.  

  Execute Kaizen events, waste elimination activities, and process improvement initiatives.  

  Identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, capacity, safety, and cost performance.  

  Implement sustainable solutions and verify achievement of targeted results.  

  Monitor project progress and communicate outcomes to site leadership.  

  Facilitate root cause analysis using structured problem-solving tools such as DMAIC, A3 Problem Solving, 5 Why Analysis, Fishbone Diagrams, and Pareto Analysis.

  Facilitate workshops and improvement events.  

  Encourage employee engagement and support continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.  

  Track and report project savings and operational performance metrics.  

  Maintain the continuous improvement project pipeline and status reporting.  

  Present recommendations, updates, and results to site leadership.  

 

   

   Qualifications   

   

  Education & Experience   

 

  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing Technology, Business, or a related field.  

  An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.  

  3 to 7 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering, or continuous improvement.  

  Demonstrated success leading Lean or Six Sigma projects within a manufacturing environment.  

  Experience managing projects from identification through successful implementation.

  TPM Certification  

  Kaizen Certification  

  Lean Practitioner Certification  

 

   

   Required Certification

   Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities   

   

 

  Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.  

  Proficiency in root cause analysis and structured problem-solving techniques.  

  Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.  

  Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  

  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  

  Strong facilitation and presentation skills.  

  Ability to influence and drive change without direct authority.  

  Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft Office Suite.

 AmerCable is an ISO 9001:2015-certified manufacturer of jacketed electrical power, control and instrumentation cables. The company’s core markets, mining, oil and gas, and industrial, require complex cable designs that can operate reliably over long periods of time in harsh operating environments.

  Location:  El Dorado, Arkansas  Employment Type:  Full-Time, Permanent 

   

  Summary  

 As the Senior HSE Specialist, you will serve as the primary Health, Safety and Environmental resource for site operations, driving a culture where safety, environmental stewardship, and regulatory compliance are embedded into daily operations. In this role, you will lead the implementation of occupational safety, health, and environmental programs while partnering with site leadership, employees, and corporate teams to proactively identify risks, prevent incidents, and strengthen Mattr's commitment to an incident-and-injury-free workplace. You will play a critical role in advancing operational excellence, environmental compliance, employee engagement, and sustainability initiatives across the site and, where required, multiple facilities. 

   

  Responsibilities  

  Lead HSE Excellence and Regulatory Compliance  

 

 Serve as the site subject matter expert for health, safety, and environmental matters. 

 Provide technical guidance on regulatory requirements, environmental compliance, and workplace safety programs. 

 Lead the implementation and administration of corporate, divisional, and site HSE programs and management systems. 

 Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal standards. 

 Act as a visible safety leader through regular engagement with employees and operational teams. 

 

  Drive Risk Identification and Incident Prevention  

 

 Lead complex incident investigations and root cause analyses. 

 Identify systemic risks and recommend preventive and corrective actions. 

 Support workplace inspections, Active Safety Audits (ASAs), and Hazard Identifications (HazIDs). 

 Promote proactive risk management practices that reduce incidents and improve workplace safety performance. 

 Champion Mattr's incident-and-injury-free philosophy across site operations. 

 

  Build and Strengthen Safety Culture  

 

 Partner with site management, supervisors, and employees to create a proactive and inclusive safety culture. 

 Facilitate safety meetings, toolbox talks, recognition programs, and employee engagement initiatives. 

 Encourage employee participation in hazard identification, reporting, and resolution activities. 

 Support leaders in integrating HSE requirements into daily operational planning. 

 Provide coaching and mentorship to HSE personnel and site leaders. 

 

  Manage HSE Data and Performance Reporting  

 

 Analyze HSE metrics and trends to identify opportunities for improvement. 

 Maintain audit-ready records, training documentation, permits, and compliance files. 

 Utilize systems such as Velocity, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and other reporting tools to manage HSE information. 

 Develop and communicate performance reports and recommendations that support informed decision-making and risk reduction. 

 

  Coordinate Environmental and Sustainability Programs  

 

 Ensure compliance with environmental requirements involving waste management, wastewater permitting, stormwater programs, and air emissions. 

 Maintain environmental permits, reporting schedules, and compliance records. 

 Partner with operations teams to identify pollution prevention opportunities and environmental improvements. 

 Support environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives and sustainability programs. 

 Help advance site environmental performance while maintaining compliance excellence. 

 

  Support Critical HSE Programs  

 

 Ensure effective execution of key health, safety, and environmental programs including: 

 

 Hearing Conservation and Industrial Hygiene monitoring 

 Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) 

 Machine Guarding 

 Elevated Work and Fall Protection 

 Hot Work 

 Ergonomics 

 Powered Industrial Vehicles 

 Contractor Safety Management 

 HSE Training and Competency Management 

 Regulated Waste Management 

 Stormwater and Wastewater Compliance 

 Tier II and Air Compliance requirements, as applicable 

 

 Support regional initiatives and multiple facilities as required.

 7 to 10 years of Health, Safety, and Environmental experience. 

 Professional certification such as CHMM, ASP, CSP, CIH, or an equivalent HSE credential. 

 Strong experience supporting manufacturing or industrial operations. 

 Demonstrated expertise in incident investigation, root cause analysis, regulatory compliance, environmental compliance, industrial hygiene, risk assessment, and HSE management systems. 

 Proven ability to influence, coach, and collaborate across all levels of an organization. 

 Strong communication, leadership, problem-solving, and data analysis skills.

Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills, including the ability to clearly define requirements and introduce new technical concepts. Advantages    Experience researching AI security, LLM vulnerabilities, prompt injection, model behavior, AI agents, or adversarial machine learning.  Experience developing or evaluating AI-powered security systems.  A record of security publications, vulnerability disclosures, or presentations at leading security conferences.  Experience transforming research findings into production-grade security capabilities.  Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks, inference infrastructure, model internals, and agent orchestration.

We're looking for a motivated, hands-on Materials and Geotechnical Technician/Technologist to help make sure the ground, concrete, and asphalt behind our region's infrastructure are built to last. GEMTEC knows that creative, talented people are our greatest asset and as an employee-owned firm, investing in your development is investing in our own future.

We currently have openings for Materials and Geotechnical Technician(s)/Technologist(s) in our Saint John office.

The ideal candidate has some experience in general construction, is comfortable moving between outdoor fieldwork and lab settings, and brings curiosity and attention to detail to everything they do.

What You’ll Bring:

• College diploma in Civil Engineering Technology (or a related field).

• Two years' experience in civil construction.

• Experience with materials testing and inspection.

• Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.

• Strong multi-tasking, organization, and planning skills.

• Comfortable lifting 30–50 lbs on a regular basis.

• Valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle required for work-related travel.

What You’ll Do:

• Laboratory testing of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt.

• Field testing and sampling of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt.

• A mix of office, laboratory, and field work across materials testing and geotechnical engineering projects.

• Conduct construction surveys to support engineering projects.

• Work alongside engineers, technologists, and project teams to keep projects moving.

• Communicate project updates, milestones, and potential issues to clients in a clear and professional manner.

• Other duties as required; no two days look quite the same.

Why GEMTEC?

• Seasonal and term positions are available.

• Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.

• Retirement savings plan with employer match.

• As a 100% employee-owned firm, GEMTEC employees have a real stake in the work you do and the company you help build.

Our presence in Ontario is expanding, and we are searching for various roles throughout the GTA, including a Senior Geotechnical Engineer within our Geotechnical Division based in our Sudbury office (Other office locations may be considered for the right candidate). • Actively collaborate with Branch Managers on business planning and market strategy.

• Perform project management functions, including proposal preparation, budget estimation, scheduling, scope management, project summary report preparation, maintaining quality throughout the project, and implementing improvements.

• Collaborate with junior and intermediate staff to complete geotechnical analysis and reporting.

Preference will be given to candidates with Ministry of Transportation foundation engineering project experience.

• Be motivated to provide excellent client service and enjoy working in a multi-disciplinary team environment.

We're looking for a Hydrogeologist to join our growing team in Fredericton, NB. This role is also open to our other New Brunswick offices in Moncton, Saint John, Bathurst or Grand Falls.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We’re a perfect sized employee-owned, 400-person multi-disciplinary consulting firm that is large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

A typical day on the job might look like:

• Provide technical support to a wide variety of physical hydrogeology projects and prepare proposals and reports.

• Design field investigations such as drilling, coring and test pitting logging; soil and bedrock description and characterization; monitoring well and groundwater/surface water instrumentation installation; single- and multi-well pumping tests; soil, groundwater, sediment and surface water sampling; infiltration rate testing; and private well monitoring.

• Prepare technical proposals and reports, including hydrogeological characterization assessments; impact assessments, groundwater supply and source water protection studies and approvals; quarry, mine pit and construction dewatering assessments and permitting; water balance assessments; and groundwater and surface water interaction and monitoring programs.

• Develop and maintain relationships with clients.

The good stuff you get:

• Fair pay plus extra: competitive salary with year-end profit-sharing bonus.

• Complete health & dental coverage including vision, paramedical services, and Teladoc.

• Retirement planning made easier with a 5% employer match on your contributions.

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days) plus Employee & Family Assistance Program when you need it.

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year).

Your background and what you bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in earth science, environmental science or geological/geotechnical/civil engineering with an emphasis in water resources or hydrogeology.

• Professional license in NB (i.e., P.Geo. or P.Eng.)

• 5 to 10 years of relevant professional related experience (preferably in consulting).

• Knowledge and understanding of provincial and federal regulatory frameworks for groundwater withdrawal/use, drinking water supply, contaminated sites assessment and management, and environmental assessment is required.

• Familiarity with infrastructure, pit and quarry dewatering as well as exploration and development of community water supplies is required, with specific experience in the mining industry considered an asset.

• Groundwater flow and transport modeling experience is considered an asset.

• Valid NB driver’s license.

Forte d'une tradition d'excellence en ingénierie, de fiabilité et de service à la clientèle de premier ordre dans le secteur, Télésat est devenue l'un des opérateurs mondiaux de satellites les plus importants et les plus prospères. Telesat Lightspeed, notre réseau révolutionnaire de satellites en orbite basse (LEO), dont la mise en service est prévue en 2027, redéfinira la connectivité mondiale à bande passante pour les utilisateurs professionnels en offrant une capacité, une sécurité et une résilience élevées, ainsi que des prix abordables, avec une latence ultra-faible et des vitesses comparables à celles de la fibre optique. Télésat a son siège social à Ottawa, au Canada, et possède des bureaux et des installations partout dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus, consultez le site www.telesat.com. English version to follow En tant que membre de l’équipe des opérations des satellites LEO, le contrôleur de satellites LEO assurera la surveillance et le contrôle des satellites et effectuera toutes les activités prévues et imprévues liées à l’exploitation des satellites Lightspeed de Telesat. Le contrôleur de satellites LEO travaille 24 heures sur 24 au Centre des opérations des satellites Lightspeed; il collabore étroitement avec l’ingénieur des opérations de vol pour exploiter les systèmes de contrôle des satellites qui exécutent et surveillent les activités des satellites; il réagit aux anomalies des satellites ou des systèmes et en fait rapport. Responsabilités principales Effectuer toutes les activités prévues et imprévues liées à l’exploitation des satellites Telesat Lightspeed; Participer à toutes les activités d’exploitation des satellites, prévues et imprévues, liées à l’entretien et au développement de l’équipement de contrôle au sol et des systèmes de contrôle des satellites; Surveiller et analyser les données de télémétrie générées par les satellites afin de détecter toute anomalie et prendre les mesures appropriées au besoin; Préparer, télécharger et surveiller les manœuvres d’orbite et d’attitude conformément aux procédures établies; Assurer la préparation et la planification précises des activités des satellites telles que fournies par d’autres groupes d’exploitation des satellites; Assurer la validation et le signalement des défaillances pour l’ensemble du matériel, des logiciels et de l’équipement de soutien auxiliaire des systèmes de contrôle des satellites. Reconnaître, signaler et déterminer la réponse appropriée à toutes les anomalies des satellites ou au sol en temps opportun, en mettant en œuvre les procédures d’urgence appropriées pour les satellites et d’autres instructions spécifiées. Fournir des rapports détaillés et de la documentation d’appui pour toutes les anomalies des satellites, les défaillances d’équipement, les problèmes logiciels et les pannes de communication. Maintenir un haut niveau de compétence dans l’utilisation des systèmes d’exploitation et des programmes informatiques, ainsi que des programmes informatiques spécialisés conçus sur mesure et des outils d’analyse utilisés au Centre de contrôle des satellites. Formation et expérience Diplôme de technologue d’au moins trois (3) ans en communications, en électrique ou en génie électronique, ou l’équivalent. La connaissance des systèmes de contrôle des satellites constitue un atout; Une connaissance de base de la conception des sous-systèmes satellitaires et des orbites constitue un atout; Solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes, en prise de décision en temps réel, en planification et en organisation; Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit; Connaissance du français à l’oral et à l’écrit est un atout; Autonome et motivé, capable de travailler efficacement tant de façon individuelle qu’en équipe. Compétences, prise de décision et supervision Grande capacité à suivre les procédures techniques d’exploitation des satellites; Capacité à travailler sans supervision et à diriger une petite équipe; Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’ingénieur des opérations de vol; D’excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles sont essentielles, car le contrôleur de satellites interagit intensivement avec les équipes d’ingénierie des opérations satellitaires ainsi qu’avec d’autres segments du système Lightspeed; Capacité à rester vigilant en tout temps dans un environnement où la conscience situationnelle et l’excellence opérationnelle sont cruciales pour maintenir la santé de la constellation de satellites Lightspeed; Capacité à réagir rapidement et avec précision aux anomalies des satellites; être très attentif à un certain nombre d’alarmes visuelles et sonores. Il est nécessaire de porter une attention constante aux textes imprimés, aux écrans d’ordinateur et aux informations transmises verbalement par les collègues, les gestionnaires et les nombreux experts techniques qui interagissent régulièrement avec le Centre des opérations satellitaires. Excellentes compétences en gestion du temps dans un environnement multitâche. Capacité à apprendre de façon continue par l’autoformation et la formation en milieu de travail Maîtrise des outils logiciels; des compétences en programmation et en développement sont considérées comme un atout Le candidat retenu doit posséder (ou être admissible à obtenir) une autorisation de sécurité CGP. Le lieu de travail se situe à notre Centre principal d’exploitation des satellites (SOC) à Gatineau, ou à notre SOC secondaire à Ottawa, situé à environ 3 km de là. Des primes de quarts de travail sont versées pour couvrir le travail après les heures normales, les fins de semaine et les jours fériés, ainsi que certaines heures supplémentaires, selon la demande. Nous nous engageons à offrir la meilleure expérience possible aux candidats, y compris en mettant en place les mesures d’adaptation nécessaires à chaque étape de notre processus d’entrevue. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com As a member of the LEO Satellite Operations team, the LEO Satellite Controller will monitor, and control satellites and perform all scheduled and non-scheduled activities associated with the operation of Telesat Lightspeed satellites. The LEO Satellite Controller works around the clock in Lightspeed Satellite Operations Centre; closely with the Flight Operations Engineer Operating the Satellite Control Systems that execute and monitor satellite activities; respond and report satellite or system anomalies. Main Responsibilities Perform all scheduled and non-scheduled activities associated with the operation of Telesat Lightspeed satellites; Assist with all scheduled and non-scheduled satellite operations activities associated with the maintenance and development of Satellite Ground Control Equipment and Satellite Control Systems; Monitor and analyze satellite generated telemetry data for anomalous satellite conditions and take appropriate action as required; Prepare, upload and monitor orbit and attitude maneuvers in accordance with established procedures; Ensure accurate preparation and scheduling of satellite activities as provided by other Satellite Operations groups; Provide validation and deficiency reporting for all Satellite Control system hardware, software and ancillary support equipment. Recognize report and determine the correct response to all satellite or ground discrepancies in a timely manner by instituting appropriate satellite emergency procedures and other specified instructions. Provide detailed reports and support documentation for all satellite discrepancies, equipment malfunctions, software issues and communications outages. Maintain high proficiency in the use of computer operating systems and programs and special use custom designed computer programs and analysis tools utilized in the Satellite Control Centre. Education and Experience Minimum 3-year technologist diploma in Communications, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering or equivalent. Knowledge of satellite control systems is an asset; Basic knowledge of satellite subsystems design and orbits is an asset; Strong analytical, problem solving, real-time decision-making, planning and organizational skills; Excellent verbal and written English communications skills; Verbal and written French communications skills is an asset; Independent and self-motivated, with the ability to work effectively both individually and in a team environment. Skills, Decision Making and Supervision Strong ability to follow technical satellite operations procedures; Ability to work unsupervised and lead a small team; Ability to work closely with Flight Operations Engineer; Excellent interpersonal skills are essential as the Satellite Controller interfaces extensively with Satellite Operations engineering teams as well as other Lightspeed system segments; The ability to remain alert at all hours in an environment where situational awareness and excellence in operations are critical to maintaining the health of the Lightspeed satellite constellation; Ability to quickly and accurately respond to satellite anomalies; be keenly aware of a number of visual and audio alarms. There is a continuous requirement to give close attention to printed text, computer screens and information given verbally by co-workers, managers and numerous technical experts who interface with the Satellite Operations Centre on an ongoing basis. Well-developed time management skills in a multi-tasking environment. Disciplined ability to continuously learn through self-study and OJT Proficiency in use of software tools with programming/development skills considered an asset Successful candidate must possess (or be eligible to obtain) a CGP security clearance. • Please indicate your last complete year of study and your GPA

• Good with details, time management, and planning.

• Proficient in verbal and written communication.

• Previous work terms in Software Development or relevant projects

• You have used tools to manage, build, and test code that you have written.

Aperçu du poste :

Calian est à la recherche d’une ressource en physique – spécialiste pour soutenir Recherche et développement pour la défense Canada (RDDC). Le rôle consiste à soutenir la recherche en modélisation et en simulation en caractérisant des phénomènes physiques, en recueillant et en analysant des données expérimentales et en apportant une expertise en physique à l’évaluation de systèmes et de capacités militaires.

Responsabilités :

• Fournir une expertise en physique pour soutenir les modèles numériques, les simulations ainsi que l’analyse des systèmes et des capacités militaires.

• Soutenir la caractérisation des phénomènes physiques utilisés en modélisation et en simulation, notamment l’électro-optique, les signatures infrarouges, le suivi et le guidage de cibles, la propagation atmosphérique, les systèmes laser et les systèmes radar, selon les tâches assignées.

• Soutenir la collecte de données expérimentales et en laboratoire et analyser les données recueillies afin d’améliorer et de valider les modèles numériques.

• Contribuer à la vérification, à la validation et à l’amélioration itérative des modèles afin d’atteindre le niveau de fidélité requis.

• Soutenir l’analyse des simulations et préparer des rapports techniques présentant les méthodes, les résultats et les constatations.

• Soutenir le transfert de connaissances, les présentations techniques et la formation des partenaires du projet.

Qualifications :

• Baccalauréat, maîtrise ou doctorat en physique, en génie physique, en génie informatique, en génie aérospatial, en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou en sciences appliquées.

• Expérience dans les domaines d’expertise pertinents :

o 12 mois d’expérience dans le domaine des phénomènes physiques électro-optiques.

o 12 mois d’expérience dans le domaine des phénomènes physiques liés à la signature infrarouge des plateformes (p. ex., navires, aéronefs, véhicules) et/ou des leurres.

o 12 mois d’expérience dans le domaine des phénomènes physiques liés au suivi ou au guidage de cibles.

o 12 mois d’expérience dans le domaine de la propagation atmosphérique de la lumière et des lasers.

o 12 mois d’expérience en laboratoire dans la collecte de données provenant de circuits électroniques.

o 12 mois d’expérience avec des systèmes laser.

o 12 mois d’expérience avec des systèmes radar (émetteurs et récepteurs, autodirecteurs ou contre-mesures).

Exigences supplémentaires :

• Des déplacements au Canada ou à l’étranger peuvent être requis selon la tâche, notamment pour la collecte de données, la mise en place d’essais, le transfert de connaissances ou des présentations.

• Les exigences en matière de sécurité varient selon le travail assigné et peuvent aller de la cote de fiabilité à SECRET ou SECRET NATO.

• Support characterization of physical phenomena used in modelling and simulation, including electro-optics, infrared signatures, target tracking and guidance, atmospheric propagation, laser systems and radar systems, as applicable to assigned tasks.

• Support experimental and laboratory data collection and analyze collected data to improve and validate digital models.

• Support simulation analysis and prepare technical reports presenting methods, results and findings.

## Additional Requirements

• Travel within Canada or internationally may be required depending on the task, including for data gathering, test set-ups, knowledge transfer or presentations.

• Security requirements vary by assigned work and may range from Reliability to SECRET or NATO SECRET.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) psychothérapeute autorisé(e) pour se joindre à notre équipe au Centre de surveillance de l’immigration de l’Agence des services frontaliers du Canada (ASFC) à Laval.

Dans ce rôle unique et valorisant, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le soutien du bien-être psychologique de personnes provenant de divers contextes culturels et sociaux. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une clientèle présentant des besoins variés en santé mentale, tout en contribuant à offrir un environnement de soins respectueux, sécuritaire et centré sur la personne.

Que vous souhaitiez compléter votre pratique privée ou diversifier votre expérience clinique, cette opportunité vous permettra d’avoir un impact significatif auprès d’une clientèle souvent confrontée à des défis d’adaptation, de stress et de vulnérabilité.

Pourquoi rejoindre Calian?

• Contribuez concrètement à la santé mentale et au mieux-être de personnes issues de parcours de vie variés.

• Exercez votre profession dans un environnement stimulant, collaboratif et axé sur les meilleures pratiques cliniques.

• Capacité à établir rapidement une relation de confiance avec une clientèle diversifiée.

• Solide jugement clinique et autonomie professionnelle.

• Aptitude à travailler efficacement au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire.

## Position Overview

We are seeking experienced Nurse Practitioners to join a virtual primary care program supporting patients across Saskatchewan who do not currently have access to a family physician, Nurse Practitioner, or established primary care team.

CareersInnerInfo
This initiative is designed to improve access to timely primary care while providing patients with safe, convenient and clinically appropriate care through secure virtual consultations. The program will support Saskatchewan residents until they can be connected with a permanent primary care provider. Nurse Practitioners will provide comprehensive primary care through virtual encounters, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, diagnostic investigation, referrals and appropriate follow-up.

## Responsibilities

As a Virtual Primary Care Nurse Practitioner, you will independently assess and manage patients presenting with a broad range of primary care concerns through secure virtual consultations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Conduct virtual patient assessments by video and/or telephone.

• Assess symptoms, medical history and presenting concerns and develop appropriate clinical impressions and treatment plans.

• Provide medical advice, treatment and patient education.

• Prescribe and renew medications within your authorized scope of practice.

• Order and review laboratory investigations and diagnostic imaging as clinically appropriate.

• Initiate referrals to specialists and other healthcare services.

• Determine when a patient's condition cannot be safely or effectively managed virtually and facilitate appropriate in-person follow-up.

• Direct patients to primary care clinics, urgent care or emergency departments when clinically indicated.

• Provide appropriate follow-up for investigations, referrals and ongoing clinical concerns.

• Follow evidence-based clinical guidelines and established virtual-care protocols.

• Maintain accurate, timely and complete clinical documentation following each encounter.

• Participate in clinical quality, patient safety, privacy, consent and emergency-response procedures.

## Qualifications

• Hold or be eligible to obtain active licensure as a Nurse Practitioner through the College of Registered Nurses of Saskatchewan (CRNS).

• Be eligible to obtain a formal Appointment to the Practitioner Staff of the Saskatchewan Health Authority (SHA).

• Maintain active professional liability/malpractice insurance with coverage appropriate for the services being provided.

• Be able to successfully complete all required SHA credentialing requirements.

• Provide professional references.

• Provide a current criminal record check, including a vulnerable sector search.

• Provide evidence of professional standing and other credentialing documentation as required.

Experience

The successful candidate will ideally bring:

• Experience practising as a Nurse Practitioner in primary care, family practice, community health, urgent care or a comparable clinical environment.

• Strong clinical assessment and independent decision-making skills.

• Experience managing a broad range of common primary care presentations.

• Demonstrated competence in prescribing, diagnostic investigation, referrals and ongoing patient management.

• Strong understanding of when virtual care is clinically appropriate and when an in-person assessment or higher level of care is required.

• Experience providing virtual care or telehealth services considered an asset.

• Experience working with electronic medical records and digital clinical systems.

• Strong written clinical documentation skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly and compassionately with patients through telephone and video-based encounters.

• Ability to practise independently while collaborating effectively with physicians, clinical support teams and other healthcare providers.

Schedule

The program is expected to provide virtual primary care at minimum during typical weekday office hours, approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional evening and weekend coverage may also be offered based on patient demand.

The Patient Population

The program supports Saskatchewan residents who currently do not have a regular family physician, Nurse Practitioner or primary care team. Virtual care is intended to provide accessible primary care while patients await attachment to a permanent provider.

Compensation

Employee salary $95/hour

Why Join Us?

At Calian, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports your well-being, growth, and long-term success:

• Supportive Team Environment: You will work in a collaborative environment alongside healthcare professionals, coordinators, and case managers who are passionate about improving patient outcomes.

• Professional Growth: We invest in our people. You will have opportunities to expand your knowledge in healthcare systems, and pharmaceutical support services. You will also have access to formal leadership programs designed to help you grow professionally.

• Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits plan, and access to wellness programs that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Mentorship & Collaboration: Participate in events like our speed mentoring sessions to connect with senior leaders and peers across the organization.

Join a team that values collaboration, resilience, excellence, and sustainability—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

## Position Overview

We are seeking a Registered Psychologist to provide psychological risk assessment services within a federal correctional healthcare environment in New Brunswick.

This opportunity is well suited to a psychologist with experience in forensic, correctional, clinical or counselling psychology who is comfortable conducting comprehensive psychological assessments, evaluating risk and treatment needs, and preparing high-quality professional reports.

The psychologist will primarily provide services at Dorchester Complex in Dorchester, New Brunswick, working collaboratively with an interdisciplinary healthcare and case management team.

The role is focused on psychological risk assessment and provides an opportunity to apply specialized clinical expertise within a forensic environment while contributing to informed decisions related to treatment planning, case management, risk management and community reintegration.

The psychologist will collaborate with professionals across psychology, nursing, social work, occupational therapy, case management and other healthcare disciplines.

## Responsibilities

The psychologist will be responsible for conducting comprehensive psychological risk assessments and providing professional consultation as required. Responsibilities may include:

• Conducting psychological and risk assessment interviews.

• Reviewing relevant clinical, health, correctional and case management records.

• Administering, scoring and interpreting appropriate psychological and risk assessment instruments.

• Integrating information obtained through clinical interviews, psychological testing, file review and consultation with other professionals.

• Assessing risk factors, treatment needs, responsivity factors, protective factors and risk-management considerations.

• Preparing comprehensive psychological risk assessment reports and recommendations.

• Communicating assessment findings in accordance with professional and organizational requirements.

• Collaborating with interdisciplinary healthcare professionals and correctional case management teams.

• Participating in case conferences, interdisciplinary meetings, consultations and related activities when required.

• Maintaining complete, accurate and timely clinical documentation.

• Providing services in accordance with applicable professional, ethical, legislative, privacy and practice standards.

## Qualifications

Applicants must meet all of the following requirements to be considered.

• Current Registration or Licensure. You must hold a current and valid licence or registration as a psychologist with the applicable provincial regulatory body in the province where services will be provided.

• Proof of current registration or licensure will be required before placement.

Relevant Professional Experience

Within the past five years, you must have at least two years of professional experience in one of the following areas:

• Correctional or forensic psychology; or

• Clinical psychology and/or counselling psychology.

Psychological Risk Assessment Experience

You must have completed a minimum of five psychological risk assessments within the past five years.

Candidates who progress through the selection process will be asked to provide information allowing this experience to be verified, including the organization where the assessments were completed, the approximate dates of the work and an appropriate professional or administrative reference.

## Additional Requirements

While not mandatory, preference may be given to psychologists with experience in:

• Forensic or correctional environments.

• Structured psychological risk assessment.

• Actuarial or structured professional judgment tools.

• Complex mental health and behavioural presentations.

• Assessment of criminogenic needs and risk factors.

• Working with women in forensic or correctional settings.

• Working with Indigenous and culturally diverse populations.

• Interdisciplinary healthcare or case management teams.

• Preparing psychological reports used to support treatment, correctional, release or risk-management decisions.

• Working within environments involving heightened confidentiality, privacy and security requirements.

The contract requires services to take gender, cultural, religious and linguistic differences into account and to be responsive to the specific needs of women and Indigenous people.

Compensation

Per assessment.

Vacancy

We have 2 available positions.

Calian is seeking a Physiotherapist for the Canadian Forces Health Services Centre at CFB Comox to provide comprehensive consultation, assessment, and treatment in both the physiotherapy section, by booked appointment and walk-ins, and the Care Delivery Unit (CDU) via sick parade and/or consultation, as part of the collaborative practice model. • Participate in ongoing management of patient care by presenting cases during inter-disciplinary meetings, attending clinical rounds, conducting patient conferences, and in scheduling additional follow-up care

• Perform daily clinical documentation for all patient interactions in accordance with CF and provincial regulatory body clinical documentation and record keeping requirements

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian Health Services is currently seeking a Registered Dental Assistant for a full-time position at CFB Gagetown’s dental unit. The Registered Dental Assistant will provide dental care to military members as part of the dental healthcare delivery team.

The clinic hours are 7:30 am – 3:30 pm - Monday to Friday, no evenings or weekends! Dental services are provided to active military members. No seniors, no children.

## Responsibilities

• Assist dentists or other dental clinicians chairside in performing a wide range of dental procedures.

• Take, process, and mount dental radiographs.

• Perform a wide range of dental laboratory procedures.

• Sterilize and disinfect dental instruments, equipment, and operating area.

• Maintain dental operating area and monitor consumable supplies.

• Provide administrative support as required.

• Other associated tasks relevant to this occupational group.

## Qualifications

• Must be a graduate of an accredited Level II (Intra-Oral) Dental Assisting program.

• Must be licensed in Good Standing as a Level II Dental Assistant with the NBDS

• Must have (or be able to obtain) CPR Level C / AED certification.

## Additional Requirements

• Candidates must be eligible and able to obtain and maintain a Reliability level Government Security clearance.

## Position Overview

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader to advance Calian’s growth agenda through proactive government engagement, industrial participation, strategic partnerships, Indigenous participation, and innovation funding.

CareersInnerInfo
The Head, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships & Industrial Participation will connect government priorities with business strategy by influencing policy, building trusted relationships across government and industry, developing strategic partnerships, and maximizing Industrial and Technological Benefits (ITB), Value Proposition (VP), Indigenous Participation (IP), and government funding opportunities.

Working across Defence, Space, Health, and Critical Infrastructure, this role will help shape opportunities before procurements are released while strengthening Calian’s position as a leading Canadian mission-critical technology company.

## Responsibilities

• Develop and execute Calian’s enterprise government relations strategy.

• Build trusted relationships with Ministers, Members of Parliament, senior public servants, Crown corporations, and key agencies including DND, PSPC, ISED, CSA, Global Affairs Canada, EDC, BDC, and provincial governments.

• Monitor government policy, defence priorities, budgets, legislation, and procurement initiatives.

• Advise executive leadership on political, regulatory, and policy developments.

• Position Calian as a trusted Canadian partner supporting sovereignty, national security, resilience, and innovation.

• Build and manage strategic relationships with defence primes, Indigenous organizations, SMEs, academic institutions, research organizations, venture partners, and allied governments.

• Identify partnership opportunities that strengthen capture strategies and future growth.

• Support collaborative innovation initiatives and ecosystem development.

• Develop long-term partnership strategies aligned with business growth priorities.

• Lead enterprise strategy for ITB, Value Proposition, and Indigenous Participation.

• Develop industrial participation strategies supporting major pursuits.

• Coordinate delivery, reporting, and governance of contractual ITB commitments.

• Identify Canadian suppliers, technology investments, research collaborations, and Indigenous business opportunities.

• Support negotiations involving industrial participation commitments and partnership agreements.

• Identify and pursue federal and provincial funding opportunities supporting innovation, commercialization, and defence capability development.

• Coordinate applications for innovation and funding programs.

• Align funding opportunities with strategic partnerships and business development priorities.

• Manage stakeholder relationships and reporting requirements.

• Support capture teams by integrating government priorities into capture strategies.

• Provide policy intelligence that strengthens win strategies.

• Develop executive briefing materials, thought leadership content, unsolicited proposals, and advocacy strategies.

• Support executive engagement with government stakeholders before procurement activity begins.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Corporate Communications, Business Development, Pursuits & Proposals, Legal, Finance, and Business Units to align external engagement with growth objectives.

## Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive experience in Government Relations, Defence, Public Policy, Industrial Participation, Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, or related fields.

• Strong understanding of Canadian defence procurement, Defence Industrial Strategy, ITB Policy, Value Proposition Framework, Indigenous Participation requirements, and federal procurement processes.

• Experience working with DND, PSPC, ISED, CSA, EDC, BDC, and innovation funding programs.

• Demonstrated success building executive-level relationships across government and industry.

• Experience supporting major capture efforts, strategic partnerships, or industrial participation initiatives.

• Eligibility to register as an in-house lobbyist.

• Excellent communication, executive advisory, relationship management, negotiation, and influencing skills.

• Government of Canada security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

## Additional Requirements

• Secret security clearance eligibility required.

• Strong government and political acumen.

• Strategic partnership development experience.

• Business development and capture support mindset.

• Policy analysis expertise.

• Ability to support innovation and ecosystem development initiatives.

• Other duties as required within the context of the role.

Compensation

The compensation range for this position is $150,000 – $180,000 CAD annually, plus eligibility for applicable incentive programs.

Position Type: Full-time

We have 1 available position(s).
