## Position Overview

The Systems Engineering Technician (SET) provides network operations and maintenance support under the direction of the Senior Systems Engineering Technician (SSET). The role supports DND/CAF network environments, including secure and simulation networks, and may involve work in both fixed and deployed locations. The SET delivers 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Line support to ensure secure, compliant, and operational network services in accordance with DND/CAF policies and technical plans.

## Responsibilities

The Systems Engineering Technician will perform duties including, but not limited to, the following:

• Provide 1st and 2nd Line network operations and maintenance support as assigned by the SSET, in support of DND/CAF Network Support staff, including support for deployed operations when required.

• Provide 3rd Line network operations and maintenance support as assigned by the SSET, in direct support of Network Operations Centre (NOC) staff.

• Ensure that only personnel designated by DND/CAF Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) are granted connectivity to Simulation, Test, and Evaluation (STE) networks.

• Monitor DND-owned network usage to ensure compliance with all applicable DND governance frameworks, policies, regulations, and directives.

• Configure networks to support specific exercises or activities in accordance with approved Systems Engineering plans and under the direction of the DND/CAF Network Manager.

• Collaborate with DND/CAF Network Support staff to ensure all networks are fully functional no later than 24 hours prior to the start of scheduled activities or exercises.

## Qualifications

Candidates must meet one of the following criteria:

• A graduate degree in Information Management or Information Science from a recognized post-secondary institution; or

• A university degree (any discipline) from a recognized post-secondary institution and a minimum of two (2) years of experience working in the Information Management/Information Science field; or

• A college diploma or certification in Information Management or Information Science from a recognized training or post-secondary institution and a minimum of five (5) years of experience working in the Information Management/Information Science field.

PLUS

• A minimum of three (3) years of combined experience within the past five (5) years using the following technologies: Windows 7 and/or newer versions, Windows Server 2008 R2 and/or newer versions, Red Hat Linux, VMware virtualization technologies

• A minimum of three (3) years of experience within the past five (5) years reconfiguring large network environments supporting up to 200 or more client workstations. This experience must include: System imaging and ghosting, Remote system management, Rapid data population and deployment techniques, Operation within secure and simulation network environments

• You must be available to work on-site

• You must be able to communicate effectively in both official languages

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

## Position Overview

Calian Health Services is seeking a Physiotherapist for the Canadian Forces Health Services Centre in St-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec to provide comprehensive consultation, assessment, and treatment in both the physiotherapy section, by booked appointment and walk-ins, and the Care Delivery Unit (CDU) via sick parade and/or consultation, as part of the collaborative practice model. They can benefit by treating clients who are generally very fit and motivated towards their recovery.

## Responsibilities

• Deliver physiotherapy and rehabilitation interventions using evidence-based approaches and best practices in accordance with applicable regulatory standards and scope of practice

• Carry a full orthopedic caseload of 12-18 patients per day; including 2 New Assessments per 7.5 hour clinical day, and up to 3 follow-up patients per hour. This may include 60 minutes charting time if required, provided the 12-18 patients per day range is still attained

• Provide assessment and treatment of neuro-musculoskeletal conditions resulting mainly from sports and training injuries as well as work injuries and accidents

• Obtain and document informed patient consent for assessment and treatment through an accurate explanation and instruction

• Provide screening assessments, education and orthoses recommendations in a direct access setting such as CDU walk-ins

• Prescribe exercises to optimally rehabilitate and prevent injuries and promote fitness

• Provide manual therapy and soft tissue techniques for neuro- musculoskeletal conditions, scar tissue, muscle tension, circulatory disorders and lymphatic problems

• Utilize pain management techniques that may include acupuncture (needling below the dermis);

• Provide ergonomics education including the provision of on-site assessments in the patient’s workplace

• Provide physiotherapy related education to patients and members of the health care team in topics such as injury prevention and health promotion issues

• Perform Biomechanical Foot Assessments including orthotics fitting and fabrication

• Contribute to the design, preparation and provision of programs integral to the operation of the physiotherapy clinic as a member of the healthcare team for the purpose of education and rehabilitation such as programs specializing in proprioceptive rehabilitation, reintegration, or back pain self-management

• Participate in ongoing management of patient care by presenting cases during inter-disciplinary meetings, attending clinical rounds, conducting patient conferences, and in scheduling additional follow-up care

## Position Overview

Calian is proud to support public and private sector clients across Canada with expert psychological assessment services for candidate selection in high-risk roles. We are currently seeking a Consultant Psychologist in Windsor to join our growing national team who can provide support to complete in-person assessments at their private office.

CareersInnerInfo
When organizations responsible for public safety—such as the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA)—are selecting candidates for critical roles, they rely on Calian’s trusted network of psychologists to assess psychological suitability and fitness for duty.

Help ensure Canada’s frontline agencies are staffed with psychologically resilient, well-assessed professionals.

Why Join Calian’s Psychological Services Team?

• Flexible, casual contract: Work based on client needs and your availability.

• Schedule options include weekdays, evenings, and weekends.

• Opportunity to join a collaborative, mission-driven team committed to excellence in psychological assessment and public safety.

• Ongoing support from our Senior Consulting Psychologist and Chief Psychologist.

## Responsibilities

• Conducts psychological suitability assessments for Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) officer candidates and armed personnel to determine readiness to carry a duty firearm and other defensive equipment.

• Reviews psychometric test results (MMPI-3, 16PF, MCMI-IV, MAST, DAST), which are administered by Calian’s psychological services team, and integrates findings into clinical evaluations.

• Performs structured stress interviews as part of a two-stage assessment process.

• Evaluates psychological fitness for duty following non-administrative removal of defensive equipment due to mental health concerns, substance use, or exposure to traumatic incidents.

• Assesses readiness to resume full operational duties following critical incidents or firearm discharge events.

• Provides professional judgment and recommendations regarding suitability to begin or continue in armed law enforcement roles.

• Completes standardized assessment reports, and where required, offers feedback to candidates.

• Collaborates with Calian’s Senior Consulting Psychologist and Chief Psychologist as necessary.

## Qualifications

• Must be able to conduct interviews a private office space or virtually.

• Must be registered psychologist licensed for autonomous practice and in good standing with the College of Psychologists and Behaviour Analysts of Ontario (mandatory)

• Doctorate-level applicants must have a minimum of 5 years of experience, including formal training in personality assessment or occupational health psychology.

• Master's-level applicants must have a minimum of 10 years of experience, including formal training in personality assessment or occupational health psychology.

• Must have conducted a minimum of 25 psychological assessments for individuals working in law enforcement or military.

• Ability to provide a de-identified sample assessment report that clearly demonstrates relevant clinical competencies in suitability or fitness-for-duty evaluations.

• Demonstrated proficiency in psychological personality assessment, including the use of validated psychometric instruments (e.g., MMPI-3, MCMI-IV), and conducting structured or semi-structured clinical interviews.

## Additional Requirements

• Must be eligible for and able to obtain and maintain a Reliability-level security clearance in accordance with federal government requirements.

$225-$300/hr

Calian est fière d’appuyer des clients des secteurs public et privé partout au Canada en offrant des services spécialisés d’évaluation psychologique pour la sélection de candidats à des postes à haut risque. Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) psychologue consultant(e) à Montréal, QC ou à Québec, QC pour se joindre à notre équipe nationale en pleine croissance et offrir du soutien à la réalisation d’évaluations en personne dans son cabinet privé.

CareersInnerInfo
Lorsque des organisations responsables de la sécurité publique - comme l’Agence des services frontaliers du Canada (ASFC) - sélectionnent des candidats pour des rôles critiques, elles s’appuient sur le solide réseau de psychologues de confiance de Calian afin d’évaluer l’aptitude psychologique et la capacité à exercer les fonctions.

Contribuez à faire en sorte que les organismes de première ligne du Canada soient composés de professionnels résilients sur le plan psychologique et rigoureusement évalués.

Pourquoi se joindre à l’équipe des services psychologiques de Calian?*

• Contrat flexible et occasionnel : travail en fonction des besoins des clients et de vos disponibilités.

• Horaire modulable : jours de semaine, soirs et fins de semaine.

• Occasion de collaborer au sein d’une équipe engagée, axée sur l’excellence en évaluation psychologique et la sécurité publique.

• Soutien continu de notre psychologue consultant principal et de notre psychologue en chef.

Responsabilités

• Réaliser des évaluations d’aptitude psychologique auprès des candidats agents de l’Agence des services frontaliers du Canada (ASFC) et du personnel armé afin de déterminer leur capacité à porter une arme de service et d’autres équipements de défense.

• Analyser les résultats de tests psychométriques (MMPI-3, 16PF, MCMI-IV, MAST, DAST) administrés par l’équipe des services psychologiques de Calian et intégrer les conclusions aux évaluations cliniques.

• Mener des entrevues structurées de stress dans le cadre d’un processus d’évaluation en deux étapes.

• Évaluer l’aptitude au travail à la suite du retrait non administratif de l’équipement de défense en raison de préoccupations liées à la santé mentale, à l’usage de substances ou à l’exposition à des événements traumatiques.

• Évaluer la capacité à reprendre pleinement les fonctions opérationnelles à la suite d’un incident critique ou d’un usage d’arme à feu.

• Formuler des avis professionnels et des recommandations quant à l’aptitude à occuper ou à continuer d’occuper des fonctions policières armées.

• Rédiger des rapports d’évaluation normalisés et, au besoin, offrir une rétroaction aux candidats.

• Collaborer, lorsque requis, avec le psychologue consultant principal et le psychologue en chef de Calian.

## Qualifications

• Être en mesure de mener des entrevues en cabinet privé ou en mode virtuel.

• Être psychologue dûment inscrit(e) et autorisé(e) à exercer de façon autonome, en règle avec l’Ordre des psychologues du Québec (obligatoire).

• Les titulaires d’un doctorat doivent posséder au moins 5 ans d’expérience, incluant une formation formelle en évaluation de la personnalité ou en psychologie du travail/santé au travail.

• Les titulaires d’une maîtrise doivent posséder au moins 10 ans d’expérience, incluant une formation formelle en évaluation de la personnalité ou en psychologie du travail/santé au travail.

• Avoir réalisé un minimum de 25 évaluations psychologiques auprès de personnes œuvrant dans les domaines de l’application de la loi ou du milieu militaire.

• Être en mesure de fournir un exemple de rapport d’évaluation anonymisé démontrant clairement des compétences cliniques pertinentes en matière d’évaluation d’aptitude ou de capacité fonctionnelle au travail.

• Démontrer une expertise en évaluation de la personnalité, incluant l’utilisation d’outils psychométriques validés (p. ex., MMPI-3, MCMI-IV), ainsi que la conduite d’entrevues cliniques structurées ou semi-structurées.

Exigences supplémentaires

• Être admissible à une cote de fiabilité de niveau fédéral, et en mesure de l’obtenir et de la maintenir conformément aux exigences du gouvernement du Canada.

Rémunération

225 $ à 300 $/heure

Poste à combler

1 poste disponible

## Position Overview

Calian is proud to support public and private sector clients across Canada with expert psychological assessment services for candidate selection in high-risk roles. We are currently seeking a Consultant Psychologist in Montreal, QC or Quebec city, QC to join our growing national team who can provide support to complete in-person assessments at their private office.

When organizations responsible for public safety - such as the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) - are selecting candidates for critical roles, they rely on Calian’s trusted network of psychologists to assess psychological suitability and fitness for duty.

Help ensure Canada’s frontline agencies are staffed with psychologically resilient, well-assessed professionals.

Why Join Calian’s Psychological Services Team?

• Flexible, casual contract: Work based on client needs and your availability.

• Schedule options include weekdays, evenings, and weekends.

• Opportunity to join a collaborative, mission-driven team committed to excellence in psychological assessment and public safety.

• Ongoing support from our Senior Consulting Psychologist and Chief Psychologist.

## Responsibilities

• Conducts psychological suitability assessments for Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) officer candidates and armed personnel to determine readiness to carry a duty firearm and other defensive equipment.

• Reviews psychometric test results (MMPI-3, 16PF, MCMI-IV, MAST, DAST), which are administered by Calian’s psychological services team, and integrates findings into clinical evaluations.

• Performs structured stress interviews as part of a two-stage assessment process.

• Evaluates psychological fitness for duty following non-administrative removal of defensive equipment due to mental health concerns, substance use, or exposure to traumatic incidents.

• Assesses readiness to resume full operational duties following critical incidents or firearm discharge events.

• Provides professional judgment and recommendations regarding suitability to begin or continue in armed law enforcement roles.

• Completes standardized assessment reports, and where required, offers feedback to candidates.

• Collaborates with Calian’s Senior Consulting Psychologist and Chief Psychologist as necessary.

## Qualifications

• Must be able to conduct interviews a private office space or virtually.

• Must be registered psychologist licensed for autonomous practice and in good standing with the College of Psychologists of Quebec (mandatory)

• Doctorate-level applicants must have a minimum of 5 years of experience, including formal training in personality assessment or occupational health psychology.

• Master's-level applicants must have a minimum of 10 years of experience, including formal training in personality assessment or occupational health psychology.

• Must have conducted a minimum of 25 psychological assessments for individuals working in law enforcement or military.

• Ability to provide a de-identified sample assessment report that clearly demonstrates relevant clinical competencies in suitability or fitness-for-duty evaluations.

• Demonstrated proficiency in psychological personality assessment, including the use of validated psychometric instruments (e.g., MMPI-3, MCMI-IV), and conducting structured or semi-structured clinical interviews.

## Additional Requirements

• Must be eligible for and able to obtain and maintain a Reliability-level security clearance in accordance with federal government requirements.

Compensation

$225-$300/hr

Vacancy

We have 1 available position.

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking a Physiotherapist for the Canadian Forces Health Services Centre (Comox) to provide comprehensive consultation, assessment, and treatment in both the physiotherapy section, by booked appointment and walk-ins, and the Care Delivery Unit (CDU) via sick parade and/or consultation, as part of the collaborative practice model. They can benefit by treating clients who are generally very fit and motivated towards their recovery.

## Responsibilities

• Deliver physiotherapy and rehabilitation interventions using evidence-based approaches and best practices in accordance with applicable regulatory standards and scope of practice

• Carry a full orthopedic caseload of 12-15 patients per day (on average 8-10 new assessments per week), and typically 2 follow-up patients per hour

• Provide assessment and treatment of neuro-musculoskeletal conditions resulting mainly from sports and training injuries as well as work injuries and accidents

• Obtain and document informed patient consent for assessment and treatment through an accurate explanation and instruction

• Provide screening assessments, education and orthoses recommendations in a direct access setting such as CDU walk- ins

• Prescribe exercises to optimally rehabilitate and prevent injuries and promote fitness

• Provide manual therapy and soft tissue techniques for neuro- musculoskeletal conditions, scar tissue, muscle tension, circulatory disorders and lymphatic problems

• Utilize pain management techniques that may include acupuncture (needling below the dermis);

• Provide ergonomics education including the provision of on-site assessments in the patient’s workplace

• Provide physiotherapy related education to patients and members of the health care team in topics such as injury prevention and health promotion issues

• Perform Biomechanical Foot Assessments including orthotics fitting and fabrication

• Contribute to the design, preparation and provision of programs integral to the operation of the physiotherapy clinic as a member of the healthcare team for the purpose of education and rehabilitation such as programs specializing in proprioceptive rehabilitation, reintegration, or back pain self-management

• Participate in ongoing management of patient care by presenting cases during inter-disciplinary meetings, attending clinical rounds, conducting patient conferences, and in scheduling additional follow-up care

• Perform daily clinical documentation for all patient interactions in accordance with CF and provincial regulatory body clinical documentation and record keeping requirements

## Qualifications

• Current license in good standing from province of British Columbia

• Minimum of 7 years of experience working in orthopaedics or sports medicine; and either a Diploma of Advanced Orthopedic Manual and Manipulative therapy; or a Diploma of Mechanical Diagnosis and Therapy (McKenzie)

## Additional Requirements

• Must be able to obtain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level

• Hourly salary of $65.00 to $75.00 per hour

## Position Overview

Calian is proud to deliver high-quality psychological assessment services to public and private sector clients across Canada. We are seeking Psychologists throughout Ontario to join our team and contribute to meaningful work. In this role, you will support organizations operating in high-risk environments by conducting assessments that ensure candidates are well-suited for their positions.

CareersInnerInfo
As part of our national network of consultant psychologists, you will help ensure that organizations are staffed with individuals who have been thoroughly assessed and are prepared to perform their duties effectively. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on the success of our clients and the professionals they employ.

We are looking for psychologists to conduct candidate selection assessments for correctional services officers and armed border agents. This role offers flexibility, as we manage referrals and coordinate assessments based on your availability.

Your work will focus on structured stress interviews and comprehensive report writing, allowing you to concentrate on your core expertise. This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy variety and have a strong interest in law enforcement. It offers a dynamic environment without the need for therapeutic alliances, making it a great fit for those who prefer assessment-focused work.

## Responsibilities

• Conduct interviews with candidates who have completed written personality assessments administered by Calian. After the interview, complete a structured template with your findings.

• Perform the second part of a two-part assessment: review formal testing results (MMPI-3 and 16PF) and conduct a structured clinical interview.

• Interpret test results and determine whether candidates meet the requirements of the Correctional Service of Canada (CSC).

• Provide feedback on assessment results to candidates and, when required, defend psychological evaluations.

## Qualifications

• Ph.D. or Psy.D in Psychology (must-have)

• Fully licensed for autonomous practice as a Psychologist in Ontario, and in good standing.

• Minimum of 3 years of recent experience working with public safety entities such as provincial or municipal police forces, DND, RCMP, CSC, CSIS, CBSA, or provincial equivalents

• Must have completed of at least 50 psychological readiness assessments for candidates

## Additional Requirements

• Casual contract and flexible working schedule

• Assessments may be conducted on weekdays, weekends, or evenings.

• Ability to conduct interviews either in person in a private office or remotely

Compensation

$225-$300/hr

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Medical Radiological Technologists provide diagnostic imaging services to radiologists, specialists, physicians and other health care providers. The images are used to diagnose and treat medical and surgical conditions or injury and disease.

Medical Radiological Technologists operate x-ray equipment, such as computed radiography (CR), digital radiography (DR) and work in fully-equipped clinics in diagnostic imaging services as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Patients are seen as booked appointments as well as walk-ins for sick parade and urgent cases.

## Responsibilities

The primary roles and responsibilities of Medical Radiological Technologists are to:

• provide patient care;

• produce diagnostic examinations;

• maintain equipment, accessories and supplies; and

• maintain a quality assurance program.

## Qualifications

All Medical Radiological Technologists must, as a minimum:

• have a current certification from and current membership (Full Practice Membership) with the Canadian Association Medical Radiation Technologists (CAMRT) or by other professional associations that have reciprocal agreements with CAMRT such as the Ordre des technologues en imagerie médicale, en radio-oncologie et en électrophysiologie médicale du Québec (OTIMROEPMQ);

• a Certificate of Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Provider or equivalent such as Cardio-pulmonary Resuscitation/Automated External Defibrillator (CPR/AED) Level C; and

• have a current license from the Medical Radiation Technologists regulatory body in the province of work.

## Additional Requirements

The Medical Radiological Technologist must, as a minimum, have of 2 years of experience:

• working in a clinic or hospital as a Medical Radiation Technologist performing general, special, emergency, interventional, and operative radiology examinations observing safe radiation protection practices or procedures;

• applying diagnostic imaging quality assurance and quality control practices and programs; and

• operating and maintaining digital imaging equipment and accessories such as digital radiography, Radiology Information Systems, Computed Radiography, and Picture Archival and Communication Systems.

Compensation

35.00 – 38.00 per hour

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking a full-time Nurse Practitioner to add to our clinical team working at CFB Yellowknife. The Nurse Practitioner functions as an essential member of the health care team in the provision of comprehensive, multidisciplinary, collaborative primary health care services to Canadian Armed Forces members. • Makes appropriate medical employment limitation recommendations in accordance with the Surgeon General’s guidelines.

• Prescribes medications and orders x-rays, ultrasounds, and lab tests in accordance with the Standards of Practice for RNs in the Extended Class

• Refers patients to other providers or programs according to the patient’s need.

Calian Health Services is seeking a Physiotherapist for the Canadian Forces Health Services Centre in Ottawa to provide comprehensive consultation, assessment, and treatment in both the physiotherapy section, by booked appointment and walk-ins, and the Care Delivery Unit (CDU) via sick parade and/or consultation, as part of the collaborative practice model. ## Position Overview

Join Calian in Shaping the Future of Psychological Services!

CareersInnerInfo
At Calian, we take pride in being one of Canada's largest providers of pre-employment psychological services for federal, provincial, and municipal law enforcement agencies and departments. Trusted by clients nationwide, we conduct assessments ranging from selection services to suitability to carry a firearm and return to work. Our comprehensive psychological services extend across both public and private sectors, ensuring that our clients' teams are equipped with the right individuals for high-risk scenarios.

As part of our strategic growth initiative, Calian is thrilled to announce the expansion of our operations in the Ottawa and GTA areas. This expansion presents an exciting opportunity for us to further our mission of delivering comprehensive psychological services to a diverse range of clients across Canada. We are actively seeking a dedicated Staff Psychologist to join our team and play a pivotal role in continuing to shape our presence in this region.

Your Impact in Law Enforcement Settings

We are looking for a psychologist with a genuine interest in the complexities of human behavior within law enforcement settings. If you're drawn to the challenges of assessing candidates for high-stakes roles and are eager to contribute to public safety, this opportunity is for you. Our ideal candidate values collaboration, possesses a strong understanding of psychological principles, and is committed to ensuring the well-being and readiness of individuals entering and working in law enforcement and related fields.

Benefits Package, Work-Life Balance & Growth Opportunities

This role is full-time, requiring a commitment of 40 hours per week. We value flexibility and understand that candidates may have diverse needs, so we offer opportunities to work on weekdays, weekends, and evenings to accommodate various schedules. While some aspects of this role require conducting in-person interviews in an office setting, our working environment is hybrid, allowing for flexibility and the opportunity to work remotely.

We offer a competitive base salary, paid vacation days, and a comprehensive benefits package including group medical and dental coverage. Additionally, we provide access to a professional development fund, empowering you to attend conferences, workshops, and training sessions to enhance your skills and knowledge in the field of psychology.

Join Calian Today!

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply now and become part of a dynamic team committed to delivering exceptional psychological services across Canada.

## Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive psychological assessments tailored for law enforcement and policing roles, to determine psychological suitability for employment in high-risk occupations.

• Utilize a variety of assessment tools including the MMPI-3, 16PF, and other psychometric measures to evaluate personality traits, psychopathology, and psychological readiness.

• Review pre-interview questionnaires and administer structured stress interviews and clinical interviews to further assess psychological readiness and suitability for careers involving law enforcement.

• Collaborate with the Senior Clinical Psychologist to lead consultations on challenging cases, providing guidance on additional testing and interviews required for making final determinations on psychological suitability.

• Prepare comprehensive evaluation reports outlining psychological suitability for prospective employers, ensuring clarity and adherence to professional standards.

• Provide feedback to candidates on individual assessment results as requested, offering insight and guidance based on psychological evaluations.

• Conduct psychological assessments following the removal of duty firearms, addressing concerns such as substance abuse, recovery, and sobriety management.

• Perform psychological assessments for re-arming, utilizing tools such as the MAST, DAST, and DSM-V, and conducting clinical interviews to ensure readiness to resume full duties.

• Assess psychological readiness for resuming or continuing full duties following involvement in critical incidents, providing support and guidance as needed.

• Conduct quality assurance (QA) reviews of assessment reports, ensuring adherence to accuracy and established standards specific to law enforcement and policing requirements.

• Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of assessment programs for law enforcement and policing roles, including the design and refinement of assessment protocols based on research and industry best practices in this field.

## Qualifications

• Doctoral-level degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in Psychology is preferred.

• Candidates with a Master's Degree in Psychology will be considered, provided they have relevant experience and expertise in conducting psychological assessments, particularly in law enforcement or related fields.

• Fully licensed for autonomous practice with the College of Psychologists of Ontario

• A minimum of 2 years of recent experience working for public entities (federal, provincial, or municipal)

• Must have completed 50 assessments for psychological readiness of candidates for high-risk employment requiring the issuance of duty defensive equipment in the last 10 years.

• At least 2 years of experience within the last 5 years conducting psychological assessments with adult clients in high-risk occupational settings, including demonstrated use of the MMPI-2, MMPI-2-RF or MMPI-3.

• Bilingualism in English and French (written and spoken) is a very strong asset.

## Additional Requirements

• Must obtain and maintain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level.

Compensation

$180 000 to $210 000 per year

We have 2 available positions.

Description du poste

Rejoignez Calian pour façonner l'avenir des services psychologiques!

Chez Calian, nous sommes fiers d'être l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de services psychologiques préalables à l'emploi au Canada pour les organismes d'application de la loi fédéraux, provinciaux et municipaux. Faisant confiance à des clients de tout le pays, nous réalisons des évaluations allant des services de sélection à la capacité de porter une arme à feu et de retour au travail. Nos services psychologiques complets s'étendent à la fois dans le secteur public et privé, garantissant que les équipes de nos clients sont composées des bonnes personnes pour des scénarios à haut risque.

Dans le cadre de notre initiative de croissance stratégique, Calian est ravi d'annoncer l'expansion de nos opérations dans les régions d'Ottawa et Toronto. Cette expansion offre une opportunité passionnante pour nous de poursuivre notre mission de fournir des services psychologiques complets à une gamme diversifiée de clients à travers le Canada. Nous recherchons activement un psychologue du personnel dévoué pour rejoindre notre équipe et jouer un rôle crucial dans la poursuite du façonnement de notre présence dans cette région.

Votre impact dans les environnements de l'application de la loi

Nous recherchons un psychologue avec un véritable intérêt pour les complexités du comportement humain dans les environnements d'application de la loi. Si vous êtes attiré par les défis liés à l'évaluation des candidats pour des rôles à enjeux élevés et que vous souhaitez contribuer à la sécurité publique, cette opportunité est pour vous. Notre candidat idéal valorise la collaboration, possède une solide compréhension des principes psychologiques et s'engage à assurer le bien-être et la préparation des personnes entrant et travaillant dans le domaine de l'application de la loi et des domaines connexes.

Forfait avantages, équilibre vie professionnelle et opportunités de croissance

Ce rôle est à temps plein, nécessitant un engagement de 40 heures par semaine. Nous apprécions la flexibilité et comprenons que les candidats peuvent avoir des besoins divers, nous offrons donc des opportunités de travail en semaine, le week-end et en soirée pour accommoder divers horaires. Bien que certains aspects de ce rôle nécessitent la réalisation d'entretiens en personne dans un bureau, notre environnement de travail est hybride, permettant la flexibilité et la possibilité de travailler à distance.

Nous proposons un salaire de base compétitif, des jours de vacances payés et un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux, y compris une couverture médicale et dentaire de groupe. De plus, nous offrons l'accès à un fonds de développement professionnel, vous permettant d'assister à des conférences, des ateliers et des sessions de formation pour améliorer vos compétences et vos connaissances dans le domaine de la psychologie.

Rejoignez Calian aujourd'hui!

Prêt à faire progresser votre carrière? Postulez maintenant et faites partie d'une équipe dynamique engagée à fournir des services psychologiques exceptionnels à travers le Canada.

Responsabilités

• Réaliser des évaluations psychologiques approfondies adaptées aux rôles de l'application de la loi et de la police, afin de déterminer l'aptitude psychologique à l'emploi dans des professions à haut risque.

• Utiliser divers outils d'évaluation, notamment le MMPI-3, le 16PF et d'autres mesures psychométriques, pour évaluer les traits de personnalité, la psychopathologie et la préparation psychologique.

• Examiner les questionnaires pré-entrevues et administrer des entretiens structurés sous stress et des entretiens cliniques pour évaluer davantage la préparation psychologique et l'aptitude aux carrières liées à l'application de la loi.

• Collaborer avec le psychologue clinique principal pour diriger des consultations sur des cas difficiles, fournissant des conseils sur les tests et les entretiens supplémentaires nécessaires pour prendre des décisions finales sur l'aptitude psychologique.

• Préparer des rapports d'évaluation complets détaillant l'aptitude psychologique pour les employeurs potentiels, en veillant à la clarté et au respect des normes professionnelles.

• Fournir des commentaires aux candidats sur les résultats individuels des évaluations, offrant des informations et des conseils basés sur les évaluations psychologiques.

• Réaliser des évaluations psychologiques après le retrait des armes de service, abordant des préoccupations telles que l'abus de substances, la récupération et la gestion de la sobriété.

• Réaliser des évaluations psychologiques pour le réarmement, en utilisant des outils tels que le MAST, le DAST et le DSM-V, et en menant des entretiens cliniques pour garantir la préparation à reprendre pleinement les fonctions.

• Évaluer la préparation psychologique à reprendre ou à continuer pleinement les fonctions après avoir été impliqué dans des incidents critiques, fournissant un soutien et des conseils au besoin.

• Réaliser des examens de l'assurance qualité (QA) des rapports d'évaluation, en veillant au respect de l'exactitude et des normes établies spécifiques aux exigences de l'application de la loi et de la police.

• Contribuer au développement continu et à l'amélioration des programmes d'évaluation pour les rôles de l'application de la loi et de la police, y compris la conception et le raffinement des protocoles d'évaluation basés sur la recherche et les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie dans ce domaine.

## Qualifications

• Diplôme de doctorat (Ph.D. ou Psy.D.) en psychologie de préférence.

• Les candidats titulaires d'une maîtrise en psychologie seront considérés, à condition qu'ils aient une expérience et une expertise pertinentes dans la réalisation d'évaluations psychologiques, en particulier dans le domaine de l'application de la loi ou des domaines connexes.

• Licence pour la pratique autonome auprès de l'Ordre des psychologues de l'Ontario.

• Un minimum de 2 ans d'expérience récente au sein d'entités publiques (fédérales, provinciales ou municipales).

• Doit avoir effectué 50 évaluations de la préparation psychologique des candidats pour des emplois à haut risque nécessitant la délivrance d'équipement de défense en service au cours des 10 dernières années.

• Au moins 2 années d’expérience au cours des 5 dernières années dans la réalisation d’évaluations psychologiques auprès d’une clientèle adulte œuvrant dans des milieux professionnels à haut risque, incluant l’utilisation démontrée du MMPI-2, MMPI-2-RF ou MMPI-3.

• Le bilinguisme en anglais et en français, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, constitue un atout important.

Exigences supplémentaires

• Doit obtenir et maintenir une cote de sécurité gouvernementale au niveau Fiabilité.

Rémunération

180 000 $ à 210 000 $ par année

CareersInnerInfo

• Conduct trauma assessments to identify acute and long-term mental health needs following critical events.

• Deliver evidence-based trauma therapies such as EMDR, Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT), Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT), or Critical Incident Stress Debriefing (CISD) to address immediate and ongoing psychological effects.

• Work closely with emergency management teams, organizations, and first responders to develop tailored interventions and recovery plans.

• Offer psychological first aid and guidance to help clients stabilize in the immediate aftermath of traumatic incidents.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure holistic support for affected individuals, including follow-up services and referrals to additional resources as needed.

• Provide group debriefings, psychoeducation, and workshops to organizations and affected communities to build resilience and aid in recovery.

• Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation, including incident reports, treatment plans, and client progress notes.

• Stay updated on best practices in trauma therapy, crisis intervention, and critical incident response.

## Qualifications

• Bilingualism in English and French is required.

• Registration and good standing as either a Registered Social Worker or Registered Psychotherapist in the province of Ontario.

• Experience working in trauma therapy, with a focus on critical incidents or crisis intervention.

• Specialized training in trauma therapies such as EMDR, CPT, TF-CBT, Critical Incident Stress Debriefing (CISD), or Psychological First Aid (PFA).

• Proven ability to respond effectively and calmly in high-stress situations.

• Strong communication, crisis management, and de-escalation skills.

• Ability to collaborate with emergency teams, organizations, and community groups.

• Commitment to maintaining cultural competence and sensitivity when working with diverse populations.

## Additional Requirements

• PSPC Reliability Status is required.

Compensation

• $110-175/hr

The Calian Nuclear team provides a comprehensive range of services covering the entire nuclear lifecycle. This includes Safety Analysis, Licensing, Emergency Preparedness, Environmental Protection, Decommissioning, Waste management, and cutting-edge Systems Engineering and Robotics.

## Position Overview

Calian's Nuclear Division is seeking a Business Development Executive to grow and protect key enterprise accounts while expanding our footprint across Canada's nuclear sector. This is a commercially focused role for someone who understands how nuclear utilities, regulators, and project teams buy services, and who can build the kind of long-cycle relationships that translate into multi-year contracts.

You will serve as the primary commercial point of contact for large enterprise customers while simultaneously identifying and qualifying new opportunities across the nuclear and energy sector. The ideal candidate brings technical fluency in nuclear services, experience navigating complex procurement processes, and the discipline to manage a structured pipeline.

## Responsibilities

Account Management & Growth

• Own and grow the commercial relationship across two key enterprise accounts, developing account plans that align Calian's full service nuclear portfolio (safety analysis, environmental services, engineering, decommissioning, emergency management, and project management) to each customer's multi-year project roadmap

• Identify expansion opportunities tied to active capital programs, including refurbishment planning cycles, outage schedules, and regulatory submission milestones, and translate these into scoped proposals with defined revenue targets

• Lead quarterly business reviews with senior customer stakeholders, presenting Calian's delivery performance, forecasting upcoming needs, and proactively introducing relevant capabilities where they can add value beyond the current engagement

• Manage multi-year contract renewals and master service agreement negotiations, ensuring continuity of recurring work while structuring agreements that support scope expansion over the contract lifecycle

New Business Development

• Build and manage a pipeline of new opportunities across Canadian nuclear utilities, Crown corporations, and technology developerswith particular focus on major active programs: OPG's Darlington SMR, New Nuclear Wesleyville, and Pickering refurbishment, as well as Bruce Power's Major Component Replacement and Bruce C planning.

• Continue to grow Calian’s footprint as a trusted service provider for new nuclear builds

• Conduct discovery meetings and needs assessments with prospective customers to identify where Calian can deliver differentiated value

• Develop relationships with procurement and technical leads at utilities, technology developers (Atkins Realis, GE Hitachi, Westinghouse) and project delivery organizations entering the Canadian market, positioning Calian as a preferred local services partner

• Represent Calian at sector events, including Canadian Nuclear Association forums, utility-hosted supply chain days, and industry engagement sessions, building visibility and sourcing early-stage opportunity intelligence

Capture & Proposal Management

• Lead capture planning for priority procurements, coordinating subject matter experts across Calian's nuclear disciplines to develop win strategies, bid decisions, scope narratives, and competitive pricing structures aligned to customer priorities

• Develop customer-specific value propositions that differentiate Calian's integrated offering

• Maintain a disciplined pipeline in HubSpot, ensuring opportunities are accurately staged, risks are flagged, and revenue forecasting reflects realistic close timelines consistent with the long procurement cycles typical in the Canadian nuclear sector

• Support pricing strategy and commercial risk assessment on major bids, working with the nuclear division leadership team to balance competitiveness with sustainable margin

Other duties as required within the context of the role.

## Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in business development, sales, or account management, with direct exposure to the Canadian nuclear industry or broader energy/defence sectors

• Working knowledge of nuclear services. Familiarity with the Canadian regulatory environment (CNSC), utility procurement processes, and project delivery models is a strong asset

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, long-cycle sales processes and multi-stakeholder relationships

• Experience supporting or leading capture and proposal efforts for government or utility contracts

• Proficiency with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms and pipeline management disciplines

• Post-secondary education in engineering, business, or a related technical field; equivalent industry experience will be considered

What Sets You Apart

• You've worked inside a nuclear utility, regulator, or service provider, and you understand how procurement decisions get made

• You're as comfortable in a technical conversation with an engineer as you are presenting a business case to an executive

• You know the Canadian nuclear landscape: the utilities, the projects in development, and the organizations shaping the sector's next decade

## Additional Requirements

• Must be eligible for Government of Canada security clearances and nuclear site security clearances.

• Ability to travel to client sites on a regular basis.

$100,000–$150,000 annual base salary plus performance-based commission.

• Drive and contribute to security backlog activities from analysis and refinement through implementation, verification, and continuous improvement.

• Design, build, operate, and maintain nodal and end-to-end verification lab environments.

• Plan and execute system-level verification activities across radio products, releases, and lab setups.

• Reproduce, debug, and support resolution of complex field and customer issues.

• Work closely with hardware, software, and system teams to understand platform constraints, verification gaps, and product-level risks.

• Develop and maintain automation pipelines, including AI-enabled workflows, to orchestrate security and verification tools and generate structured reports.

• Provide technical guidance to software development teams when required, including support for design reviews, implementation discussions, and complex problem resolution.

• Document test strategies, results, recommendations, and supporting evidence clearly, and collaborate with cross-functional teams on remediation and continuous improvement.

## The skills you bring:

• Hands-on experience with nodal-level or virtualized network functions in telecom or similar distributed systems, including lab build, deployment, and system-level verification.

• Strong background in radio security engineering and end-to-end verification, supported by Linux, networking, automation, and field-debugging expertise.

• Minimum 5 yearsof industry experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, vulnerability assessment, secure software development, or related security domains.

• Solid understanding of key network and security protocols such as IPsec/IKEv2, TLS, SNMP, and LDAP, with the ability to interpret protocol traces.

• Practical development experience with C/C++, Python, embedded Linux, Git/Gerrit, code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.

• Experience with security testing workflows and tools such as fuzzing suites, web security tools, vulnerability scanners, SBOM/SCA tools, and packet analyzers.

• Practical experience using AI or scripting to automate security and verification workflows, orchestrate multiple tools, and generate structured reports.

## Nice to have:

• Background in radio or access network hardware, or previous collaboration with hardware design and validation teams.

• Experience integrating security and verification tooling into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps-style environments.

• Familiarity with secure software development models such as SSDF and creating documentation, guidelines, or design rules for development teams.

• Experience with threat and risk analysis at system or feature level.

• A self-driven mindset for continuous security learning, including participation in external security forums, communities, or standards activities.

• Security-related certifications such as CISSP, GSEC, OSCP, or similar.

• Familiarity with cybersecurity standards, regulations, and emerging technologies relevant to radio products, including ISO 27001, ISO 21434, IEC 62443, the EU Radio Equipment Directive, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIST cybersecurity guidance, and post-quantum cryptography principles.

## Horizontal Machining Center Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, Ohio

## Purpose

Operates a horizontal boring mill, with and without continuous path control, performing contouring, boring, facing, turning, counter boring, grooving, undercutting, reaming, milling, drilling and tapping operations to produce quality product in accordance with established quality and procedural guidelines. Makes in-process changes to programs and edits/writes programs, as necessary, under the supervision of a programmer and/or immediate supervisor.

## Minimum Requirements

• A high school diploma or GED equivalency is required. Formal technical education is preferred, but not required. A minimum of three (3) years' technical experience in a similar role is desired.

• Must demonstrate ability to maintain detailed records, complete process documentation and other production records.

• Must be able to demonstrate proper use of instruments such as: dial indicators, verier calipers, precision instruments, micrometers, calipers, jacks, clamps, bolts, shim, jigs, fixtures, and angle plates.

• Must be able to recognize problems as programs are running and demonstrate ability to write/edit programs using both G and M coded controls (experience with Siemens and Fanuc controls preferred).

• Must be able to work with tolerances of .000" and to a microfinish 16 when necessary.

• U.S. citizenship is required.

• Must be open and available to working all shifts.

## Physical Demands

The characteristics listed below are representative of the physical demands required by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts, toxic, and caustic chemicals and fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment ranges from normal noise levels to loud.

## POSITION SUMMARY:

The Industrial Hygienist 3 serves as an industrial hygiene and safety resource for clean-up operations as a result of past transuranic (TRU) waste processing activities. Specific duties may include, but are not necessarily limited to, the development, maintenance and implementation of IHS policies, procedures, and process related to ES&H Programs. The IHS Professional will collaborate with their peers and the workforce in developing solutions to complex IHS problems that require in-depth analysis of work activities.

426.2: This position is subject to DOE Order 426.2, Personnel Selection, Training, and Qualification Requirements for DOE Nuclear Facilities, which establishes entry-level requirements to ensure candidates selected for specific positions can successfully perform the requirements of the job.

## MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

## Include, but are not limited to:

• Providing Industrial Hygiene & Safety (IHS) technical guidance to operations on environmental remediation problems and issues

• Conducting investigations of the site to determine the extent of contamination and ensure that work will be in accordance with all federal, state regulatory requirements and within N3B's Industrial Hygiene & Safety policies

• Providing input to the N3B Safety and Health Programs team related to developing, maintaining and revising IHS processes/programs necessary for ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements.

• Applying the hierarchy of controls to eliminate or mitigate hazards while ensuring mission success.

• Monitoring and reviewing the Industrial Hygiene & Safety performance of subcontractors in the areas of work planning, work execution, installation, inspections, material control, and other areas of their work to confirm that they are performing in accordance with N3Bs subcontract work program (Exhibit F process).

• Performs other duties as required.

## Minium Qualifications:

Advanced knowledge[DS1] of strategic communications planning, as well as experience in managing EM communications programs.

• Frequent use and application of technical standards, principles, theories, concepts and techniques.in Industrial Hygiene, including use of various sampling and analysis methods, personal exposure monitoring, safety program development, and related recordkeeping.

• Excellent communication skills to effectively convey major elements of IHS, clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing to diverse audiences.

• Experience preparing, reviewing and presenting Industrial Hygiene & Safety protection reports.

• Demonstrated advanced experience in the identification, application and interpretation of federal codes, standards, and regulations in several Industrial Hygiene & Safety program areas, including chemical safety, beryllium, exposure assessment, cryogens, confined spaces, fall protection, and other IHS areas.

• Advanced experience conducting research, investigating alternative solutions, and recommending solutions on problems affecting CH-TRU worker health & safety.

• Experience with and advanced knowledge of IHS sampling and measurement equipment including a comprehensive understanding of functionality, calibration, and interpretation of measurements.

## EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

• A bachelor’s degree in a technical (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physiology, etc.) Five (5) years of related experience. Per DOE O 426.2, this position requires a bachelors’ degree, two (2) of job related and one year of nuclear experience.

## LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS:

• Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) by the Board for Global EHS Credentialing and/or Certified Safety Professional (CSP) by the Board of Certified Safety Professionals is preferred.

## BUSINESS ASSOCIATION:

Represents organization as a prime contact on contracts or projects. Interacts with senior internal and external personnel on significant matters often requiring coordination between organizations.

## IMPACT:

Exerts some influence on the overall objectives and long-range goals of the organization. Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve objectives would normally have serious effect upon the administration of the organization.

## WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL REQUIREME NTS:

• Individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

• This position works in an office environment with low noise levels due mostly to office equipment.

## Position Overview:

As an Instrumentation and Control (I&C) System Design Engineer, contribute to a variety of projects, working in a team environment. Depending upon individual project needs, duties will include the development of control system requirements, architectures and interfaces, detailed design of control systems, specification of instruments and sensors, perform setpoint calculations and logic development for a wide variety of systems and subsystems. The role requires a broad, multi-disciplined background in both I&C and electrical systems.

## Location:

Onsite in Lynchburg, Virginia at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as an Instrumentation and Control (I&C) System Design Engineer:

• Work independently and within a team environment to develop innovative solutions to complex problems, infusing best practices and experience.

• Develop algorithms, architectures, and requirements for control systems.

• Utilize system and interface requirements to prepare appropriate design documentation.

• Develop system-level design documents, including requirements, specifications, setpoint documents, control narratives, and system design descriptions.

• Develop component-level design documents to select and specify I&C hardware, including sensors, PLCs, processors, I/O devices and embedded controllers.

• Provide technical oversight of vendors designing and/or implementing components and systems to BWXT specifications.

• Collaborate on the creation, development, and presentation of technical briefings.

• Recognize and solve problems. Recommend solutions to technical problems.

• Interface, coordinate, and support other design disciplines such as mechanical design, system design, procurement, and testing.

• Contribute to proposals, RFQ’s and business development efforts as needed.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of seven (7) years of related experience is required.

• Must have design experience in instrumentation and/or control systems.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills including technical writing.

• Must have working knowledge of nuclear-related IEEE standards, e.g. IEEE-603, -323, etc.

• Must be familiar with standard MS Office applications.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Detailed knowledge of NEC standards, NRC guidelines, and nuclear-related IEEE standards.

• System modeling and simulation experience in Flownex or Simulink and exposure to SysML.

• Expertise in autonomous control algorithms and systems.

• Familiarity with Systems Engineering principles and tools including INCOSE guidelines model-based systems engineering, CAMEO and/or PLM systems such as Enovia.

• Ability to design, develop, and/or specify sensors for extreme operating environments.

• Familiarity with nuclear power plant systems.

• Active DOD or DOE security clearance.

## Summary

As an Assembler, you play a key role in producing the high‑quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) storage tanks and components that Mattr is known for. Reporting to the Production Manager or Shift Supervisor, you will join FRP components using a hand lay‑up process to build single‑wall and double‑wall shells, domes, and related products. Your work directly supports safe, reliable production performance and contributes to meeting customer and plant expectations for quality, efficiency, and safety.

• Operate machinery, equipment, and hand tools to cut, shape, splice, and fit plastic materials into parts and assemblies.

• Follow blueprints and drawings to join shell halves using the hand lay‑up process.

• Install fittings, gauge plates, manways, and other components and accessories.

• Cut and prepare composite materials from patterns to join parts and assemblies.

• Make minor adjustments or repairs to products as needed.

• Perform regular inspections to ensure work meets company quality standards.

• Complete process sheets and time cards accurately and on time.

• Use grinders, trimmers, measuring tools, rollers, and other equipment; perform preventive maintenance when required.

• Support additional assembly tasks as needed to meet production requirements.

• Follow all company Health, Safety, and Security rules and maintain a positive safety attitude.

• Immediately report incidents to a supervisor; participate in investigations when required.

## Work Practices & Accountability

• Use materials effectively to reduce waste and support efficient production workflow.

• Maintain quality control and manage time and materials to meet plant schedules.

## Qualifications

## Education & Experience

• High School Diploma or equivalent required.

• Experience in an FRP manufacturing facility or similar environment is preferred but not required.

## Skills & Abilities

• Strong production and quality‑focused mindset.

• Ability to read and follow blueprints and drawings.

• Solid verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively with team members in a fast‑paced environment.

• Willingness to learn new tools, equipment, and materials used in above‑ground and underground tank manufacturing.

• Basic mathematical problem‑solving ability.

• Experience with Lean manufacturing principles is an asset.

## Physical Requirements

• Frequent climbing, balancing, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, grasping, and feeling to complete assembly tasks.

• Ability to work with hand tools, power tools, and production equipment.

• Clear near‑to‑mid‑range vision and depth perception required for safe, accurate work.

## Working Conditions

• Work performed in a fiberglass reinforced plastic manufacturing plant.

• Regular exposure to dust, fibers, chemical/solvent fumes, moving equipment, and plant noise.

• Temperature variations depending on season.

• Use of hand tools, power tools, forklifts, overhead hoists, and measuring equipment.

## Waste Management Specialist Sr

## Position Overview:

This position is responsible for ensuring that all aspects of the NFS Transportation/Waste Management (T/WM) programs are compliant with federal and state waste regulations. Specific attributes include waste characterization, packaging, storage, and disposition including compliance with RCRA, TSCA, NRC and DOT.

## Location:

Onsite in Erwin, TN.

## Your Day to Day as a Waste Management Specialist Senior:

• Interface with on-site waste generators to develop solutions to technical problems associated with T/WM.

• Provide direction to waste generators for adherence to on-site and off-site waste acceptance criteria.

• Review and approve work requests, procedures, and drawings detailing proposed process changes and determine waste characterization, packaging, storage and disposal strategies. Waste streams included are RCRA, low level radioactive waste, mixed waste, PCB waste, and sanitary waste.

• Develop/revise waste characterization document.

• Prepare sampling and analysis plans in accordance with EPA guidance documents and SW-846.

• Interpret laboratory analytical data and characterize material for disposal in accordance with applicable regulations and disposal/treatment facilities waste acceptance criteria.

• Provide T&WM technical guidance to staff and waste generators.

## Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering, Waste Management, Environmental Science or related science, engineering, or technical field OR 8 years of equivalent experience acceptable in lieu of degree.

Over 10 years experience since degree or without degree must have 18 years' experience. Must have a working knowledge of RCRA, DOT, and radioactive waste management pertaining to the packaging and management of hazardous, radioactive, and mixed waste.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

The QNX Sensor Framework team develops a middleware software framework that simplifies access to cameras and sensors for automotive, robotics, industrial and embedded applications. The framework facilitates access to cameras and other sensors such as LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU through simple C APIs.

As a member of the team, you'll help deliver production-quality software used by some of the world's leading technology companies. This is an excellent opportunity for new graduates and junior developers to gain hands-on experience with embedded software, real-time operating systems, sensor technologies, and modern software development practices while being mentored by experienced engineers.

## What you will do:

• Develop embedded software written primarily in C and C++

• Add support for new cameras, sensors, and hardware platforms

• Design and implement new framework features and APIs

• Create and enhance sample applications, tools, and utilities

• Investigate and root-cause complex technical problems

• Work directly with hardware including cameras, LiDAR, radar, GPS, and IMU sensors

• Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and collaborative software development

• Support customers integrating sensors and cameras into their products

• Learn from experienced engineers while contributing to production software used worldwide

## What we are looking for:

• Programming skills in C and C++

• Analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills

• Knowledge of operating system fundamentals, computer architecture, and embedded systems concepts

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• Self-motivated with a passion for learning and building high-quality software

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline

## It's great if you have:

• Experience with embedded software development, could be project, coops or professional

• Experience with QNX, Linux or other embedded operating systems

• Experience with device driver and low-level software development

• Familiarity with computer vision, image processing, graphics, or machine learning

• Experience working with cameras, sensors, robotics, or automotive systems

## Why join us?

• Work on technology that makes a real-world impact

• Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge embedded systems

• Learn from experienced engineers while building production software

• Tackle challenging technical problems and broaden your expertise

The work we’re doing is not incremental—it’s foundational, and it’s accelerating the industry. Come join us!

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview:

As our Field Operations Production Technician 3, you will perform highly technical work in both radiological and industrial environments. This position requires sound radiological work practices, strong trade knowledge and skills, and strict compliance with applicable safety policies, procedures, and regulations.

You will support a broad range of projects, including demolition and decontamination (D&D), new equipment and system installations, modifications, and repairs in various industrial settings. You will work with specialized equipment and tools while applying strong problem-solving skills and collaborating with other members of the project team.

Safety is a critical component of this role. You will be expected to follow established safety protocols, radiological controls, procedures, and regulations while performing work that can have significant implications for personal and public health and safety.

## Location:

On-site at NOG-L Mt. Athos Site in Lynchburg, Virginia.

## Your Day to Day as a Field Operations Production Technician 3:

• Report to the Project Manager and Field Operations Manager.

• Prepare the work site for daily activities, including staging the materials, tools, and equipment required to perform assigned tasks.

• Perform assigned daily tasks using engineering procedures, engineering drawings, and applicable safety procedures and Job Hazard Analyses under the direction of the Field Operations Manager and Field Operations Supervisor.

• Perform project activities using mechanical and electrical trade skills, including new installations, modifications, and repairs of equipment, systems, buildings, and structures.

• Perform radiological work using sound radiological work control practices while adhering to applicable policies and procedures. Work may include equipment removal, decontamination of contaminated equipment, equipment and facility modifications, and radiological waste disposal.

• Wear the appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) necessary for protection from hazards associated with assigned tasks. PPE may include anti-contamination clothing, safety glasses, safety shoes, goggles, face shields, hard hats, safety gloves, safety harnesses, and respirators.

• Comply with applicable health and safety requirements while performing all assigned tasks.

• Maintain a productive and safe pace of work to complete assigned activities within established time constraints.

• Obtain and maintain all certifications and qualifications required for the position.

• Perform field walk-downs to support project estimates, readiness reviews, project closeout, and lessons learned, as directed by the Field Operations Manager.

## Required Qualifications:

• Must be a U.S. citizen

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance.

• Minimum A.S. degree in technical field + 4 years of experience, or minimum 8 years of relevant experience

• Trade experience in at least one of the following areas: electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or plumbing.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering blueprints, drawings, and procedures.

• Ability to build mechanical and/or electrical systems and components using drawings and detailed work instructions.

• Experience using basic hand tools, including power and manual tools.

• Ability to interact with peers in a positive and collaborative manner.

• Must successfully complete applicable BWXT pre-employment requirements, including a security background check and drug screening, and maintain applicable employment requirements.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Applicable military experience.

• Experience across multiple trades, including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and/or plumbing.

• Experience operating equipment such as forklifts, material lifts, aerial lifts, personnel lifts, and scissor lifts.

## Physical Abilities:

• Ability to work at heights and from ladders, scaffolds, and personnel lifts.

• Ability to stand throughout a 10-hour shift and generally remain on your feet while working in the work area.

• Ability to frequently stoop, bend, crouch, crawl, and kneel.

• Ability to frequently push and pull.

• Ability to frequently climb stairs and ladders.

• Ability to maintain balance while performing assigned work.

• Ability to regularly use hands to operate tools and controls.

• Ability to frequently move and lift materials and equipment of varying sizes and weights up to and including 50 pounds.

• Ability to frequently operate various hand and power tools.

• Ability to work in noisy, dirty, isolated, or crowded environments.

• Ability to work in environments that may include temperature variations, fumes, moving machinery, and hazardous materials.

• Ability to don and wear required personal protective clothing and equipment, which may include protective work suits, safety shoes, gloves, foot protection, safety harnesses, and respiratory equipment such as a powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR).

Join a team focused on the design and integration of custom mixed-signal macros within an ASIC flow for next-generation high-baud-rate optical modems. Work involves advanced nanoscale CMOS technologies that enable high-performance optical and electrical interfaces. The role provides opportunities to contribute to mixed-signal circuit design and IP integration activities in a collaborative engineering environment.

## How you will make an impact:

• Utilize knowledge of electronics, mathematics, VLSI design, and computer-aided design tools to solve engineering design challenges.

• Generate representations of mixed-signal blocks for the digital design team, including Verilog, Library Exchange Format, Liberty timing files, documentation, preliminary and final layout files, and SPICE netlists for chip-level LVS as part of IP integration activities.

• Develop understanding of the design and place-and-route of macro-level standard cell interfaces to facilitate analog-digital timing handoff and static timing analysis.

• Contribute to digital integrated circuit design using standard cell libraries and develop design-for-test solutions and models aligned with ASIC test methodologies.

## The must haves:

• Education: Completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical or computing engineering.

• Experience: Previous internship, co-op, or applied project experience relevant to the role.

• Analog design principles and experience with schematic capture, layout, extraction, pre- and post-layout analog simulation, design rule checking, and layout versus schematic verification.

• Fully conversant with the custom IC tools from Cadence Design Systems.

• A solid understanding of digital design, including Verilog/RTL, place-and-route, and static timing analysis.

• Prior experience with Cadence Innovus or Synopsys Integrated Circuit Compiler II.

## Grow with us

Location: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada – Ericsson will not provide immigration support.

Approximately 40% of the world’s mobile traffic is carried through an Ericsson network. Our 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions are already connecting billions of devices, and we are actively shaping the evolution toward 6G. Within this context, our L1 Software Development team in RCE RAN Performance designs and implements the Physical Layer baseband functions – the signal‑processing engine at the heart of 5G.

We are looking for a curious, driven junior developer who is passionate about high‑performance embedded software, low‑level programming, and cloud‑ready systems. If you are excited by innovation and want your code to help power networks around the world, we’d like to hear from you.

Within our organization, we work on two Ericsson products, our purpose-built multi-core ASIC and newly deployed, Cloud based Radio Access Network. Our mission is twofold:

• Develop high‑quality L1 features that grow our customers’ businesses and improve network performance.

• Secure the product’s future through cutting‑edge technology, cloud‑native architectures, and continuous innovation.

You will join a collaborative, international team that works closely with global RAN and platform experts, using modern development practices to deliver robust, performant software.

## What you will do:

• Designing, developing, and testing L1 software components on Ericsson’s 5G processing platform and related cloud/COTS environments.

• Implementing and enhancing Physical Layer baseband features across a range of deployment scenarios and frequency bands defined by 3GPP.

• Performing continuous analysis, clarifying requirements, and contributing to technical solutions that balance performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Working in both manual and highly automated environments to integrate new software modules and algorithms, and to troubleshoot complex issues.

• Applying real‑time software development practices and knowledge of wireless communication protocols (for example NR/5G, LTE, WCDMA, WLAN).

• Participating in code reviews, inspections, and design discussions to help maintain high software quality standards.

• Developing and maintaining test coverage to ensure new changes do not degrade existing functionality.

• Exploring cloud‑native platforms and learning how to optimize L1 software for containerized and virtualized environments.

• Using AI/ML tools and techniques where appropriate to accelerate development, improve performance, or enable intelligent automation.

• Contributing to a modern, agile way of working, including sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement activities.

• Documenting system analysis, software designs, and test plans in line with internal standards.

## The skills you will bring:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Communications Systems, AI/ML, or a related field.

• 0–4 years of professional experience in a relevant domain.

• 2+ years of experience with embedded software, low‑level programming, and cloud‑ready systems
