## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## What do we do?

The mechanical engineering co-op student will join a multi-disciplinary R&D team that is continually and rapidly advancing new products from conception to their fully-realized, mature state - deployed around the world as the foundation of the optical internet.

The team works on a variety of different products applied in optical communication networks: optical amplifiers, wavelength-selectable switches, optical channel monitors and highly-integrated circuit packs. In addition to designing the products, the team also designs the precision production tooling essential to build the products in volume. Creative, reliable tooling designs are developed, documented and built within tight schedules.

What will you do in this role?

The mechanical engineering co-op student will join a multi-disciplinary R&D team that is continually and rapidly advancing new products from conception to their fully-realized, mature state - deployed around the world as the foundation of the optical internet.

The team works on a variety of different products applied in optical communication networks: optical amplifiers, wavelength-selectable switches, optical channel monitors and highly-integrated circuit packs. In addition to designing the products, the team also designs the precision production tooling essential to build the products in volume. Creative, reliable tooling designs are developed, documented and built within tight schedules.

## Responsibilities:

• Participate in the development of precision production tooling designs.

• Prepare engineering drawings of the required parts and assemblies using 3D solid CAD tools such as Solid Edge to develop fully-documented detailed mechanical designs.

• Apply a solid knowledge of mechanical engineering and manufacturing philosophies to develop new solutions and to evaluate the merits and risks of alternative concepts.

• Apply our mechanical engineering design process to compile design requirements, evaluate conceptual designs, deliver detail design documentation and evaluate performance of realized designs.

• Participate as a positive team member, working effectively with colleagues to ensure that design choices which span multiple disciplines are balanced and optimized for the overall performance, manufacturability and cost-effectiveness of the tooling solutions.

We aim to provide a high-quality learning experience. Depending on the aptitude and interests of the mechanical engineering co-op student, the role will provide opportunities to gain exposure to topics such as opto-mechanical product design, electronics packaging and the application of Finite Element Methods and Computational Fluid Dynamics to product engineering.

What experience will allow you the greatest success in this role?

Recommended Education:

• 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year student in a Mechanical Engineering Bachelor’s Degree program.

• Candidates must be currently enrolled in a recognized Canadian post-secondary institution.

Skills:

• Demonstrated proficiency in producing part and assembly drawings compliant with ANSI drafting standards;

• Proficiency in the use of a 3D solid modeling mechanical CAD tool such as SolidWorks or SolidEdge;

• Ability to demonstrate an aptitude for detailed mechanical design;

• Practical and theoretical knowledge of metal machining processes, design of machined parts, selection of engineering materials, structural mechanics;

• Demonstrated ability to apply excellent design judgment and engineering skills;

• Demonstrated ability to consistently apply attention to detail in pursuit of high quality.

## Desired Qualifications

• Knowledge of and ability to apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GDT) practices;

• Experience with engineering document management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems;

• Practical and theoretical knowledge of a variety of fabrication processes: sheet metal, injection molded plastics, electronic assemblies, optical assemblies, Design for Manufacturability.

Event Calendar, Strategy & Portfolio ROI - Own the end-to-end event calendar and strategy across a region or channel, not just individual events. - Design the playbook for how events, dinners, and tradeshows are planned, executed, and measured. - Ensure pre-show, on-site, and follow-up processes are consistent across multiple simultaneous events. - Evaluate ROI across the portfolio of events and reallocate budget/effort toward what performs. - Improve systems and tools (tech stack, automation, templates) to increase team efficiency. Vendor & Partner Portfolio Management - Manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships across events and channels, including performance discussions. - Align AEs, CAMs, and partners across multiple events on shared priorities and expectations. - Build standardized stakeholder processes (partner briefing templates, AE requirement docs) to reduce friction. A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU - 6–8 years of B2B field marketing or event marketing experience, including experience owning a portfolio of events or a regional/channel program, ideally in SaaS or technology. - A track record of evaluating ROI across multiple events and reallocating budget or effort toward what performs. - Experience managing a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships, including performance conversations and escalations. - Experience building GTM programs targeted at specific verticals or strategic accounts, ideally including Restaurant or Financial Institution segments. - Demonstrated ability to build systems, playbooks, or templates that other team members plan against. - Experience coaching or mentoring more junior marketers on stakeholder management and event execution. - Comfort acting as the escalation point for vendor, partner, or internal stakeholder issues. NICE TO HAVES - Experience marketing into Restaurant, Financial Institution, or other physical-security-relevant verticals. - Familiarity with event management platforms (e.g., Cvent, Splash) and marketing automation tooling (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot). - Experience supporting enterprise or strategic account segments alongside a direct sales team. - Exposure to account-based marketing (ABM) concepts and vertical-specific campaign design. - Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. ROLE EXPECTATIONS This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are a key contributors within their team, they act as a mentor to colleagues, not only within their team, but also cross functionally and can be relied on for strategic collaboration on team and org wide initiatives. In This Role, You'll Be Expected To: - Lead projects as the lead while providing direction and able to keep key stakeholders informed - Coach and mentor other employees through complex problems, goals, tasks and initiatives, giving constructive feedback. - Consistently deliver on their priorities and commitments - Drive process improvements and influence adoption. - Builds frameworks, templates, or standards that scale team effectiveness What Success Looks Like: - Enterprise pipeline and account penetration that visibly grow within Restaurant, Financial Institution, and Strategic segments because of the GTM programs you built - A portfolio ROI framework the team trusts, with budget and effort clearly shifted toward the event formats and vendors that actually perform - A playbook, templates, and processes that the broader field marketing team plans against by default, not just when you're in the room - Vendor, partner, and stakeholder issues that get resolved at your level, with AEs, CAMs, and partners aligned before problems reach leadership SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States. - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. OUR VALUES We do things the Solink way: - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too. - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar. - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work. - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required. - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth. - Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need. - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs. - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together. - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics. - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun. WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect: 1. Intro call with our Talent Team 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable) 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members 5. Reference Checks 6. Offer & Onboarding 🎉 PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward. NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION. SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

## Position Overview:

BWXT is seeking an experienced Engineering Codes & Methods Platform Lead for our Advanced Technologies (AT) office in Lynchburg, VA. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical lead for a team responsible for the computational tools and methods that underpin our research and engineering efforts. This role requires substantial technical expertise, demonstrated leadership capability, and the ability to coordinate complex activities across multidisciplinary teams. The successful candidate will possess deep knowledge of modeling and simulation requirements, software quality assurance, and the physics associated with reactor and fuel systems—including neutronics, thermal hydraulics, and structural analyses. They must have exceptional interpersonal skills to coordinate multiple activities simultaneously across joint organizational teams.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Engineering Codes and Methods Platform Lead:

• Create models and simulations of nuclear reactors and nuclear fuels with historical, specialty, and modern computational tools.

• Coordinate and/or work with teams in the generation of computational methods, analytical procedures, and organizational / technical processes associated with computational tools and methods.

• Coordinate multiple research and engineering activities simultaneously within a joint organizational team using scrum project management framework.

• Execute project engineering activities (task plans, schedules, etc.).

• Provide technical and strategic direction to teams, ensuring alignment with program objectives and quality standards.

• Foster a high-performing team environment, including collaboration across multiphysics areas of structural mechanics, thermal/hydraulics, and neutronics.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience is required.

• Must have an understanding of nuclear and non-nuclear phenomena that impact the performance and behavior of systems during normal and off-normal events.

• Must have an understanding of static and time-dependent behaviors and attributes of physics behind nuclear and non-nuclear systems.

• Must have knowledge of software configuration, quality, and development best practices and standards is required. Knowledge of revision-controlled software releases through a centralized version control system is required.

• Must be able to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely written and verbal communication.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including:
• Experience facilitating technical teams in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.

• Ability to provide clear direction, constructive feedback, and effective mentorship

• Strong decision-making skills with the ability to prioritize and balance competing demands

• Proven success in fostering collaborative, inclusive, and accountable team culture

• Travel (<25%) domestic and international.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with nuclear modeling and simulation and relevant nuclear quality standards.

• Knowledge of MOOSE applications.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

At our Oak Ridge, Tennessee Enrichment Operations site, you will join teams working at the forefront of advanced nuclear manufacturing, precision engineering, and mission‑critical national security programs. Our work requires a wide range of skills, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who share a passion for meaningful impact and technical advancement.

Position Overview
As our Principal Data Engineer for Semantic Modeling & Industrial Knowledge Architecture, you will lead the design, engineering, and governance of large‑scale semantic data models and industrial knowledge systems that support real‑time operational intelligence across advanced manufacturing environments. You will build unified namespaces, enterprise knowledge graphs, and ontology-driven architectures that ensure consistent interpretation, traceability, and interoperability of mission‑critical industrial data. This role partners with controls engineers, data architects, AI/ML teams, and manufacturing SMEs to deliver enterprise-grade foundations for analytics, predictive maintenance, simulation workflows, and AI-driven automation in a high-security DOE/NNSA environment.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee (Q Clearance Required)

Your Day to Day as a Principal Data Engineer
• Design semantic data models and ontologies enabling unified interpretation of industrial data across chemical, aerospace, automotive, and high-throughput manufacturing sectors.
• Develop enterprise knowledge graph components using OWL, RDF, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, and SPARQL.
• Build unified namespaces aligned with ISA‑95 and W3C standards to ensure cross-system interoperability.
• Architect scalable storage solutions including time-series databases, knowledge graphs, and lakehouse systems.
• Engineer pipelines to ingest, reconcile, and contextualize structured, semi-structured, streaming, and unstructured data.
• Apply governance practices including versioning, modularization, URI strategies, and quality gates.
• Map relational models into semantic representations using R2RML/RML.
• Support AI/ML and simulation teams by embedding semantic models into analytics and automation workflows.
• Lead workshops with SMEs to define domain concepts, modeling requirements, and competency questions.
• Implement data quality controls, lineage, validation frameworks, and anomaly detection.
• Develop reusable frameworks for units modeling, hierarchical structures, identifier normalization, and event modeling.
• Mentor engineering teams and contribute to enterprise data modernization strategies.
• Maintain semantic specifications, governance artifacts, workflows, and compliance documentation.
• Participate in DOE/NNSA audits, reviews, and inspections.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Engineering, Information Science, Computer Science, or related STEM field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in data engineering, semantic modeling, ontology design, or knowledge graph development.
• Experience designing ontologies using OWL, RDF, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, and SPARQL.
• Hands-on experience with pipelines for structured, semi-structured, streaming, and unstructured data.
• Experience integrating OT/IoT, edge devices, and SCADA systems into unified data environments.
• Strong knowledge of data architecture principles and modern storage paradigms.
• Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms and Kubernetes.
• Understanding of semantic governance and lifecycle management.
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance.
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Information Science, or related field.
• Experience in automotive, aerospace, chemical, or high‑throughput manufacturing sectors.
• Consulting or enterprise-scale modernization experience.
• Experience with Unified Namespace, data mesh/fabric, and graph-enabled AI frameworks.
• Familiarity with Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS analytics.
• Experience with semantic modularization, versioning, and interoperability.
• Experience leading global engineering teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits.
• Flexible work schedules and paid time off (as applicable).
• Professional development including mentorship and continuing education support.
• An inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
• Opportunities to contribute to mission-driven national security programs.
• Continuous learning and training for career growth.

This is a newly unified leadership role, bringing Product Marketing and Customer Marketing together so the story we tell to prospects and the story we tell to existing customers reinforce each other. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Positioning & Messaging - Own product positioning, messaging, and narrative across Solink’s platform and key products and industries we serve. - Develop and defend a category point of view that differentiates Solink from adjacent and competing solutions. - Test and refine messaging with customers, prospects, and sales to ensure it resonates and converts. GTM Strategy - Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for major feature and product launches, partnering with Product, Demand Gen, Sales, and Customer Success. - Build launch playbooks and processes that scale across a growing product portfolio. - Identify opportunities to grow adoption and ARPU through positioning, packaging, and GTM for new features and add-ons. Competitive Intelligence - Own Solink’s competitive intelligence program, keeping a current, accurate view of the competitive landscape. - Run a win/loss program that turns deal outcomes into sharper positioning and enablement. - Educate internal teams - Sales, Marketing, Product - on competitive threats and how to respond to them. Sales Enablement - Build and scale sales enablement content — battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and training — that drives rep proficiency and win rate. - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to ensure enablement keeps pace with the roadmap and competitive landscape. - Measure and improve enablement adoption and its impact on ramp time and win rate. Analyst Relations (AR) - Build Solink’s Analyst Relations program from the ground up, establishing relationships with relevant industry analysts. - Prepare briefings, RFI/RFP responses, and positioning materials for analyst evaluations and reports. - Translate analyst feedback into product, positioning, and GTM recommendations for leadership. Customer Marketing & Advocacy - Own customer marketing strategy - references, case studies, testimonials, and advocacy programs that support both sales, demand gen, channel and brand. - Partner with Demand Gen and Customer Success on programs that drive adoption, expansion, and retention among existing customers. - Build a scalable customer reference and advisory program to support field marketing pg growth, competitive deals and category-building efforts. A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU - 10+ years of experience in product marketing, with meaningful experience in customer marketing, competitive intelligence, or analyst relations. - A proven track record building category positioning that differentiates a product in a competitive market. - Experience leading go-to-market strategy and execution for major product launches end-to-end. - Experience building or scaling a sales enablement function, with measurable impact on win rate or ramp time. - Comfort building new functions from scratch, including Analyst Relations or customer advocacy programs. - Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting positioning and strategy to CMO, executive, and board-level audiences. - Experience building and coaching a team of product and/or customer marketers. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Solink has a clear, differentiated category position that Sales, Marketing, Channel, and Product all use consistently. - Major launches land on time with strong adoption and a measurable revenue contribution. - Sales wins more competitive deals, supported by sharp, current competitive intelligence and enablement. - Solink has an active, credible presence with relevant industry analysts. - Existing customers become a growing source of references, advocacy, and expansion revenue. NICE TO HAVES - Experience in physical security, video surveillance, IoT, or a related B2B technology industry. - Experience building an Analyst Relations function in a company that didn’t previously have one. - Experience scaling a product or customer marketing function as a company grows past $100M+ ARR. - Familiarity with sales enablement and customer marketing platforms (e.g., HubSpot, SalesForce, Highspot, Seismic, Gainsight). https://truecontext.bamboohr.com/careers.body:
#CareersThatKickSaas! When something breaks in a customer's field operation, you are who they reach out to. TrueContext runs the forms, workflows, and data capture that thousands of field technicians depend on every day, so a stalled integration can leave a crew standing around a job site. This role is blended by design: you pick up the ticket, reproduce the issue, and carry it to fix yourself.

The Customer Success Manager owns the customer's outcomes and the Account Manager owns the commercial relationship. You own the problem in front of you: quick acknowledgement, a real diagnosis, and an answer the customer understands. For most users, this is the most visible evidence they have that we are dependable.

What you'll do

Own the ticket, start to finish

Work the queue across email, portal, and phone. Figure out what the customer is actually trying to accomplish, not just what they typed in the ticket, and stay with it through to resolution.

Most of the job is diagnosis. Reproduce the problem, then narrow it:

• Form behavior: conditional logic, repeatable sections, calculated fields, validation rules

• Data Source and Data Destination failures: refresh schedules, mapping errors, payload formatting

• API responses and integration logs, to work out whether the break sits with us, with the customer's connected system, or in the configuration between them

• Mobile issues on iOS and Android: offline sync, device performance, version mismatches

When it turns out to be a configuration choice, show the customer what to change. When it is a bug, write it up well enough that Engineering can act without three rounds of follow-up questions.

Handle escalations and incidents

Escalate early rather than after a customer has run out of patience. Hand Engineering a reproduction path and the real business impact. During platform incidents, keep affected customers posted and close the loop with each one afterward. On-call for urgent evening and weekend issues is shared across the team.

Make the next ticket unnecessary

Recurring problems should end up as help articles and internal runbooks instead of repeat tickets. Keep the ticketing system honest while you are at it: accurate categories, current status, resolution notes someone else could follow.

Be the early warning system

Support sees trouble before anyone else does. Pass ticket patterns and sentiment shifts to the Customer Success Manager and Account Manager so nobody is surprised at renewal. Same with Product: which parts of the platform generate the most friction, and the evidence to back it up. A well-argued support trend is one of the more reliable inputs into our roadmap.

What we're looking for

2 to 4 years in a technical support or a similar customer-facing technical role at a SaaS company. More than anything, you can take a vague description of a problem and narrow it to a cause.

You are comfortable reading API documentation, inspecting a JSON payload, and interpreting error code. Some exposure to REST APIs, webhooks, or integration platforms matters more here than any particular tool on your resume. Low-code, mobile, or field service platforms are a bonus, as is supporting apps on both iOS and Android.

You can explain a technical cause to a non-technical user without making them feel small. You are organized, because this is a queue rather than one problem at a time. You stay steady when a customer is upset and the answer is not obvious yet.

Helpful but not required: Jira Service Management or Salesforce Service Cloud; a background in field service, construction, utilities, or another regulated industry.

Location and Work Model

Ottawa, hybrid, with regular time in the office next to the Support, Product, and Engineering teams. This is a late shift role: 12pm to 8pm ET, Monday to Friday. Occasional weekend coverage is required depending on team availability, and the team shares an on-call rotation for urgent after-hours issues.

Some Extra Benefits

• Company-wide & team social events

• Wellness yearly allowance

• Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day)

• Catered lunches 2x per week

• An amazing office space with plenty of snacks, drinks, and space to collaborate

• Hybrid work environment (3 days a week in the office)

Salary Range

• $60,000 - $75,000 base salary

If you are looking for the opportunity to embrace and be part of a truly unique company culture, this opportunity might just be for you!

Calian is proud to continue its long-standing partnership with the Department of National Defence (DND), providing healthcare services to members of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF). Through our Healthcare Provider Contract, Calian employs healthcare professionals across Canada who play a vital role in supporting the health, readiness, and well-being of military personnel.

## About the role

Calian is currently seeking a Bilingual Licensed Practical Nurse (French and English) to join the Health Services team at Canadian Forces Base Saint-Jean (CFB Saint-Jean) in a full-time capacity.

This position offers an excellent work-life balance, featuring consistent daytime hours in a primary care environment. In this role, you will make a meaningful contribution to the health and well-being of Canadian Armed Forces members.

Key Responsibilities

• Minimum of one (1) year of full-time experience within the past three years in a primary care or ambulatory care setting serving an adult population.

• Must be fully bilingual in both French and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.

• Must be eligible to obtain a Reliability Status security clearance issued by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC).

Additional Information

• Contract position with the possibility of extension

• Full-time schedule: 37.5 hours per week (7.5 hours per day)

• Stable daytime schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

• Competitive health and wellness benefits

• Structured, collaborative, and rewarding work environment

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the health and well-being of those who serve our country

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. The Photonic Systems Technician supports the development, testing, and sustainment of Ciena's Reconfigurable Line System (RLS) and related photonic products. This hands-on role is responsible for supporting laboratory equipment and automated test environments, supporting optical and system-level testing activities, conducting initial field-return evaluations, and maintaining laboratory hardware and inventory. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering teams to support product development, qualification, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management activities.

## Key Responsibilities

• Perform incoming field-return triage, basic fault isolation, and hardware evaluation using field logs, alarms and test results

• Execute optical, electrical, and system-level testing on photonic networking products.

• Build, configure, operate, and maintain automated photonic laboratory test systems and test setups supporting engineering development, validation, and qualification activities.

• Support the operation and maintenance of automated photonic laboratory test systems and equipment.

• Maintain laboratory inventory, engineering hardware, optical modules, and field-return assets.

• Create and maintain laboratory procedures, test records, and test setup documentation

• Support engineering change activities, component evaluations, and alternate-source qualification testing.

## Required Skills & Qualifications

• Diploma in Electronics Engineering Technology, Photonics, Telecommunications Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related technical field.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience working with optical, telecommunications, networking, or electronic systems in a laboratory, manufacturing, or field support environment

• Experience building, configuring, and troubleshooting laboratory test setups.

• Familiarity with fiber optic handling, inspection, cleaning, and testing practices.

• Experience using electronic and optical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, optical power meters, OTDRs, spectrum analyzers, and digital multimeters.

• Basic understanding of electronics, telecommunications, and optical networking concepts.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage equipment, inventory, and multiple tasks.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with optical transport, ROADM, WSS, OCM, amplifier, or photonic systems.

• Experience with fiber optic troubleshooting and optical performance measurements.

• Experience with automated test environments or scripting tools such as Python.

• Experience supporting product development, manufacturing, repair, or failure-analysis environments.

Position Overview:
The Director of Programs – NOG J is responsible for leading all programs and strategic initiatives across the Jonesborough site, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and long-term business strategy. This role oversees program execution, governance, strategic planning, and cross functional coordination, and manages a team of program and project managers. The Director serves as a primary liaison between site leadership, corporate leadership, subcontractors, and key external stakeholders. This position drives operational excellence, resource optimization, and enterprise level transformation initiatives while ensuring all programs are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a Director of Programs:

• Define, communicate, and execute the vision and strategy for program management at NOG J.

• Align program objectives with site and enterprise strategic priorities.

• Serve as chief coordinator of strategic initiatives for the General Manager, Jonesborough.

• Lead development and monitoring of annual operating objectives, long range plans, and organizational performance metrics.

• Lead planning, prioritization, and implementation of programs and projects across the organization.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks to monitor performance, progress, and outcomes.

• Manage the strategic initiative portfolio and track execution against commitments.

• Provide functional oversight for subcontractors supporting program execution.

• Recruit, mentor, and develop a high performing team of program and project managers.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Lead cross functional teams to address critical business challenges and emerging opportunities.

• Serve as primary point of contact for senior leadership, regulators, customers, and key stakeholders on program related issues.

• Coordinate executive leadership meetings, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.

• Develop executive level presentations, reports, and recommendations for senior leadership, customers, regulators, and boards.

• Oversee resource allocation and ensure optimal utilization across programs.

• Identify and address resource constraints and conflicts proactively.

• Oversee program budgets and ensure financial discipline across initiatives.

• Identify organizational and programmatic risks and develop mitigation strategies that protect business performance and mission objectives.

• Establish key performance indicators to measure program and portfolio success.

• Provide regular reports on program status, challenges, and opportunities.

• Drive implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

• Continuously assess, improve, and standardize PMO processes, methodologies, and tools.

• Implement best practices in program, project, and portfolio management.

• Lead enterprise level operational improvement and transformation initiatives.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Technical Management, Project Management, or related field.

• Minimum 20 years of progressive leadership experience in operations, engineering, program management, manufacturing, strategic planning, or similar areas.

• Experience working directly with executive leadership in highly regulated, technically complex, or mission critical environments.

• Proven ability to lead enterprise wide initiatives requiring significant cross functional coordination.

• Strong business acumen and experience managing strategic priorities, organizational performance, and stakeholder relationships.

• Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver large scale programs on time and within budget.

• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q Clearance.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

## Preferred Qualifications:

## 7-Axis CNC HBM Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

We are hiring a 7-Axis CNC Horizontal Boring Mill Operator for our facility in Barberton, Ohio!

The individual hired for this role will operate horizontal boring mills with vertical machining and boring attachments, with continuous path, to perform contouring, trepanning, milling, face milling, drilling, tapping, boring, and other CNC operations necessary for machining large-scale precision components. Additionally, the machinist will:

• Grind and perform handwork to deburr, as necessary

• Use electronic measuring probe to inspect work, as required

• Work from process, drawings, manuscripts, verbal and written instructions

• Obtain necessary tooling and information for tape or manual data input operations

• Position and secure work piece and fixtures on table; properly assembles tooling and connects attachments

• Use precision instruments to physically measure setup; observe digital readout and compensate to orient work piece and machine to tape or MDI

• Make test cut and rechecks setup; make in-process compensations to keep prints, tapes, and manuscripts coordinated at all times

• Keep equipment and work area clean and orderly

• Verify identity and physical characteristics of materials, as required

• Maintain necessary records and complete process documentation and any production records, as required

• Perform minor maintenance on machines and assist maintenance personnel as required during repairs

## Minimum Requirements:

In order to thrive in this role, individuals must possess the necessary skills to safely perform the required tasks. This includes having a high school diploma or GED equivalence coupled with at least three (3) years of experience performing multi-axis CNC HBM machining operations, with and without continuous path. Lesser experience coupled with formal education and/or certification may be considered. Desired applicants must also:

• Be knowledgeable of all machine functions and coded commands (both G and M code)

• Work to 0.000” tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary

• Use higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices

• Have experience with grinders, tool setter, jacks, clamps, bolts, shims, jigs, fixtures, angle plates, rules, micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, lapping equipment, gages, levels, protractors, verniers, and light hand tools

• Be able to pass all proficiency testing for the position

• Be a U.S. citizen

• Must be open and available to working all shifts

• Successfully pass all pre-employment processes, including an extensive criminal background check, a physical examination and drug screen, verification of education and work history, and reference checks.

## Physical Demands

While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required communicate verbally and with written information; to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and use ladders inside and outside of parts being machined. The employee is occasionally required to lift and move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Pay for this position is $43.68 per hour and is complemented by a generous benefits package. Upon an offer, a relocation package is available for eligible candidates.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Location:

Onsite in Lynchburg, VA

## Your Day-to-Day as an Electrical Engineer:

As an Electrical Engineer for BWXT you will join a team that powers some of the most important nuclear and national‑security missions in the country. In this role, you will design and support complex electrical systems that keep our facilities running safely, reliably, and efficiently. Your work will directly contribute to BWXT’s mission of delivering high‑consequence engineering with uncompromising precision.

## What You’ll Do:

• Design complex electrical systems for facility infrastructure, including substations, switchgear, transformer sizing, VFDs, power monitoring, and related systems.

• Review and write technical specifications for facility equipment and buildings.

• Manage projects involving electrical infrastructure additions, replacements, and modifications.

• Collaborate closely with facility engineers, contractors, and maintenance teams to ensure safe and effective execution.

## Required Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology, plus a minimum of 2 years of experience.

• Working knowledge of National Electric Code, NFPA 70E and 79, and 29 CFR 1910 OSHA Standards.

• Ability to work during the annual plant shutdown (week of July 4).

• Ability to support occasional emergency needs related to power distribution (less than 5% of the time).

• Experience with industrial or facility infrastructure design and industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated superior written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to thrive in a collaborative, team‑oriented environment.

• Proven ability to work independently with minimal guidance, interpret business needs, and recommend practical solutions.

• High self‑motivation with excellent attention to detail.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

As an MSP Sales Specialist, you will be responsible for accelerating the growth of Check Point’s Workspace Security business through our Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) ecosystem.

This is a high-impact, individual contributor sales role for someone who understands how MSPs operate, how they make money, and how to turn strong partner relationships into scalable recurring revenue. You will own the MSP sales motion within your assigned market—from identifying and developing high-potential partners to building joint business plans, creating pipeline, and driving opportunities through close.

Success in this role requires a start-up mentality within a global organization. You must be comfortable building new business, challenging the status quo, moving quickly, and taking ownership of results. You will work closely with MSP leadership, Channel, Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to expand Check Point’s presence within the MSP/MSSP market.

## What You’ll Do

• Own MSP Revenue Growth: Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue, pipeline, and growth targets across assigned territory.

• Develop Strategic MSP Partners: Identify high-potential partners and build relationships with executive, sales, technical, and operational stakeholders to expand Check Point adoption.

• Recruit & Activate New Partners: Partner with recruitment and channel teams to identify, recruit, onboard, and activate new MSP/MSSP partners with clear expectations for revenue and pipeline generation.

• Build Joint Business Plans: Develop measurable partner business plans covering revenue targets, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, enablement, marketing, and growth opportunities.

• Create Pipeline: Proactively identify opportunities within partner customer bases and whitespace accounts rather than relying solely on partner-generated demand.

• Drive the Full Sales Cycle: Maintain ownership and visibility from opportunity identification through technical validation, commercial negotiation, and close.

• Manage and develop key distribution partner relationship: responsible for growing multiproduct MSP revenue through key distributor.

• Execute Joint GTM Strategies: Develop and execute co-selling, demand-generation, customer acquisition, and partner marketing initiatives designed to create measurable pipeline and revenue.

• Increase Partner Productivity: Help partners expand their security practices, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and increase recurring revenue through Check Point solutions.

• Become a Trusted Advisor: Understand each partner’s business model, customer base, growth strategy, competitive environment, and profitability drivers to position Check Point as a strategic part of their business.

• Lead with Security Expertise: Develop strong knowledge of Workspace Security solutions and clearly articulate their technical and business value to MSP executives, sellers, engineers, and customers.

• Drive Competitive Wins: Understand the competitive landscape and proactively position Check Point against competing cybersecurity and email security platforms.

• Maintain Operational Command: Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, partner plans, opportunity data, and next steps. Identify risks early and take action before they impact results.

• Own Partner Escalations: Serve as a point of escalation for strategic MSP partners, coordinating internal resources to resolve issues quickly while maintaining partner confidence.

• Operate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Sales, Channel, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to remove barriers and accelerate partner growth.

## What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of successful sales experience within MSP/MSSP, cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, or subscription-based technology environments.

• Demonstrated experience selling through and with MSP/MSSP partners, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue and managed services business models.

• Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue and pipeline targets.

• Strong understanding of how MSP/MSSP organizations generate revenue, build service offerings, manage margins, acquire customers, and scale recurring services.

• Experience recruiting, developing, and growing strategic partner relationships.

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships across multiple organizational levels, including MSP owners, executives, sales leaders, technical teams, and frontline sellers.

• Experience developing and executing partner business plans and joint GTM strategies that produce measurable revenue and pipeline.

• Strong prospecting and business-development skills with the ability to create opportunities rather than wait for inbound demand.

• Experience managing complex sales cycles involving partners, customers, technical stakeholders, and internal teams.

• Strong cybersecurity knowledge: experience with email security, endpoint security, SaaS security, or Workspace Security is highly preferred.

• Ability to translate technical cybersecurity capabilities into business outcomes, including risk reduction, operational efficiency, customer retention, recurring revenue, and profitability.

• Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM discipline.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and executive-engagement skills.

• Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment with limited direction.

• Strong business judgment with the ability to prioritize partners and opportunities based on revenue potential and strategic value.

• Bilingual with ability to speak both French and English.

## Must-Have Attributes

Enterprise Ownership: Operates beyond individual responsibilities and makes decisions based on what is best for the overall business. Takes accountability for results and actively helps teammates and partners succeed when support is needed.

Customer & Partner First: Keeps the MSP and end customer at the center of decisions, responding with urgency and working across organizational boundaries to deliver the right outcome.

Relentless Offense: Consistently looks for the next opportunity. Proactively creates pipeline, challenges obstacles, competes aggressively, and does not accept the first "no" as the final answer.

Growth & Agility: Embraces change and finds ways to grow the business without assuming additional resources or headcount. Adapts quickly, takes on new challenges, and uses available resources creatively.

Operational Command: Maintains a strong understanding of the business, including pipeline, forecast, partner performance, risks, priorities, and next actions. Anticipates issues and acts before they become barriers to execution.

Sense of Urgency: Moves quickly on business-critical opportunities, partner needs, and customer issues while proactively escalating blockers that could impact revenue or execution.

## What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building an MSP business that produces predictable, scalable, recurring growth. You will be expected to:

• Meet or exceed assigned quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Maintain sufficient qualified pipeline to support future revenue goals.

• Increase revenue and pipeline production from strategic MSP/MSSP partners.

• Recruit and activate new partners that generate measurable business.

• Build and execute joint business plans with priority partners.

• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM discipline.

• Create measurable pipeline through partner GTM and co-selling activities.

• Expand Check Point adoption across existing MSP customer bases.

• Build strong executive relationships with strategic partners.

• Identify risks early and take ownership of resolving issues that could impact revenue.

## Interview Focus Areas

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate:

• How they have built and grown revenue through MSP/MSSP partners.

• Their understanding of MSP economics and recurring-revenue business models.

• Examples of recruiting, activating, and developing new MSP partners.

• How they have turned underperforming partners into productive revenue relationships.

• Examples of joint GTM programs that produced measurable pipeline or revenue.

• Their approach to pipeline creation, forecasting, and opportunity management.

• Experience navigating complex partner and customer sales cycles.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity and the competitive security landscape.

• Ability to present a cybersecurity solution to both executive and technical audiences.

• Examples of taking ownership and delivering results in a fast-moving or ambiguous environment.

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

Job Code: 00194001

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

## ## About the Job

We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products.
In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities.

## ## About You

• Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization.

• Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).

• Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry.

• Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).

• Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.

• Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.

• Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Why Join & Who Should Apply
This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you:

• Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle.

• Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights.

• Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines.

• Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership.

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred

## Summary

Reporting to the Production Supervisor, the Quality Control Technician plays a critical role in ensuring all incoming materials, in-process production, finished products, and shipping activities meet established quality standards. This position supports product integrity, customer satisfaction, and manufacturing excellence by performing inspections, maintaining accurate documentation, identifying quality issues, and driving corrective actions throughout the production process.

## Responsibilities

Quality Control & Inspection

• Conduct incoming inspections and testing of raw materials and purchased goods.

• Perform in-process and final product inspections to verify compliance with specifications and quality standards.

• Maintain visual inspection standards and support the development of inspection procedures.

• Ensure measuring and testing equipment is calibrated and maintained according to quality requirements.

• Review and archive production and quality documentation.

## Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

• Identify non-conforming materials and products and ensure appropriate containment and disposition.

• Participate in root cause investigations and corrective action activities.

• Submit and support Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and related quality processes.

• Support internal, customer, ISO, and safety management system audits.

• Collect and analyze quality data to support continuous improvement initiatives.

## Documentation & Communication

• Maintain accurate inspection, testing, and production records.

• Provide quality documentation to internal stakeholders and customers as required.

• Communicate quality issues, corrective actions, and process improvements across departments.

• Support production teams by providing guidance on inspection methods and quality requirements.

## Health, Safety & Team Support

• Follow all company health, safety, and environmental policies and procedures.

• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.

• Support manufacturing initiatives, cross-training activities, and other duties as assigned.

• Act as a key quality resource within the manufacturing operation.

## Qualifications

Education & Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• 6 months to 1 year of related experience in quality control, manufacturing, or a similar environment.

## Skills & Knowledge

• Experience using calibration equipment and precision measuring devices.

• Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in inspections and data entry.

• Ability to interpret procedures, specifications, and quality documentation.

• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to participate in root cause analysis and quality improvement activities.

## Why Join Mattr?

• Competitive wages with paid overtime and incentive bonus plans

• Safety boot allowance, PPE, and full safety training provided

• Flexible health, dental & vision benefits with Health Spending Account (HSA)

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance

• 24/7 Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP)

• Wellness, mental health & resilience programs

• Discounts through Perkopolis & GoodLife Fitness

• Year-round permanent work at one location plus staff social events

Xerxes, a division of Mattr is the largest manufacturer of underground fiberglass storage tanks in the world. With nearly 40 years of direct industry expertise, we are recognized as both a leading innovator and a trusted brand. We are always looking to add great people to the Mattr family, people whose skills and goals match our mission and values. If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic team environment where integrity and passion drives operational excellence, Mattr is for you!

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. All recruiting activities are managed via our applicant tracking system. Please apply online to be considered for this opportunity.

## Resident Engagement Assistant

## Aspira Waterford Barrie Retirement Living

Rate of Pay: $20.14

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

This is a Casual (On-Call) position covering vacations and open shifts.

• must have some weekend availably

At Sienna you won’t just fill a position; you will build lasting relationships with residents who call Aspira their home. Join us in a role where knowing each resident not just by name, but by story, is not just possible, it is expected. Our purpose is to cultivate happiness in daily life! We truly believe it is a privilege to serve Canada’s seniors, ensuring they live fulfilling lives with the utmost comfort, dignity, and respect.

## Why you belong here:

We are a purpose driven organization. We aspire to cultivate an environment and culture where team members feel valued, heard and empowered to do meaningful work. We offer a number of programs and benefits that support team members’ financial, personal and professional needs:

• A competitive salary and vacation package

• Health & Dental benefits program

• Share Ownership and Reward Program (SOAR)

• Employee Share Purchase Plan with company match

• Continuous learning and growth so you have the skillset needed to succeed and take on new challenges

• A welcoming culture that values diversity and differing perspectives, experiences and beliefs

## What you’ll be doing:

You will be a welcomed team member, working in a fast-paced environment where you will make a meaningful difference in residents’ lives. As a Resident Engagement Assistant you will do meaningful work everyday ensuring a safe and clean environment for residents’. As an individual and part of a wider team, you will be a strong contributor to the culture of the home, where the focus is always on helping residents live fully, every day.

## What makes you a great fit?

• Track participation and engagement data per organization guidelines

• Support the completion of leisure profiles on new residents within 14 days of move-in, as directed by REM Maintain updates to daily events, posters, and designated leisure bulletin boards

• Assist in the completion and distribution of the monthly event calendar

• Respond to emails within 24-48 hours or on your next scheduled shift

• Attend all required meetings

• Ensure all IPAC and infection control protocols are adhered to

• Order and maintain departmental supplies and equipment as requested by REM

• Maintain and organize leisure areas and equipment to provide a positive “tour ready” experience

• Work cooperatively with volunteers, student, and community groups

• Maintain a positive image of the community through ongoing communications

• Adhere to established departmental policies and procedures regarding resident interaction and documentation of feedback, issues, and concerns

• Follow all health and safety policies and procedures. Work safely to reduce the risk of injury to self, co-workers, and residents

• Maintain a sound working knowledge of the role and your responsibilities during all emergency situations, even when working different shifts

• Participate in drills to prepare for emergencies and attend all education sessions in relation to emergency preparedness

• Immediately advise supervisor or designate of all team member incidents that may result in an Occupational Accident Claim; any concerns with the physical plant, incidents or injuries, and complete required reports

• Work in accordance with the organization’s Health and Safety Policies and Procedures and in compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act

• Perform other duties as required

• A passion and commitment to promote, elevate, and support the health and happiness of seniors through lifestyle wellness experiences, including special events, outings, small and large group programming, and fitness based offerings

• Must be able to set priorities and meet time and calendar deadlines; workload may fluctuate as resident needs and occupancy change

• Effective verbal and written English communication skills required

• A degree/diploma in Gerontology, Kinesiology, Human Kinetics, Therapeutic Recreation, Leisure Studies, Health Promotion, or Health Sciences

• Experience working with seniors, including an understanding of motivational concepts with seniors, as well as health, wellbeing, and leisure principles

• Certified to teach land group fitness, and where necessary aquatic fitness to seniors through a reputable organization, as approved by Sienna and/or willing to obtain within the first 60 days post hire

• Valid driver’s license and/or special class license (or willingness and ability to obtain within the first 6 months of employment) and clean driving record

• Current certificate in CPR and First Aid

• Certificate in Smart Serve/Serving It Right (or willingness and ability to obtain)

• Ability to meet the physical demands of the position, including lifting, portering, driving, leading fitness programs a minimum of twice daily etc.

• Familiarity with the provincial Occupational Health and Safety Act

• Proficiency in Word, Publisher, PowerPoint, and Excel, as well as virtual technologies such as Zoom, Skype, FaceTime etc.

• Additional certifications (i.e., specialized fitness, supporting people with dementia, etc.) considered a valuable asset

## What you need to know:

• You must be legally eligible to work in Canada or have a valid work/study permit

• You must successfully pass a Vulnerable Sector Check and Criminal Records Check

• Sienna Senior Living may utilize artificial Intelligence to screen or assess applicants for this position

Sienna Senior Living is committed to employment equity, diversity, and inclusion in the workplace. In accordance with provincial regulations, upon request, support will be provided for accommodations throughout the recruitment, selection, and assessment process.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. • Evaluate current systems and procedures and make process improvement suggestions, including the use of AI.

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Opportunity: Work term of 4 months extendable to 8, starting in January 2027.

Ciena is seeking a student to contribute to the development and evolution of automation infrastructure used for next-generation ASIC devices. The role provides exposure to ASIC design, integration, layout, and verification activities within large-scale DSP ASIC development for optical communications. The position is aligned to a student’s experience, strengths, and technical interests.

## How you will make an impact:

• Contribute to the development of automation infrastructure for ASIC devices.

• Collaborate with developers and team leads to advance ASIC design, layout, integration, and verification activities.

• Develop design blocks and evaluate designs for correctness and performance.

• Implement netlists into silicon-realizable layouts and automate placement and extraction workflows.

• Create constraints, analyze implementation reports, and automate ASIC integration processes.

• Develop reusable SystemVerilog/UVM verification components.

• Enhance Python-based reporting, analysis, build, simulation, and debug workflows.

## The must haves:

• Programming experience using one or more of Java, Python, TCL, Skill/Ocean, or SystemVerilog.

• Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.

## Nice to haves:

• Previous experience with ASIC or FPGA development programs.

• Strong analytical and debugging skills.

• Familiarity with Agile, JIRA, Confluence, and Git.

## Pay Range:

The hourly pay range for this position is $25.50 - $35.00.

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers students access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation pay as required by applicable laws.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Ciena’s WaveLogic family of products is a cornerstone of our optical fiber transmission solutions, driving innovation and success in the telecommunications industry. As a Digital ASIC Physical Implementation Engineer, you will play a critical role in developing large mixed-signal SoC ASICs targeting advanced technology nodes. Your contributions will directly impact the performance, power efficiency, and area optimization of our industry-leading WaveLogic ASICs.

In this role, you will:

• Scope and define the physical architecture of designs, utilizing EDA vendor tools to build, adapt, and maintain a robust flow from netlist to full closure and GDSII generation.

• Partner with RTL circuit designers and other layout engineers to create optimal floorplans, design power grids, and clock distribution networks that achieve the best performance and power efficiency.

• Navigate and fine-tune EDA tool settings, parameters, and attributes to ensure signoff-quality results with an optimal balance of performance, power, and area (PPA).

• Identify and propose alternative implementations, trade-offs, and solutions to achieve lower power consumption and higher performance.

• Collaborate with analog designers and ASIC/SoC teams to integrate analog blocks seamlessly into the overall design.

• Conduct initial Place & Route trials to refine design and correlation, influencing circuit architecture by working closely with RTL designers and architects to ensure reliable and closable physical design.

• Generate and implement timing ECOs to achieve timing closure, as well as functional ECOs to address RTL feature fixes when necessary.

• Utilize tools like Formality or Conformal for formal verification, analyzing reports and ensuring design accuracy and integrity.

• Write scripts to enhance productivity and efficiency for yourself and other backend engineers. Collaborate with tool and technology vendors to drive fixes, improve workflows, and evaluate new tools and features.

• Produce concise status reports at various stages of development, highlighting trade-offs and providing actionable insights.

• Resolve timing challenges associated with DFT through scan chain reordering, placement, and CTS constraints.

• Run Static Timing Analysis (STA), analyze timing reports, and debug issues related to timing constraints and correlation between P&R and STA tools.

• Your expertise in physical design, collaboration with cross-functional teams, and ability to innovate will be instrumental in advancing Ciena’s cutting-edge optical networking solutions.

## The Must Haves:

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science or other applicable scientific degree coupled with significant experience in ASIC physical digital design and timing closure

• Understanding of the submicron technology nodes full backend ASIC flow and timing/power/area analysis and trade-offs.

• Proven experience working with Place&Route tools.

• Practical experience developing scripts to automate tasks throughout the backend flow.

• Understanding of UPF and SOCV/POCV concepts

## Nice to Haves:

• Experience in working with multiple power domains

• Experience with physical verification (Calibre).

• Experience with power integrity (EMIR)

• Hand-on experience creating and validating timing constraints

• Experience with Static Timing Analysis (STA)

• Experience with physical synthesis and full RTL-to-GDS flow using industry-standard EDA tools

Salary Range: The salary range for this role in Ottawa is $109, 000 - $174, 000

We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Are you ready to take your career to the next level and make a real impact? Join our exceptional medical team at CFB Halifax, where you’ll work exclusively with Canadian Armed Forces members, providing vital care in a rewarding and supportive environment.

This is a part-time position where we require someone who can work Mondays and Fridays up to a total of 15 hours per week; work hours are 7:30am to 4pm. We are offering competitive compensation.

As an Operating Room Technician (OR Tech), you’ll play a critical role in supporting life-changing procedures while ensuring the highest standards of care. This is your chance to bring your skills to a unique and meaningful setting where your expertise truly matters.

Operating Room Technicians (OR Tech) assist surgeons, internal medicine specialists, physicians with endoscopy, cystoscopy, and minor surgery procedures. Their work includes providing patient care during all aspects of procedure, preparing for procedures, assisting with procedures, cleaning procedure room, cleaning, disinfecting and sterilizing equipment. OR Tech works under the direction of surgeon internal medicine specialist, physicians during procedures and act as a part of the health care team.

Why Choose This Role?

Exclusive Patient Base: Work solely with Canadian Armed Forces members, making a difference in the lives of those who serve.

Dynamic Environment: Collaborate with a highly skilled team of surgeons, physicians, and healthcare professionals.

Career

Growth: Hone your skills and stay at the forefront of best practices with opportunities for professional development.

## Responsibilities

The required tasks for this occupational group include the following:

a. Assist surgeons, internal medicine specialists, physicians before, during and after endoscopy, cystoscopy, and minor surgery procedures.

b. Assist the patients before, during and after procedures according to best practices and clinic procedures.

o. Maintain stock of medical supplies within MDRD and procedure rooms

• • Military Service equivalent in pay grade E-6 or above. One or more of the following Navy Enlisted Classifications (NEC) or other service branch specific equivalent:
• Machinery Repairman or service equivalent

• U32A Computer Numerically Controlled Machinist

• U33A NAMTS Inside Machinist

## Position Overview:

## Location:

Onsite in Lynchburg, VA; Relocation is available as needed.

• Advises company officials and employees on contractual matters both on commercial and U.S. Government contracts with a greater emphasis on the latter. Review and formally concur on major contract actions taken by the company.

• Participates in contract negotiations with customers and suppliers and leading negotiating teams in the negotiation of complex transactions.

• Reviews contract documents and company purchasing procedures for compliance with the pertinent regulations. Interface with Panels and Boards related to Federal Government Contract Compliance matters and maintain current knowledge on the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and Agency supplements to the FAR.
